Andaman & Nicobar Forest Department Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

Selection will be made through a Physical Endurance Test consisting of three different levels. Candidates participating in Level-I, II & III Tests shall furnish an undertaking that they are physically fit & mentally sound to undertake the test. Candidates failing any test shall not be given a second chance under any circumstances.

Level-I Test (Running Test): Qualifying for short-listing

  • Male: Must complete 10 km
  • Female: Must complete 8 km
  • 15 times the number of vacancies shall be shortlisted.

Level-II Test (Long Jump): Qualifying in nature (to be cleared within three attempts)

Category Male Female
General & OBC 12 feet 9 feet
ST 9 feet 7 feet

Level-III Test (Weight Carrying Test): For final selection/merit

  • Male: Carry 30 kg weight for 500 meters
  • Female: Carry 20 kg weight for 500 meters

Merit list shall be prepared for exact number of vacancies + wait list (maximum 10% of vacancies notified) based on Level-III performance. ST/OBC/EWS candidates selected on merit without relaxed standards will be accommodated against unreserved vacancies. Reserved vacancies will be filled from eligible ST/OBC/EWS domiciled in A&N Islands.

Final selection is subject to verification of certificates, character & antecedents, and medical examination. Selected candidates will undergo 2 years probation.

How to Apply

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Andaman Forest Department Mazdoor Recruitment 2026 through the official recruitment portal.

A. Online Application Process

  1. The candidate should register their full particulars of the Application through online only at https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in
  2. The online application will be accepted from 16/03/2026 (from 11:00 Hrs) to 29/04/2026 (up to 23:59 Hrs).
  3. Candidates should provide all the mandatory details in the online portal. Failing which the application will not be accepted by the website.
  4. Photograph to be uploaded should be:
    • 8-bit JPEG format
    • Size between 10 Kb to 50 Kb
    • Resolution 100 × 200 pixels
  5. It is advised to enable JavaScript in the browser (Internet Explorer, Firefox, Google Chrome, etc.) for successful upload.
  6. The website will allow the applicant to take printout forthwith of the submitted application. Those who fail to take printout immediately can download the filled-in form later also.
  7. All candidates who have registered their name in the local Employment Exchange as unemployed must enter their registration number in the appropriate box while filling the online application.

B. Documents to be submitted at the time of Document Verification (after Physical Test)

Candidates shortlisted after the Physical Test must bring:

  • One copy of recent passport-size photograph
  • Self-attested copies of:
    • Essential Qualification Certificate (10th Pass or ITI in relevant trade)
    • 10th Pass Certificate (showing Date of Birth)
    • OBC/ST/EWS/MSP Certificate (if applicable)
    • Meritorious Sports Person Certificate (if applicable)
    • Employment Registration Certificate/Card (if registered)
    • Printed copy of the Online Application Form

Important Notes from PDF

  • Applications received without the prescribed fee (₹100 for General/OBC/EWS/MSP) shall be summarily rejected.
  • Women candidates and ST candidates are exempted from fee payment.

General Instructions

  • Candidates must read the full notification carefully before applying.
  • Candidature is purely provisional at all stages. Detailed scrutiny of eligibility will be done later.
  • Age is reckoned as on the closing date i.e. 29-04-2026.
  • Candidates must have good physique and meet all physical standards.
  • For Mill Division technical posts (Raftman, Grader, Asst. Sawyer, etc.), a separate Grade-specific Trade Test will be conducted later by DCF, Mill Division, Chatham.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the Physical Test.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • The decision of the Department of Environment & Forests, A&N Administration in all matters shall be final and binding.
  • Any dispute shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts/Tribunals in A&N Islands only.
  • All updates (Admit Card, Physical Test schedule, Result) will be available only on https://erecruitment.andamannicobar.gov.in.
  • Candidates found using mobile phones or electronic gadgets in the test centre will be disqualified.
  • In case of any difficulty, contact Helpline: 03192-255228 (10:00 AM to 5:00 PM on working days).

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Walk-in-Interview only.

  • Candidates must fill the prescribed Application Form (attached with the advertisement) completely.
  • Submit the filled Application Form at the venue of the interview along with:
    • Original documents + one set of self-attested photocopies of all required certificates.
    • Three recent passport size photographs.
  • Interview will be conducted on the spot.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of credentials, educational qualification, experience (if any) and performance in the personal interview.
  • Offer of engagement will be issued to the suitable candidates in the order of merit and as per the number of vacancies.
  • In addition to the main panel, a reserved panel will also be prepared which will be used in case of any shortfall.
  • Engagement is subject to being found medically fit as per IRCTC norms.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Walk-in-Interview only (No online application).

Steps to Apply:

  1. Download and fill the prescribed Application Form (attached with the notification) in all respects.
  2. Bring the filled Application Form along with:
    • Original + one set of self-attested copies of all educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), category certificate, Aadhaar, etc.
    • Three recent passport size photographs.
  3. Appear personally at the venue on the scheduled date and time for document verification and interview.
  4. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in-interview.

Note: In case of extension of interview dates, candidates will have to arrange their own stay and food.

General Instructions

  • Engagement is purely contractual for an initial period of 02 years and extendable by one more year based on requirement and satisfactory performance. It will not confer any right for regular/permanent employment in IRCTC.
  • Contract can be terminated by giving one month’s notice by either side.
  • Selected candidates will have to furnish a Security Deposit of ₹25,000/- (DD/NEFT).
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates working in Govt./PSUs must produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview and proper relieving letter at the time of joining.
  • Candidates should ensure that they fulfil all eligibility criteria. If any false information is found at any stage, candidature/services will be terminated.
  • IRCTC reserves the right to cancel/amend the advertisement or the selection process at any stage.
  • Number of vacancies may increase or decrease as per requirement.
  • Knowledge of computer (MS Office) and preparation of reports is essential.
  • Good communication skills in English & Hindi are mandatory; knowledge of local languages (Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam) is an added advantage.
  • The selected candidate may be posted in Tamil Nadu, Kerala & Karnataka and can be deployed anywhere in India as per requirement.
  • All corrigendum/clarifications will be uploaded only on IRCTC website www.irctc.com. Candidates are advised to visit the website regularly.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.

  • Desirable Experience: One year experience in drafting of legal documents, scrutiny, recruitment matters (notice of examination, conduct of examination, evaluation of answer books, results, medical examination cases), drafting of contract agreements, handling CAT matters, etc.
  • Age Limit: Not exceeding 32 years as on the closing date.

  • Remuneration: Rs. 60,000/- per month (consolidated). On extension for another year (based on satisfactory performance), remuneration may be increased up to 5% (maximum 1.25 times of initial remuneration).
  • Period of Engagement: Initial term of one year, extendable on case-to-case basis.
  • General Conditions: Full-time engagement, no other assignment permitted, secrecy as per Official Secrets Act, 1923, non-disclosure agreement, no additional allowances (except specified TA/DA for tours), leave as per rules, police verification mandatory, etc.

SSC (KKR) Young Professional (Legal Consultant) Application Process

Interested and eligible candidates may send their application in the prescribed format (Annexure-B) along with all required documents to the following address so as to reach latest by 30 April 2026:

The Regional Director,
Staff Selection Commission (KKR),
1st Floor, ‘E’ Wing, Kendriya Sadan,
Koramangala, Bengaluru – 560034 (Karnataka)

Applications received after the prescribed date will not be considered.

Selection Process

  • The commission will interact with the shortlisted candidates before finalizing the selection.

How to Apply

  • Interested candidates may send their application in the format enclosed as Annexure ‘B’ to “The Regional Director, SSC (KKR), 1st Floor, ‘E’ Wing, Kendriya Sadan, Koramangala, Bangalore, Karnataka”, so as to reach this office, latest by 30.04.2026.
  • Applications received after the prescribed time limit shall not be considered.

General Information/Instructions

  • The engagement of Young Professional (Legal Consultant) would be on full time basis and he/she would not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the period of contract with SSC (KKR).
  • The Young Professional (Legal Consultant) on having accepted the offer shall enter into contract with SSC (KKR). The norms for secrecy will be as per the Official Secrets Act, 1923.
  • The Young Professional (Legal Consultant) shall not indulge in or disclose to any person any details of office, operational process, technical know-how, administrative / organizational matters which are of confidential /secret nature.
  • The Young Professional (Legal Consultant) shall not be entitled to any allowance such as conveyance allowance, dearness allowance, residential telephone, transport facility, residential accommodation, CGHS/medical reimbursement etc. other than those specifically mentioned herein.
  • The appointment of Young Professional (Legal Consultant) shall be of a temporary nature and SSC (KKR) can cancel the appointment at any time without providing any reason for it.
  • The Young Professional (Legal Consultant) shall be expected to follow all the rules and regulations of the Government of India which are in force.

How to Apply

Candidates must register as per 'ONE TIME REGISTRATION ' with the Official Website of Kerala Public Service Commission 'www.keralapsc.gov.in' before applying for the post. Candidates who have registered can apply by logging on to their profile using their User-ID and password. Candidates must click on the 'Apply Now' button of the respective posts in the Notification Link to apply for a post.

Candidates who create new Profile should upload their Photograph taken within a period of 6 months. Name of the candidate and the date of photograph taken should be printed legibly at the bottom portion. The photograph once uploaded meeting all requirements shall be valid for 10 years from the date of uploading. .

There is no change in other instructions regarding the uploading of photographs. No application fee is required. Candidates are responsible for the correctness of the personal information and secrecy of password. Before the final submission of the application on the profile candidates must ensure correctness of the information in their profile. They must quote the User-ID for further communication with the Commission. Application submitted is provisional and cannot be deleted or altered after submission. Candidates are advised to keep a printout or soft copy of the online application for future reference.

Candidates can take the printout of the application by clicking on the link 'My applications' in their profile. All correspondences with the Commission, regarding the application should be accompanied with the printout of the application. The application will be summarily rejected if noncompliance with the notification is found in due course of processing. Documents to prove qualification, age, Community etc. have to be produced as and when called for.

Candidates who have AADHAAR card should add AADHAAR Card as ID Proof in their profile.

  • The Ranked List will remain in force for a minimum period of one year and a maximum period of three years.
  • Kerala PSC reserves the right to cancel the advice for appointment of any candidate if any mistake is found later.

General Information/Instructions

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Supervisor (Assay/T.O.-Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy): Candidates must possess a 1st class full-time Diploma in Engineering in the relevant stream (Chemical/Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy) from a recognized institution, or higher qualification i.e. B.Tech/B.E./B.Sc. (Engineering) in the relevant discipline.
  • Engraver (Sculpture/Metal Works): Candidates must hold a Bachelor of Fine Arts (Sculpture or Metal Works) with at least 55% marks from a recognized institution.
  • Jr. Office Assistant & Jr. Bullion Assistant: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and typing speed of English @ 40 w.p.m. / Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Jr. Hindi Typist: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and Hindi typing speed @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. with Chemistry as a major subject with at least 55% marks.
  • Jr. Technician (all trades): Candidates must hold a full-time ITI certificate recognized by NCVT/SCVT in the relevant trade (Fitter/Turner/Electrician/Carpentry/Melter/Chemical Plant Operator/Goldsmith).
  • Age Limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 25 years for Jr. Technician posts, 28 years for B-3/B-4 level posts, and 30 years for Supervisor posts, as on the closing date of online application. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10–15 years), and Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected candidates under IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 will be appointed on regular posts with pay scales as per the company's pay structure along with applicable allowances.
  • Pay Scale Details: Supervisor posts carry Level S-1 pay matrix ₹27,600–95,910; Engraver and Jr. Office/Bullion Assistant/Lab Assistant posts carry Level B-3 ₹21,540–77,160 or Level B-4 ₹23,910–85,570; and Junior Technician posts carry Level W-1 ₹18,780–67,390. Selected candidates will be placed on probation for one year, extendable by a further one year at the discretion of the company.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per the IGM Recruitment 2026 advertisement, candidates belonging to UR, EWS and OBC categories must pay a non-refundable fee of ₹1000/- (inclusive of GST).
  • SC/ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee but are required to pay a non-refundable fee of ₹200/- towards service expenses.
  • Payment can be made online through Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, or UPI. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted through an online Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective type, followed by a Typing/Skill Test for certain posts, and a final merit list based on CBT performance.
  • For Supervisor posts (S-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes consisting of General Arithmetic (25 marks), Logical Reasoning (20 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (105 marks).
  • For Jr. Office Assistant, Jr. Bullion Assistant & Jr. Hindi Typist (B-3 Level): A CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Awareness (30), Computer Knowledge (30), English Language Skills (30), Numerical Aptitude (30), and Reasoning Aptitude (30), followed by a Typing Test (English @ 40 w.p.m. or Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.). Final merit is based on CBT performance only.
  • For Jr. Technician posts (W-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 120 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Arithmetic (20 marks), Logical Reasoning (15 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (85 marks).
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS category – 55%; OBC – 50%; SC/ST – 45%. There is no negative marking.

India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form

The online application process for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 will start from 28th March 2026 and the last date to submit the IGM online application form is 27th April 2026. Candidates must visit the official website igmnoida.spmcil.com, open the career page and complete their IGM Recruitment 2026 Application Form within the given dates.

While filling the India Government Mint application form 2026, candidates should register with a valid email ID and mobile number, enter personal and educational details, upload scanned documents, pay the examination fee (if applicable) and finally submit and download the IGM online form for future reference.

How to Apply for India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for the India Government Mint IGM Recruitment 2026 must submit their application forms through the online mode only within the specified dates. Follow the step-by-step process given below to fill the IGM online application form correctly.

  • Eligible candidates for IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application through the company's official website within the specified dates.
  • Step 1 – Visit Official Website: Go to http://igmnoida.spmcil.com, click on "Discover SPMCIL" and navigate to the CAREERS page to find the IGM Recruitment 2026 link.
  • Step 2 – Registration: Register on the portal using a valid mobile number and email ID, create login credentials, and proceed to the IGM online application form 2026.
  • Step 3 – Fill Application Form: Enter personal details, address, educational qualifications, category, unit preference (Mumbai/Kolkata/Hyderabad/Noida), and post applied for carefully, ensuring all data matches your original certificates.
  • Step 4 – Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of your recent passport-size photograph (JPG/JPEG, 20–50 KB, 4.5×3.5 cm), signature (10–20 KB), left thumb impression (20–50 KB), handwritten declaration, and other required certificates (educational, caste, PwBD, Ex-SM, etc.) in the prescribed format and size as per instructions in the IGM notification 2026.
  • Step 5 – Pay Fee & Submit: Complete the online fee payment (where applicable) through Debit/Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI. Review all entries, submit the form, download the confirmation page, and take a printout of the IGM application form 2026 for document verification and future reference.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Screening Test followed by Document Verification.

  • Computer Based Test (CBT):
    • Total Marks: 120 (Objective Type – 120 Multiple Choice Questions, 1 mark each).
    • Duration: 1 ½ hours (90 minutes) or as decided by the Aayog.
    • Syllabus: (i) Subject(s)/field(s) up to the level of prescribed essential qualification(s). (ii) General Knowledge (including HP & Current Affairs), Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi of Matric Standard.
    • Minimum Qualifying Marks:
      • General Category: 45%
      • SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters: 40% (Aayog may relax by maximum 5% if number of qualifying candidates is less than posts).
    • In case of multiple shifts: Normalization of scores using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method).
    • Provisional Answer Key will be uploaded; 7 days for objections (fee ₹200 per challenge).
  • Shortlisted candidates (as per merit) will be called for Document Verification.
  • Final selection on the basis of CBT marks + verification of original documents.
  • Category-wise Waiting List/Panel will also be prepared (25% for up to 25 posts, 15% for 25-50 posts, 10% for above 50 posts).
  • Appointment is purely Scheme-based, temporary for 5 years on fixed honorarium under the CBSE Scheme notified vide No. EDN-B-A(1)-3/2025 dated 01.04.2026. Selected candidates are not regular Government employees and can be posted anywhere in the State.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through the official website of HPRCA. No Offline Application Form will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit https://hprca.hp.gov.in → Click “Sign Up” to create username & password.
  2. Complete One Time Registration (OTR): Fill personal details, educational qualifications, work experience (if any), upload recent passport-size photograph & signature.
  3. Login → Go to “Apply” → Select the desired post (Post Code 26017/26018/26019/26020).
  4. Fill/confirm details (auto-filled from OTR profile).
  5. Select Preferred Exam District (HPRCA reserves right to allot any centre).
  6. Review application → Pay fee online through Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking.
  7. Submit and take printout of the application form for future reference.
  8. A candidate can submit only one application against each post.

General Instructions

  • Cut-off date for determining eligibility (Essential Qualifications, Age, Experience) is 04-05-2026 (11:59 PM).
  • Age: 18 to 45 years (as on 01-01-2026).
  • Candidates must be registered on One Time Registration (OTR) portal before filling ORA.
  • Category once claimed cannot be changed after the correction window.
  • Only Bonafide Himachali candidates need to have passed Matric & 10+2 from HP School/ Institution (except Bonafide Himachali).
  • Reserved category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/BPL/WFF) must be valid on closing date of ORA as well as on date of document verification.
  • PwBD/PwD candidates can avail scribe/reader & compensatory time (20 minutes per hour) after prior approval from HPRCA.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in CBT or document verification.
  • Admit Card will be downloaded from the website only (no postal dispatch).
  • Mere submission of application or appearing in CBT does not guarantee eligibility. Final eligibility is determined at document verification stage.
  • Canvassing in any form or use of unfair means will lead to disqualification and possible criminal action.
  • The appointment is purely temporary under the CBSE Scheme. Selected candidates shall not be regularized against any sanctioned post of Education Department.
  • Dispute, if any, shall be subject to Court jurisdiction of Himachal Pradesh only.
  • Candidates are advised to visit https://hprca.hp.gov.in regularly for updates, admit card, answer key, result etc.

Selection Process

Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Screening Test of 120 marks of 1 ½ hours (one and a half hours) duration or as decided by the Aayog.

Syllabus The objective type screening test will consist of 120 multiple-choice questions, with each question carrying 1 mark.

However, the HPRCA may issue a detailed syllabus on its official website in due course of time.

Minimum Qualifying Marks

  • General Category: 45%
  • SC/ST/OBC/Wards of Freedom Fighters: 40%

If the number of candidates securing the prescribed percentage is less than the advertised posts, the Aayog may relax the qualifying percentage by a maximum of 5% (i.e., upto 40% for General and 35% for reserved categories) for reasons to be recorded in writing.

Normalization of Scores (for multiple shifts CBT) Scores shall be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean and Standard Deviation Method) for preparation of the merit list.

Further Process

  • Shortlisting for Document Verification based on merit.
  • Final selection/allocation on the basis of “Merit-Cum-Option-Cum-Availability of Post” formula.

Step 3: Complete/Update Profile – Only users with completed profile can apply. Edit if required.

Step 4: Apply for a Post – View available posts → Click “Apply”.

Step 5: Preferred Exam District – Select preferred district(s). (HPRCA reserves the right to allot any centre.)

Step 6: Confirm Application Details – System auto-fills from profile; review carefully.

Step 7: Pay Application Fee – Through Online Payment Gateway (Credit/Debit Card/Net Banking).

Step 8: Application Submission Confirmation – After successful payment, application is complete.

How to Apply for NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The application process is online only and consists of two steps - first registering on the NAPS/NATS portal, then applying on the NHPC official website.

  1. Register on NAPS/NATS Portal: ITI trade candidates must register on NAPS at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Graduate/Diploma trade candidates must register on NATS at nats.education.gov.in. Complete your profile and upload all required documents.
  2. Note your Registration/Enrolment Number: After completing registration, note your NAPS/NATS enrolment number carefully - it will be required for the NHPC application form.
  3. Apply on NHPC Website: Visit nhpcindia.com → Career Section → Engagement of Apprentice → Apply Now. Fill in all required details including trade, personal information, educational qualifications, category and NAPS/NATS enrolment number.
  4. Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of - NAPS/NATS Registration Form, 10th Marksheet (Age proof), ITI/Diploma/Degree Marksheets, SC/ST/OBC(NCL) Certificate (if applicable), recent passport-size colour photograph, and signature.
  5. Submit & Save: Review all entries carefully and submit the application before 06 May 2026, 5:00 PM. Save/print a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Note: candidates should apply for only one region/state/trade. 

Important: Applications made through any mode other than the NHPC official website will not be accepted. Candidates awaiting final results of qualifying examinations and those who have already undergone apprenticeship training of 1 year or more are not eligible to apply.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Test (CBT) / Written Screening Test followed by Document Verification.

  • Computer Based Test (CBT): 120 Marks (Duration: 1½ Hours)
    • 120 Multiple Choice Questions (1 mark each)
    • Part (i): Subjects/fields upto the level of prescribed essential qualification (Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering)
    • Part (ii):
      • (a) General Knowledge including General Knowledge of Himachal Pradesh & Current Affairs
      • (b) Everyday Science, Logical Reasoning, Social Science, General English & General Hindi of Matric Standard
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 45% for General Category | 40% for SC/ST/OBC/WFF Categories (relaxable by maximum 5% if number of qualified candidates is less than vacancies)
  • In case of multiple shifts, scores will be normalized using Z-Score Method (Mean & Standard Deviation Method)
  • Document Verification of original certificates will be conducted for shortlisted candidates
  • Final selection is based on merit of CBT + document verification
  • A category-wise waiting list (panel) will also be prepared
  • Selected candidates will be engaged as Job Trainee under Job Trainee Scheme-2025 (consolidated honorarium ₹23,500/- p.m.)

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through the official website https://hprea.hp.gov.in

Steps to Apply:

  1. Candidates must first register on the One Time Registration (OTR) portal.
  2. Login with OTR credentials and fill the Online Recruitment Application (ORA) Form with all mandatory details (Name, Father’s Name, Mother’s Name, Date of Birth exactly as per Matric certificate, category, etc.).
  3. Upload scanned copies of:
    • Recent passport-size photograph (not older than 1 month)
    • Signature
    • Matric/10+2 certificate, Diploma/B.E./B.Tech marksheets & degree
    • Category certificates (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/BPL/WFF/PwD etc.)
    • Any other required documents
  4. Pay the examination & processing fee online through Credit Card/Debit Card/Net Banking.
  5. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.
  6. Correction window will open for 7 days (after 3 days of closing date) with additional fee of ₹100/-.

General Instructions

  • Eligibility of candidates will be determined as on the closing date i.e. 02-05-2026.
  • Candidates must be registered on OTR portal before filling ORA.
  • Category certificates (OBC/EWS/BPL/WFF etc.) must remain valid throughout the selection process (closing date + document verification).
  • Bonafide Himachali candidates must have passed Matric & 10+2 from any school/institution in Himachal Pradesh (relaxed for Bonafide Himachalis).
  • PwBD/PwD candidates can avail scribe/reader and compensatory time (20 minutes per hour) after prior approval from HPRCA.
  • No change in category or any details allowed after closure of correction window.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee eligibility or call for CBT.
  • All updates (roll number, admit card, result) will be available only on the official website https://hprea.hp.gov.in. Candidates must regularly visit the website.
  • Candidates must keep their registered mobile number and email ID active till completion of selection process.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts in Himachal Pradesh.
  • The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease.
  • The decision of HPRCA shall be final and binding.

Selection Process

Selection will be made on the basis of performance of the candidate in the Interview before the Selection Board.

  • Walk-in-Interview (Offline Mode) on 16-04-2026.
  • Document Verification & Screening of applications: 09:00 AM to 10:30 AM.

  • Final selection is based on Interview performance.
  • Result will be displayed on the official website www.esic.gov.in.
  • Selected candidates will have to join immediately or as per the schedule mentioned in the offer of appointment.
  • This is a Rolling Advertisement – unfilled vacancies will be carried forward and fresh interviews conducted every Wednesday (if required).

How to Apply

Application Mode: Walk-in-Interview (Offline)

Steps to Apply:

  1. Download the Application Form from the ESIC website www.esic.gov.in.
  2. Fill the application form completely and attach self-attested copies of all required documents.
  3. Report at the venue ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Desula, MIA, Alwar (Rajasthan) – 301030 by 09:00 AM on 16-04-2026.
  4. Carry:
    • Two recent passport-size self-attested photographs
    • Original + self-attested photocopies of all certificates (Date of Birth, Educational Qualification, Experience, Research Publications, Category Certificate, Medical Council Registration, etc.)
    • NOC from present employer (if working in Govt./Semi-Govt./PSU)
    • Application Fee (₹500/- for General/OBC/EWS or Nil for SC/ST/Female/ESIC employees/Ex-Servicemen/PwD)
  5. Pay fee in cash at the venue OR through online mode (HDFC Bank A/c No. 50100729736609, IFSC: HDFC0002857) and bring transaction proof / Demand Draft.
  6. Filled application form may also be sent in advance to [email protected] (optional but recommended).

General Instructions

  • This is a Rolling Advertisement – vacancies are provisional and may increase/decrease. Fresh interviews will be held every Wednesday if seats remain vacant.
  • Appointment is purely contractual (Teaching Faculty: 1 year; Senior Resident: 3 years) and terminable on one month’s notice or on joining of regular incumbent.
  • No claim for regular absorption or continuation.
  • Candidates must be registered with MCI/RMC or any State Medical Council before joining.
  • Age and experience will be counted as on the date of Walk-in-Interview.
  • Reservation benefits are available only to candidates having valid certificates issued by competent authority in the prescribed format.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
  • Mere reporting for interview does not guarantee eligibility. Candidature is provisional and subject to detailed scrutiny.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Director/Dean reserves the right to cancel/postpone the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason.
  • All disputes will be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts in Alwar/Rajasthan.
  • For any clarification, contact Dean Office on 0144-2887501/02 (11:00 AM to 04:00 PM) or email: [email protected].

NVS Teacher Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

How to Apply for NVS Recruitment 2026

Visit official website

Open online application link

  • Enter personal details, communication details and category details exactly as per your certificates.

  • Fill in your educational qualifications (Graduation, B.Ed, B.Sc, B.Lib, BPEd, PG Diploma etc. as applicable) and experience details post-wise.

Upload documents

  • Upload required certificates such as educational qualification, CTET certificate (for TGTs), category/reservation certificate, experience certificates and any other documents mentioned in the notification.

Payment of application fee

  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) as per the details given in the official notification through the available online payment modes.

  • After successful payment, ensure that your fee status shows as “paid” and proceed to final submission.

Final submission and printout

  • Recheck all the information filled in the form carefully before clicking on “Final Submit”.

  • After submission, download and take a printout of the filled application form and payment receipt for future reference and document verification.

  • Incomplete applications, applications without required documents or incorrect information are liable to be rejected at any stage.

APPSC TGT Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates who wish to apply for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 must carefully check the APPSC TGT Eligibility Criteria 2026 in terms of nationality, age limit and educational qualification. Only those applicants who fully meet the APPSC TGT eligibility conditions as on the last date of application will be considered for the Trained Graduate Teacher Examination 2026.

APPSC TGT Age Limit 2026

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 35 years as on 27th April 2026 (last date for receipt of online application)
  • Upper age limit is relaxable for APST, PwBD and other categories as per Government of Arunachal Pradesh rules and latest orders.

APPSC TGT Educational Qualification 2026

  • Candidates must possess a Second‑Class Bachelor’s Degree in Arts, Science or Commerce from a recognised university.
  • The applicant must have studied the concerned subject in all years/semesters of the Bachelor’s Degree programme, and the final year/semester marksheet must clearly show the subject name and marks.
  • A B.Ed (General) degree from an NCTE recognised institute is mandatory; only General B.Ed is acceptable for teaching Classes IX–X as per the Education Department instructions.
  • B.Ed (Special Education) is not treated as an alternative professional qualification for APPSC TGT (Secondary) posts.
  • The minimum duration of the B.Ed programme should be two years including mandatory school internship; however, one‑year B.Ed degrees obtained before 2015 are also considered eligible.
  • Candidates who have completed a Four‑Year Integrated Degree Programme with B.Ed (General) are eligible, provided they meet the subject‑specific requirements.
  • Students who are still in the final year/final semester of Bachelor’s Degree or B.Ed are not eligible to apply for APPSC TGT 2026.
  • Each candidate is allowed to apply for only one TGT (Secondary) post/subject under this recruitment.

Only Indian citizens fulfilling the above APPSC TGT Eligibility Criteria 2026 in terms of age, essential educational qualification and professional B.Ed degree should submit the APPSC TGT online application form on appsc.gov.in.

Application Form

The online application process for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 will start on 26th March 2026 from 5:00 PM and the last date to submit the APPSC TGT online application form is 27th April 2026 up to 1:00 PM. Candidates must visit the official website appsc.gov.in, complete One Time Registration (OTR) and then fill their APPSC TGT Application Form 2026 carefully before the last date.

APPSC TGT Salary 2026

The candidates selected under APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 will receive a salary in Pay Matrix Level‑7, which corresponds to a basic pay scale of ₹44,900 to ₹1,42,400 per month for the TGT post in the Education Department, Government of Arunachal Pradesh. In addition to the APPSC TGT basic pay 2026, selected teachers will be entitled to various allowances as per state government norms, such as Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), and other admissible benefits under Group‑B (Non‑Gazetted) cadre, making the overall APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher salary package attractive for eligible graduates with B.Ed.

APPSC TGT Selection Process 2026

The APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 selection process is conducted in two main stages – a Written Examination (Objective) followed by Viva‑Voce and Classroom Teaching. Candidates must qualify the APPSC TGT Written Exam 2026 by securing the prescribed minimum marks to be shortlisted for the APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce round.

Stage 1 – APPSC TGT Written Examination 2026

  • The APPSC TGT Written Examination (Objective) consists of two parts – a General paper and a Concerned Subject paper, together carrying a total of 450 marks.
  • Paper 1 – General English, General Studies, Aptitude & Pedagogy (Objective): 150 marks.
  • Paper 2 – Concerned Subject (Objective): 300 marks in the relevant TGT subject (e.g. English, Hindi, Mathematics, Science, Social Science, etc.).
  • There is negative marking in the APPSC TGT exam – 1/6th of the marks allotted to the question will be deducted for each wrong answer.
  • To qualify the written exam, a candidate must secure at least the minimum qualifying marks prescribed in the notification (overall aggregate as well as subject‑wise), only then they will be considered for the next stage of the APPSC TGT selection process 2026.

Stage 2 – APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce & Classroom Teaching 2026

  • Candidates who qualify in the written examination will be shortlisted in order of merit in a ratio of about 3 times the number of advertised TGT vacancies for the Viva‑Voce and Classroom Teaching test.
  • The APPSC TGT Viva‑Voce and Classroom Teaching carries 50 marks and is conducted on the premises of the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission.
  • This stage evaluates the candidate’s subject knowledge, teaching skills, communication ability, classroom handling and overall suitability for the Trained Graduate Teacher post.

Final Merit List – APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher 2026

  • The final selection for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 is made on the basis of total marks obtained out of 500 marks (450 marks in Written Examination + 50 marks in Viva‑Voce & Classroom Teaching).
  • Candidates who fail to meet the minimum qualifying marks in the written exam or are found ineligible at document verification will not be considered for final appointment as APPSC TGT, even if they appeared in the examination.

How to Apply for APPSC TGT Recruitment 2026

The application process for APPSC Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 is completely online. Eligible candidates must first complete One Time Registration (OTR) on the APPSC portal and then submit the APPSC TGT Application Form 2026 within the specified dates.

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission at www.appsc.gov.in.
  • Step 2: Click on the “One Time Registration (OTR)” link and complete the registration by entering basic details to generate your Login ID and password (if already registered, skip this step and log in directly).
  • Step 3: After successful OTR, log in with your registered User ID and password and open the online application link for Advertisement No. 02/2026 – Trained Graduate Teacher Examination 2026 (Secondary Level).
  • Step 4: Fill in the APPSC TGT online application form with accurate personal details, contact information, TGT subject/post, category, educational qualifications and B.Ed details as per your certificates.
  • Step 5: Upload scanned copies of your recent passport‑size photograph, signature and required documents (photo ID, APST certificate, PwBD certificate, etc.) in the prescribed format and file size.
  • Step 6: Pay the APPSC TGT application fee 2026 online – ₹150 for APST candidates and ₹200 for other candidates, while PwBD candidates are exempted from fee payment.
  • Step 7: Carefully review all details entered in the APPSC TGT Application Form 2026; submit only a single, fully completed application. In case of multiple forms, the one with the highest Registration ID and complete details will be considered.
  • Step 8: Click on “Submit” to finalise the form and download/print the submitted APPSC TGT application form and fee receipt for future reference, written examination and document verification.

Applicants are advised to complete the APPSC TGT online form 2026 well before the last date to avoid last‑minute technical issues and ensure successful submission.

APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

I. Educational Qualification – Junior Specialist (Allopathy)

  • A recognised medical qualification included in the First or Part-II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualification) of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. Holders of Part-II qualifications must also fulfil the condition stipulated in sub-section (3) of section (13) of the Act.
  • Post-Graduate Degree in the concerned specialty mentioned in Section 'A', 'B', or 'D' as the case may be in Schedule VI or equivalent of Arunachal Pradesh Health Service Rules, 2000.
  • The candidate (including Foreign Medical Graduates/Post Graduates) must be registered with Arunachal Pradesh Medical Council (APMC).

II. Educational Qualification – Junior Dental Specialist

  • Medical qualification included in Part-I or Part-III of the Schedule to the Dentist Act, 1948 as amended from time to time.
  • Post-Graduate Degree in the concerned specialty mentioned in Section 'A', 'B', or 'D' as the case may be in Schedule-VI or equivalent of Arunachal Pradesh Health Service Rules, 2000.
  • The candidate (including Foreign Medical Graduates/Post Graduates) must be registered with Arunachal Pradesh Dental Council (APDC).

One Time Relaxation (GoAP): The Government of Arunachal Pradesh has granted One Time Relaxation vide GoAP Notification No. DMETR-11012(17)/1/2024 dated 7th February 2026, waiving off the requirement of 3 years' experience after Post Graduate Degree and 5 years' experience after Post Graduate Diploma in the concerned Speciality.

Age Limit

Candidates must not exceed 50 years as on the last date of submission of online application form (18th May 2026), in accordance with One Time Relaxation vide GoAP Notification No. DMETR-11012(17)/1/2024 dated 7th February 2026. Age relaxation of 5 years is available for Government Servants. Age concession for PwBD candidates and regular Govt. servants of Government of Arunachal Pradesh will be as per Government rules in force.

APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Selection will be made through Viva-Voce / Interview only in accordance with the Arunachal Pradesh Health Service Rules-2000 amended vide Notification No. HFW-1/89(Pt) dated 31/10/2003. The total marks of Interview shall be 100 marks.

  • Candidates must score a minimum of 50% of the total marks in the interview to qualify for selection (as per Rule XI, Sub-rule (e) of APPSC Manual for Conduct of Examination-2024).
  • Relaxation for PwBD candidates, if any, shall apply as per the Government notification.
  • Candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on information provided in the online application form.
  • Eligible candidates must produce all original certificates/documents/mark sheets at the time of interview. If a candidate is found ineligible during document verification, candidature shall be rejected.
  • The date for interview of eligible candidates will be notified in due course.

Documents to Be Uploaded with Online Application

  • Signature of the candidate on white paper with black ink pen (40–50 kb, jpg format).
  • Latest/recent colour passport-size photo (40–100 kb, jpg format) — white background, front-faced, without headgear or sunglasses.
  • Self-attested photocopy of Matriculation Certificate/Marksheet with Date of Birth (only document accepted as proof of DOB).
  • Self-attested photocopy of APST certificate (for APST candidates seeking reservation).
  • Self-attested photocopy of Aadhaar Card / PRC / EPIC as identity proof (for non-APST applicants).
  • Self-attested photocopy of Bachelor Degree certificates and mark sheets issued by the University.
  • Self-attested photocopy of Master Degree certificates and mark sheets issued by the University.
  • Experience Certificate in the concerned speciality, if any.
  • PwBD/PwD disability certificate issued by certifying authority as per Section 57 of Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 — must clearly mention the Percentage of Disability and must be issued before the last date of application submission.
  • Self-attested photocopy of APMC Registration Certificate (for Allopathy) or APDC Registration Certificate (for Dental).
  • Govt. employees: Copy of intimation submitted to Head of Department or NOC issued by the department.

How to Apply for APPSC Medical Specialist Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only at https://appsc.gov.in. One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory before filling the application form.

Apply Online – appsc.gov.in

1. Complete One Time Registration (OTR): Visit https://appsc.gov.in and mandatorily register for OTR before filling the online application form. Candidates who have already registered in OTR can directly log in with the same user ID and password.

2. Fill the Online Application Form: The online application link will be active from 17th April 2026 (1700 hrs) to 18th May 2026 (1700 hrs). Fill all details carefully and accurately. The application form once submitted within the last date shall be complete in all respects — no additional time will be provided for further changes.

3. Upload Required Documents: Upload scanned copies of all required documents (as listed in Point E of the notification) in the prescribed format and file size. Ensure all uploads are clear and self-attested.

4. Pay Application Fee: Pay the applicable fee — ₹150/- for APST candidates, ₹200/- for others. PwBD candidates are exempted. Fee payment is through the online mode on the APPSC portal.

5. Submit Application: Read the DISCLAIMER provided in the online application form carefully before final submission. If multiple applications are submitted, the one with the highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted. Ensure the highest RID application is complete in all respects.

6. Govt. Service Applicants: Candidates in Government Service must upload a copy of intimation submitted to their respective Head of Department or an NOC issued by the department along with the application form.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

Reservation

Reservation will be followed as per the Apprentice Act 1961. Candidates claiming reservation must submit the requisite certificate in the prescribed Government format issued by the competent authority. Failure to do so will result in the candidate being treated as General category.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

There will be no written examination or interview. Selection will be entirely based on merit, calculated from the candidates' academic performance.

Graduate Apprentice

  • 10th Class: 20%
  • 12th/Diploma (higher of the two): 20%
  • Engineering/Graduation/PG:60%

  • Diploma in Engineering:70%
  • Total:100

Based on merit, preference will be given in the following order:

  1. Candidates from Project Affected Families of the respective Project/Power Station.
  2. Candidates from the concerned district(s) of the State/UT where the project is located.
  3. Candidates from the State/UT where the project is located.
  4. Candidates from other States/UTs based on merit.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

As per the official advertisement, no application fee has been prescribed for candidates applying for any category of NHPC Apprentice posts 2026.

How to Apply for NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The application process is online only and consists of two steps - first registering on the NAPS/NATS portal, then applying on the NHPC official website.

  1. Register on NAPS/NATS Portal: ITI trade candidates must register on NAPS at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Graduate/Diploma trade candidates must register on NATS at nats.education.gov.in. Complete your profile and upload all required documents.
  2. Note your Registration/Enrolment Number: After completing registration, note your NAPS/NATS enrolment number carefully - it will be required for the NHPC application form.
  3. Apply on NHPC Website: Visit nhpcindia.com → Career Section → Engagement of Apprentice → Apply Now. Fill in all required details including trade, personal information, educational qualifications, category and NAPS/NATS enrolment number.
  4. Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of - NAPS/NATS Registration Form, 10th Marksheet (Age proof), ITI/Diploma/Degree Marksheets, SC/ST/OBC(NCL) Certificate (if applicable), recent passport-size colour photograph, and signature.
  5. Submit & Save: Review all entries carefully and submit the application before 06 May 2026, 5:00 PM. Save/print a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Note: candidates should apply for only one region/state/trade. 

Important: Applications made through any mode other than the NHPC official website will not be accepted. Candidates awaiting final results of qualifying examinations and those who have already undergone apprenticeship training of 1 year or more are not eligible to apply.

Nationality & Cut-off Date

  • Candidate must be a citizen of India.​

  • Educational qualification, age and experience will be reckoned as on 10-04-2026 (closing date).​

Educational Qualification (All Posts)

  • Must have passed Class X / Matric or equivalent from a recognised Board.​

  • For Constable Band (IRBn): 10th pass with knowledge of playing band.​

  • For Constable Bugler (IRBn): 10th pass with knowledge of playing bugle.​

Age Limit

Age limit is determined as on 10-04-2026.​

Post Codes Posts Age Limit
5/26, 6/26, 7/26, 8/26, 9/26 Constable Band, Bugler, IRBn, Civil Police (Male & Female) 18–22 years ​
10/26, 11/26 Fireman, Special Tiger Guard (STPF) 18–32 years ​

Age Relaxation:

  • APST candidates: up to 5 years over the upper age limit.​

  • Ex-Servicemen: allowed to deduct period of service plus up to 3 years, as per rules; detailed formula as in notification.​

  • One-time upper age relaxation is available only for certain candidates of earlier Constable exam (as per Govt notification) for Post Codes 5/26, 6/26, 8/26 and 9/26.​

Physical Standards (PST) – Key Points

Only highlights are given here; candidates should check post-wise tables in the notification for full details.​

  • Constable (IRBn/Civil Police/Fireman – Male):

    • General: Height 165 cm; Chest 79–84 cm.​

    • APST (other than Tirap/Changlang/Longding): Height 160 cm.​

    • APST (Tirap/Changlang/Longding): Height 152 cm.​

    • Ex-Servicemen: Height 157 cm (where applicable).​

  • Constable Civil Police (Female):

    • General: Height 157 cm.​

    • APST: 152 cm.​

  • Special Tiger Guard (STPF):

    • Male (General): 163 cm; APST: 152 cm; chest 79–84 cm.​

    • Female (General): 150 cm; APST: 145 cm; chest 74–79 cm.​

Vision standards: Better eye 6/6 (corrected), worse eye 6/12 (corrected), near vision J1/J2; no colour blindness.​

Application Fees

  • APST candidates: ₹150 (non-refundable).​

  • Unreserved candidates: ₹200 (non-refundable).​

  • Fee to be paid online only; no other mode is accepted.​

Selection Process – Stages

Selection will be done through multiple stages depending on the post.​

For Post Codes 5/26 to 10/26

  • Stage I: Written Examination – Objective Type, 200 marks, 2 hours.​

    • General Awareness – 50 marks

    • General Intelligence & Reasoning Ability – 50 marks

    • Arithmetical & Numerical Ability – 50 marks

    • English Language & Comprehension – 50 marks​

    • Minimum 33% aggregate marks required; no negative marking.​

  • Stage II: Physical Standard Test (PST), Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Trade Test (where applicable).​

    • For Constable Band & Bugler: Trade Test in playing band/bugle.​

    • Candidates shortlisted for Stage II in 1:3 ratio, subject to written exam cut-off.​

    • Ex-Servicemen exempted from PET & Trade Test but must qualify PST.​

  • Stage III: Medical Fitness Test.​

For Post Code 11/26 (Special Tiger Guard)

  • Stage I: Written Examination (same pattern).​

  • Stage II: PST & PET as per standards.​

PST, PET, Trade Test and Medical Fitness Test are qualifying in nature; final merit is based on written exam and preference of posts.​

General Instructions (Key Points)

  • Applications submitted in any mode other than online will be rejected.​

  • Candidates must carefully fill all details; no modification after closing date.​

  • Multiple applications for the same post: only latest application will be considered.​

  • Admit Cards will be available only on www.apssb.nic.in; no individual admit card will be sent.​

  • Candidates must carry the same Photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, DL, PAN or Govt ID) used in application along with admit card to exam centre.​

  • Use of mobile phones, calculators, smart watches and electronic gadgets is strictly prohibited in the exam hall.​

How to Apply Online for APSSB Special Recruitment Drive 2026

Follow the steps below to submit the online application form on the APSSB portal.​

  1. Visit the official website www.apssb.nic.in within the application window (23-03-2026 to 20-04-2026 up to 3 PM).​

  2. Click on the relevant link for “Special Recruitment Drive for Uniformed Services Combined Examination 2026 (Advt 04/26)”.​

  3. Complete the registration using basic details, mobile number and email ID, if required by the portal.​

  4. Login and fill the online application form with personal details, educational qualification, category, and communication details.​

  5. Select your post preferences and Department/Office carefully; once submitted, preference cannot be changed later.​

  6. Upload scanned passport size photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size.​

  7. Pay the application fee online (₹150 for APST, ₹200 for UR) using available payment modes.​

  8. Submit the application form and take a printout of the final submitted form and fee receipt for future reference.​

  9. Download the admit card from the APSSB website when released and keep it safely till the recruitment process is over.​

  • Qualifications (Post 02 – Drishtibaadhit Vidyalay Shilp/Sangeet Teacher):
    • Intermediate with Music as a subject from Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad UP or equivalent diploma in Music.
    • Diploma in Special Education (Visual Impairment) from RCI recognized institution.
    • Knowledge of reading and writing Hindi/English in Braille script.
    • Registration with RCI as a specialist teacher for visually impaired.
  • Qualifications (Post 03 – Sparsh Drishtibaadhit Vidyalay Teacher):
    • Intermediate or equivalent from Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad UP or recognized board.
    • Diploma in Special Education (Visual Impairment) from RCI-recognized institution.
    • Knowledge of reading and writing Hindi/English in Braille script.
    • Registration with RCI as specialist teacher for visually impaired.
  • Qualifications (Post 04 – Shaareerik Roop se Aksham Vidyalay Teacher):
    • Intermediate or equivalent from Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad UP or recognized board.
    • Diploma in Special Education (Loco Motor/Cerebral Palsy) from RCI-recognized institution.
    • Registration with RCI as specialist teacher for loco motor/cerebral palsy.
  • Qualifications (Post 05 – Prayas Vidyalay Teacher):
    • Intermediate or equivalent from Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad UP or recognized board.
    • Diploma in Special Education (Loco Motor/Cerebral Palsy) from RCI-recognized institution.
    • Registration with RCI as specialist teacher for loco motor/cerebral palsy.
  • Qualifications (Post 06 – Mamta Maansik Roop se Avikasit Vidyalay Teacher):
    • Intermediate or equivalent from Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad UP or recognized board.
    • Diploma in Special Education (Intellectual Disability/Mental Retardation) from RCI-recognized institution.
    • Registration with RCI as specialist teacher for mentally underdeveloped.
  • Desirable (All Posts):

    • Obtained 'B' certificate of National Cadet Corps (NCC).

  • Pay Level: Level-6
  • Minimum Pay (Vetanmaan): ₹35,400/- Per Month
  • Maximum Pay (Vetanmaan): ₹1,12,400/- Per Month
  • Grade Pay/Pay Band: JO.T0.SI0 Grade (Posts 01, 02, 03, 05, 06, 07) | H0.T0.SI0 Grade (Post 04)

Age Limit (as on 01-07-2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 Years
  • Maximum Age: 40 Years
  • Age is determined as of the first of July of the calendar year in which vacancies are advertised.

    • OBC candidates: Upper age relaxation as per UP Government rules.
    • State Government employees (serving): 5 years relaxation in upper age limit as per GO No. 2-ई.एम./2001-का-4-2013, dated 27-08-2013.
    • Ex-Servicemen: Age relaxation as per UP Lok Seva (Reservation) Act, 1993 (as amended).
    • Mukhyamantri Adhyetavritti candidates: Relaxation as per UP Shasan Karmic Anubhag-2 Adhisoochna No. 01/2026/06/47-ka-2-2026, dated 30-01-2026.

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 – Written Examination (Main Exam):
    • One question paper containing 100 objective-type, multiple-choice questions.
    • Total duration: 120 Minutes (Two Hours).
    • Each question carries 1 mark. Negative marking: 25% (i.e., ¼ of the mark prescribed for each wrong answer).
    • Exam Plan:
      • Part-1: Introduction to Disability (25 Marks) + Child Development & Learning (20 Marks) + Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (20 Marks)
      • Part-2: Knowledge of Concepts of Computer and IT and Contemporary Technological Development (15 Marks)
      • Part-3: General Information related to the State of Uttar Pradesh (20 Marks)
      • Total: 100 Questions – 100 Marks
    • Shortlisting for Written Exam will be based on normalized score of PET-2025 (15 times the number of advertised posts).
  • Stage 2 – Qualifying Exam (Skill Test):
    • Candidates shortlisted on the basis of written exam marks will appear for Sign Language and Braille Script Proficiency Test (qualifying in nature).
    • For posts where Sign Language/Braille Script knowledge is not required in eligibility criteria, selection will be based on written exam only.
    • Sign Language Proficiency Test:
      • Component 1: Text to Sign Language Conversion – More than 20 functional words; 8 minutes; qualifying: minimum 10 functional words correctly converted.
      • Component 2: Sign Language to Text Conversion – More than 20 functional words; 8 minutes; qualifying: minimum 10 functional words correctly converted.
    • Braille Script Proficiency Test:
      • Component 1: Text to Braille Script Writing – 150–200 Hindi words; 10 minutes; qualifying: minimum 60 words accurately written in Braille.
      • Component 2: Braille Script to Text Writing – 80–100 Hindi words; 10 minutes; qualifying: minimum 40 words read and written accurately.

How to Apply

  • Application must be submitted ONLY through the Online Application System on the Commission's website upsssc.gov.in. Applications submitted through any other means will not be accepted.
  • Visit the Homepage of upsssc.gov.in and click on the relevant advertisement under the Live Advertisement Segment to download/view the notification.
  • Candidates must login using their PET-2025 Registration Number along with the OTP sent to their registered mobile number/email.
  • After login, personal details pre-filled from PET-2025 registration will be displayed. Candidates must verify and select the posts they wish to apply for.
  • Select the post(s), fill in qualification details (Board/University name, pass year, certificate/roll number, issue date, marks details), and proceed.
  • Photo and signature uploaded during PET-2025 will be auto-displayed. No changes can be made to these.
  • Fill in post preference and additional qualification details in the "Other Details" section.
  • Enter the Verification Code displayed on the Registration Page and click the "Submit" button.
  • Pay the prescribed fee using Credit Card / Debit Card / Internet Banking / UPI / SBI e-Challan before the last date (27-04-2026).
  • After successful fee payment/reconciliation, the application form will be auto-submitted and displayed on screen. Candidates must download and print the application form.
  • Application correction is permitted up to 04-05-2026 for fields like correspondence address, EWS/OBC category, gender, disability category, and marital status.
  • Only one application per candidate. If multiple applications are submitted, only the last submitted application will be considered valid.

  • The IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted through an online Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective type, followed by a Typing/Skill Test for certain posts, and a final merit list based on CBT performance.
  • For Supervisor posts (S-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes consisting of General Arithmetic (25 marks), Logical Reasoning (20 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (105 marks).
  • For Jr. Office Assistant, Jr. Bullion Assistant & Jr. Hindi Typist (B-3 Level): A CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Awareness (30), Computer Knowledge (30), English Language Skills (30), Numerical Aptitude (30), and Reasoning Aptitude (30), followed by a Typing Test (English @ 40 w.p.m. or Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.). Final merit is based on CBT performance only.
  • For Jr. Technician posts (W-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 120 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Arithmetic (20 marks), Logical Reasoning (15 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (85 marks).
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS category – 55%; OBC – 50%; SC/ST – 45%. There is no negative marking.

AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Adhoc Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

For Senior Residents (Non-Academic):

AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Adhoc Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Stage 1 – Application & Reporting:

  • Interested candidates must report for the walk-in interview at LT Ground, Medical College Building, AIIMS Raebareli, by 10:00 AM on the scheduled date with duly filled application/bio-data and all required documents.

Stage 2 – Document Verification & Screening:

  • Document verification and screening of applications will be conducted from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM on the day of interview.

  • All original certificates/documents will be verified; candidates must also submit self-attested photocopies of each document.

Stage 3 – Written Test (if required) & Interview:

  • The primary mode of selection is interview; the list of selected candidates will be uploaded on the Institute website.

  • If the number of applied candidates is large, a written examination based on MCQs in the concerned subject may be conducted, followed by interview for shortlisted candidates.

  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending document verification or interview.

The decision of the Competent Authority regarding selection will be final and binding, and no representation will be entertained.

How to Apply for AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Adhoc Recruitment 2026

Step 1 – Visit the official website aiimsrbl.edu.in and download the prescribed application/bio-data form (Annexure A) from the recruitment section.

Step 2 – Fill in all required personal, educational, registration, and professional details in the application form carefully, as per instructions.

Step 3 – Attach self-attested copies of all requisite documents in support of eligibility (MBBS/MD/MS/DNB/DM/MCh degrees, mark sheets, experience certificates, registration certificate, category certificate, etc.).

Step 4 – Bring the duly filled application form/bio-data along with one set of self-attested copies and all original documents on the date of walk-in interview at the reporting venue.

Step 5 – Report at LT Ground, Medical College Building, AIIMS Raebareli, by 10:00 AM on the scheduled date for document verification and screening.

Step 6 – Appear before the Selection Committee for interview from 03:00 PM onwards, after successful document verification and shortlisting.

  • MBBS/BDS/MSc degree certificate and mark sheets, as applicable.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Main Written Examination followed by Physical Standards Test and Physical Efficiency Test (qualifying in nature).

      • Part-1 (85 Marks): History of India & Indian National Movement, Geography of India & World, Economic & Social Development of India, Indian Polity & Constitution, General Science & Technology, Environmental Ecology & Disaster Management, Current Events of National & International Importance, Data Interpretation, Important Legal Provisions & Policies related to Excise in Uttar Pradesh.

  • Physical Standards Test (Qualifying):
    • Male: Height 167.6 cm, Chest 80 cm (unexpanded) / 85 cm (expanded).
    • Female: Height 152 cm (General), 147 cm (SC/ST), Weight 45 kg.
  • Physical Efficiency Test (Qualifying):
    • Male: 4.8 km run in 25 minutes.

UPSSSC AGTA Selection Process 2026

The UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026 selection process comprises shortlisting on the basis of UPSSSC PET 2025 scores, a mains written examination and document verification. Only PET 2025 qualified candidates will be allowed to appear in the UPSSSC AGTA mains exam.

Stage 1 – Shortlisting through UPSSSC PET 2025

  • Candidates must have a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 scorecard to apply for the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C mains examination.
  • UPSSSC will prepare a list of eligible candidates for AGTA mains based on PET 2025 scores, reservation rules and post‑wise vacancy distribution.
  • Only shortlisted candidates, as per the criteria given in the official notification, will be permitted to fill the UPSSSC AGTA mains online form and appear for the written exam.

Stage 2 – UPSSSC AGTA Mains Written Examination 2026

  • The mains written exam for UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant Group C will be an objective type paper covering agriculture and related subjects as per the prescribed syllabus.
  • The question paper will carry a fixed number of questions and marks (details like total marks, duration and negative marking will be as per the official AGTA notification).
  • Candidates must secure the minimum qualifying marks and rank high in the merit list to be considered for the next stage of the selection process.

Stage 3 – Document Verification

  • Candidates shortlisted on the basis of performance in the AGTA mains written exam will be called for document verification (DV).
  • During DV, candidates must produce original documents and certificates related to age, educational qualification, category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), domicile, PET 2025 score, and other eligibility criteria.
  • Failure to produce valid documents or any discrepancy in information can lead to cancellation of candidature for UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026.

The final selection list for UPSSSC AGTA Recruitment 2026 will be prepared purely on the basis of marks obtained in the mains written examination, subject to successful document verification and fulfilment of all eligibility conditions.

How to Apply for UPSSSC AGTA / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026

The application process for UPSSSC Agriculture Technical Assistant (AGTA) / Technical Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026 is completely online. Only candidates who have a valid UPSSSC PET 2025 registration and score can fill the UPSSSC AGTA online form 2026 on the official website upsssc.gov.in.

  • Step 1: Visit the official website of Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission at upsssc.gov.in.
  • Step 2: On the home page, click on the “Notifications/Advertisements” section and open the link for Advt. No. 06-Exam/2026 – Technical Assistant Group C (AGTA) Recruitment 2026.
  • Step 3: Read the UPSSSC AGTA Notification 2026 carefully, then click on the “Apply” or “Candidate Registration” link given against the advertisement.
  • Step 4: Log in using your UPSSSC PET 2025 Registration Number, date of birth and other required details; the system will fetch your basic data from the PET database.
  • Step 5: Fill the UPSSSC AGTA online application form 2026 with category, educational qualification, agriculture degree details, reservation information and other required fields.
  • Step 6: Upload your recent passport size photograph and signature in the prescribed format and size as mentioned in the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C notification.
  • Step 7: Pay the UPSSSC AGTA application fee of ₹25 (for all categories) using the available online payment options such as net banking, debit/credit card, SBI I‑Collect or e‑challan.
  • Step 8: Review all the details entered in the UPSSSC Technical Assistant Group C application form carefully, then submit the form and take a printout of the final submitted application and fee receipt for future reference.

Candidates should complete the UPSSSC AGTA Online Form 2026 well before the last date to avoid last minute technical issues and ensure successful submission.

The Online Written Examination will consist of 5 objective tests for a total of 200 marks and a duration of 145 minutes. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. Each question has 5 answer choices.

Sr. No. Name of Test Questions Marks Duration
1 Reasoning 40 40 35 Minutes
2 English Language 40 40 35 Minutes
3 General Awareness (with special reference to Banking) 40 40 20 Minutes
4 Computer Knowledge 40 40 20 Minutes
5 Quantitative Aptitude 40 40 35 Minutes
  Total 200 200 145 Minutes

Penalty: 0.25 marks deducted for each wrong answer. Cutoffs are applied at two stages: on individual test scores and on total score.

Exam Centres:

Sr. No. Centre
1 Haldwani (Distt. Nainital)
2 Dehradun (Distt. Dehradun)

Choice of centre once exercised will be final. No request for change of centre/venue/date will be entertained.

KNSB Assistant Grade-II Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Stage 1 – Online Written Examination: Candidates who qualify the Online Written Test will be considered for selection. Selection will be purely on merit basis based on marks obtained in the Online Written Test, conducted through IBPS.

Stage 2 – Medical Fitness: Appointment letters will be issued on merit basis subject to candidates being found medically fit for the assignment.

The Bank reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason. No correspondence in this regard will be entertained.

How to Apply for KNSB Assistant Grade-II Recruitment 2026

Step 1 – Before applying, scan and keep ready your Photograph (4.5 cm × 3.5 cm, 20–50 KB), Signature (black ink on white paper, 10–20 KB), Left Thumb Impression (black/blue ink on white paper, 20–50 KB), and a Handwritten Declaration (black ink on white paper, 50–100 KB) in JPG/JPEG format.

Step 2 – Visit the bank's official website at kurmanchalbank.bank.in, click on "KNSB CARES" → "CAREER" → "APPLY NOW".

Step 3 – Click on "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note down the Provisional Registration Number and Password received on your email/SMS.

Step 4 – Fill in all required personal, educational, and other details in the online application form carefully. Use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress.

Step 5 – Upload Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per the prescribed specifications.

Step 6 – Preview the complete application form. Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" only after verifying all details. No changes will be allowed after this.

Step 7 – Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the application fee of Rs. 1,000/- online. Wait for confirmation — do not press Back or Refresh to avoid double charge. Take a printout of the e-Receipt.

Step 8 – Download and take a printout of the system-generated online application form for future reference.

Step 9 – Download Call Letter from kurmanchalbank.bank.in when notified via email/SMS before the examination.

DBT Note: An additional Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) amount of ₹4,000/month for Diploma Apprentices and ₹4,500/month for Graduate Apprentices is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme. The above stipend figures are inclusive of DBT wherever applicable. Candidates must have an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

Reservation

Reservation will be followed as per the Apprentice Act 1961. Candidates claiming reservation must submit the requisite certificate in the prescribed Government format issued by the competent authority. Failure to do so will result in the candidate being treated as General category.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

There will be no written examination or interview. Selection will be entirely based on merit, calculated from the candidates' academic performance.

Graduate Apprentice

  • 10th Class: 20%
  • 12th/Diploma (higher of the two): 20%
  • Engineering/Graduation/PG:60%
  • Total:100

Diploma Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • Diploma in Engineering:70%
  • Total:100

ITI Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • ITI in Concerned Trade:70%
  • Total: 100

Preference in Selection

Based on merit, preference will be given in the following order:

  1. Candidates from Project Affected Families of the respective Project/Power Station.
  2. Candidates from the concerned district(s) of the State/UT where the project is located.
  3. Candidates from the State/UT where the project is located.
  4. Candidates from other States/UTs based on merit.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

As per the official advertisement, no application fee has been prescribed for candidates applying for any category of NHPC Apprentice posts 2026.

How to Apply for NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The application process is online only and consists of two steps - first registering on the NAPS/NATS portal, then applying on the NHPC official website.

  1. Register on NAPS/NATS Portal: ITI trade candidates must register on NAPS at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Graduate/Diploma trade candidates must register on NATS at nats.education.gov.in. Complete your profile and upload all required documents.
  2. Note your Registration/Enrolment Number: After completing registration, note your NAPS/NATS enrolment number carefully - it will be required for the NHPC application form.
  3. Apply on NHPC Website: Visit nhpcindia.com → Career Section → Engagement of Apprentice → Apply Now. Fill in all required details including trade, personal information, educational qualifications, category and NAPS/NATS enrolment number.
  4. Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of - NAPS/NATS Registration Form, 10th Marksheet (Age proof), ITI/Diploma/Degree Marksheets, SC/ST/OBC(NCL) Certificate (if applicable), recent passport-size colour photograph, and signature.
  5. Submit & Save: Review all entries carefully and submit the application before 06 May 2026, 5:00 PM. Save/print a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Note: candidates should apply for only one region/state/trade. 

Important: Applications made through any mode other than the NHPC official website will not be accepted. Candidates awaiting final results of qualifying examinations and those who have already undergone apprenticeship training of 1 year or more are not eligible to apply.
