Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Test (CBT) only.

  • The CBT will comprise of objective type questions with multiple choice of answers. The Question Paper and instructions will be Bilingual (English/Hindi). However, in case of any error in Hindi version, the English version of the question shall be valid & final.
  • The CBT will consist of two sections (Section – ‘A’ & Section – ‘B’):
    • Section – ‘A’: Questions related to Technical Knowledge (Discipline related) with 80 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ).
    • Section – ‘B’: Questions related to General Awareness/Aptitude and Knowledge of CIL/SECL with 20 multiple choice questions (MCQ).
  • Each question will carry 1 mark and there is no penalty for wrong answer. No marks will be awarded for un-attempted questions.
  • Syllabus for the Computer Based Test (CBT) is attached as Annexure-A in the notification.
  • Selection of candidates in merit panel will be subject to securing of cut-off marks (Minimum Qualifying marks) in the Computer Based Test for concerned post with respect to their category as mentioned below and fulfilling prescribed eligibility criteria:
Category Qualifying marks in CBT
For General/EWS Candidates 45 marks
For OBC(NCL)/ESM Candidates 40 marks
For SC/ST Candidates 35 marks
  • Result of the Computer Based Test (CBT) will be published on SECL website as early as possible after successful completion of the CBT.
  • Provisional merit panels of candidates who secure the requisite cut-off marks and above and fulfilling the eligibility criteria will be published, in the order of marks scored, after resolving tie.
  • In case of tie of marks between 02 or more candidates, the merit-list will be prepared as per the following criteria: a) Date of Birth (As per the descending order of age of candidates) b) Seniority as per the Date of issue of Statutory Certificate c) In case still tied up, alphabetical order of the name of the candidates as recorded in the application form may be taken into consideration. d) In case still tied-up, the Selection Committee will decide the criteria for deciding the merit position of tied candidates.
  • Final merit panel will be prepared based on the marks obtained in the Computer Based Test.
  • Such candidates who would score equal or above the cut off (Minimum qualifying marks as provided in Table D) and as per vacancy available in each category, would only be notified for appearing for scrutiny/ verification of their testimonials supporting their claim of candidature, in order of their respective merit position drawn on the basis of marks scored in Computer Based Test (CBT) for different positions up to the extent the positions remain unfilled. The candidates shall have to appear along with all original certificates/ documents as per eligibility criteria notified in this Employment Notification for scrutiny/ verification. The date, time and venue for scrutiny/ verification shall be notified on SECL website and the candidates shall have to report accordingly. In the event of failure to report with all original certificates and testimonials within the stipulated time, the candidature of such candidate should stand cancelled.
  • Provisional Appointment Letter will be issued to the successful candidates in accordance with their relative merit position and with due consideration of the reservation of posts to the reserved category candidates and against vacancies.
  • If it is found during the Scrutiny/ Verification, or during the course of training, or even during the course of employment, that the candidate is not fulfilling the eligibility criteria in any respect, suppressing of facts or false declaration pertaining to his Employment/Caste/ Testimonials etc. then his/her candidature/ employment will be cancelled/terminated.

Note: In case, a candidate, selected for a particular post & declared as UNFIT during Initial Medical Examination, the case would be referred to Apex Medical Board of the Company within one month based on the written/physical representation and the decision of the Apex Medical Board will be final. If the Candidate is declared UNFIT by the Apex Medical Board, his/ her selection shall stand automatically cancelled. Such candidates will be communicated the decision of the Apex Medical Board as well as regarding cancellation of their selection.

2. How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through SECL website. No other mode (post, email, offline) will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official website of SECL https://secl-cil.in/ → Career → Employment Notification for Direct Recruitment of various Statutory posts → Apply online.
  2. Employment Notification is available in both English and Hindi. Candidates may select either of them at their convenience.
  3. While applying online, candidate needs to upload the scanned copies of:
    • Recent passport size colour photograph (not older than 3 weeks in jpg/jpeg format)
    • Signature with Black ink pen (in jpg/jpeg format)
    • Matriculation certificate or equivalent examination certificate or Degree or Diploma Certificate for the post of Mining Sirdar & Dy. Surveyor (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Matriculate or equivalent examination passed from any recognized Board of examination & Diploma or relevant and higher qualification (Minimum 3 years course) in Electrical Engineering from any Institute recognized by the Government, for the post of Assistant Foreman (Electrical) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Valid Caste Certificate OBC (NCL)/SC/ST candidates and Income Certificate for EWS Candidates (if applicable) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Ex-Servicemen Certificates (if applicable) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • PwBD Certificates (if applicable) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Competency certificate of Mining Sirdar/Surveyor (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
    • Gas Testing & First Aid Certificate (for Mining Sirdar only) (in jpg/jpeg/PDF format)
  4. Register by filling up necessary details (Post opted, name, Mobile No. and e-mail ID and click on Submit Button).
  5. Check the User ID and password received on your e-mail and mobile number after successful registration.
  6. Re-login to your account entering the User ID and Password received on Mobile No. and e-mail ID.
  7. Click on the option to go to application form and fill all the necessary details in the respective fields and upload all the required documents including Photograph and Signature.
  8. Check Preview of the Application Form and make corrections, if any.
  9. Press Submit Button and make Online Payment of the fees through Debit Card/Credit Card/Net Banking (as applicable).
  10. Keep the print out of the online application form filled for future references.

Application Fee:

Category Amount (₹)
Unreserved (UR) /OBC- (Creamy Layer & Non-Creamy Layer) / EWS ₹1000/- + GST ₹180/- = ₹1180/-
SC/ ST/ESM/PwBD/ Departmental Candidates/Female Candidates Nil

Note: Applications without the prescribed fee will not be entertained and summarily rejected. No representation against such rejection would be entertained. Fee once paid shall neither be refunded nor be adjusted under any circumstances. Any tax or Bank charges other than the application fees will be borne by the candidates. Application fee will be paid through online mode only.

General Instructions

  • Application should be submitted through ONLINE Mode only.
  • All qualifications should be recognized by AICTE / UGC / appropriate Indian Statutory Authorities.
  • Before submitting the application, the candidate must ensure that he/ she fulfills all the eligibility criteria and other norms mentioned in the Employment Notification. He/ she may cross check the information such as Date of Birth, Category, Contact Details, and Qualifications etc. furnished in the application form before finally submitting the same online as no correction would be possible later and no correspondence will be considered in this regard.
  • The decision of SECL management regarding eligibility criteria, acceptance or rejection of applications, penalty for false information, mode of selection, selection and posting of selected candidates, will be final and binding on the candidates and no enquiry/correspondence will be entertained in this regard.
  • Mere issuance of Admit Card/ Call Letter to a candidate will not imply that his/ her candidature has been finally cleared by SECL. The candidature shall remain provisional till such time SECL verifies the eligibility conditions with reference to original documents after the candidate qualifies in the CBT and confirms appointment.
  • Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post for which they have applied. In case it is found at any stage of the selection process or even after the appointment that the candidate has submitted false or incorrect information or suppressed any relevant information/ material facts or does not fulfill the eligibility criteria, his/her candidature/ service is liable for rejection/ termination without notice.
  • No relaxation in the minimum educational qualification, as prescribed in Clause - '2' of this Employment Notification, is admissible for any category of candidate.
  • Wherever Grade (CGPA/ OGP/ DGPA etc.) is awarded, a certificate duly issued by concerned Board/University for conversion of Grade to percentage is to be produced by the candidate at the time of Scrutiny/ Verification of Original documents.
  • Age and all other eligibility criteria shall be reckoned as on the cut-off date as prescribed under this Employment Notification.
  • Candidates should carefully fill up their category (General/ SC/ ST/ OBC- Non Creamy Layer/ Ex-Servicemen/ EWS/PwBD etc.) in the Online Application Form. No change of category shall be allowed at the later stage of selection process.
  • Ex-servicemen must produce discharge certificate issued by Army/Navy/ Air Force of Indian Union at the time of document verification.
  • All documents (Caste Certificate, Educational Qualifications, EWS certificate, etc.) as per applicability and as provided by the candidate will be verified from the office of issuing authority and candidature will be cancelled if the certificates are not found satisfactory/ genuine at any subsequent stage of Computer Based Test (CBT).
  • The candidates must have an active E-mail Id & Mobile number which must remain valid for at least next one year. All correspondences with the candidates shall be done either through Speed Post/ Registered e-mail id & Mobile number (as may be necessary) and all general information shall be provided through SECL website. However, admit card will be provided only through SECL website and the candidates will have to download the admit card. The responsibilities of receiving, downloading and printing of application form, admit card and other information shall be of candidates. SECL will not be responsible for any loss of document due to invalid/ wrong/ incomplete contact details provided by the candidate or for delay/ non-receipt of information. In case of any problems faced by the candidates in filling up the online application they may refer the "Help Desk Option" available in the individual login portal. For queries other than the Online Application Form, candidates may write to Email Id: [email protected] only or can call us on 9425598240.
  • Candidates are advised to apply much before the closing date for submission of Online Application mentioned in this Employment Notification to avoid last minute network congestion.
  • SECL will not take any responsibility for the candidates not being able to submit their applications Online within the prescribed closing dates on account of any reasons beyond the control of SECL.
  • SECL reserves the right to shortlist candidates for Computer Based Test, reschedule the test date & venue etc. or alter any of the advertised condition depending upon the circumstances.
  • SECL will not bear any liability on account of service bond/ salary/ leave salary/ pension contribution, etc, if any, of previous employment of any candidate already working in Central Govt./ State Govt./ Autonomous Body/ Public Sector Undertaking.
  • Candidates employed in Govt./ Semi Govt./ Public Sector Undertaking (including departmental candidates) / Autonomous Bodies are required to produce 'No Objection Certificate' at the time of Scrutiny /Verification of original documents if shortlisted.
  • Selected candidates could be posted in any of the Mines/Establishments of SECL and are liable to be transferred to other subsidiaries of Coal India Limited any time during their service as may be required.
  • Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to being found medically fit in the Company's Medical Examination as per the laid down Rules related to Medical Examination of CIL.
  • Selection of candidate shall be provisional, subject to verification of documents relating to eligibility criteria, character, antecedents and other documents submitted by the candidate and is also subject to his/ her meeting other requirements applicable for appointment under the rules of SECL.
  • Appointment of the candidate in SECL will be subject to verification of Character & Antecedents by the prescribed authorities and if any discrepancy / suppression is found, the candidature of the candidate will be cancelled and decision of SECL in this regard shall be final.
  • The date of Computer Based Test (CBT) and other details will be subsequently informed. Candidates will have to appear at the Centre/ Venue allotted to them by SECL for the Computer Based Test (CBT). No change in Centre/ Venue is permissible and no application shall be entertained in this regard.
  • SC/ ST candidates called for Computer Based Test (CBT) will be paid up to IInd Class Non-AC fare as per rules. However they have to submit their claims in duly filled appropriate TA Claim format provided at the examination centre along with all desired enclosures like caste certificate, photocopy of Onward (mandatory) and return Journey (optional) of railway ticket / bus receipt ticket to the room invigilator after attempting Computer Based Test (CBT) only, subsequent claims as well as claims with incomplete information will not be entertained. The distance of examination centre will be calculated from the Permanent address of the candidate or from place of actual journey whichever is shorter. In case, candidate has submitted only onward journey ticket and not submitted return journey tickets then the claims will be considered up to the double of onward journey fare and that will be paid as per rule.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the CBT, scrutiny/ verification of certificates and documents or for joining on being selected except otherwise as provided in this Employment Notification.
  • Candidate will appear for the CBT at the exam center at his/her owns risk and South Eastern Coalfields Limited will not be responsible for any injury or losses etc.
  • SECL management reserves the right to modify/ alter/ restrict/ enlarge/ cancel the recruitment process, and revise the number of vacancies, at its discretion without assigning any reasons whatsoever. The decision of the SECL management will be final and no appeal will be entertained in this regard.
  • All future communication/ information regarding this recruitment will be made available on SECL website. Candidates are advised to check/ visit SECL website regularly for further updates.
  • Court of Jurisdiction for any dispute will be Honorable High Court of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur.
  • In case of any ambiguity/ confusion, English Version of Employment Notification will be considered valid.
  • Canvassing in any form will be treated as dis-qualification.
  • At the time of Computer Based Test (CBT), if a candidate is found guilty of using unfair means or impersonating or misbehaving in the examination hall or resorting to any other unfair means in connection with his/her candidature for the selection; or obtaining support of his/ her candidature by any means, such candidates will be liable to criminal prosecution and will be disqualified from the Computer Based Test (CBT). The Company may also debar such candidates from participating in any selection process in the Company in future.
  • If it is detected that any candidate has furnished any false information / particulars with regard to his/ her qualification, Category/caste and experience in the Application Form or in any document and/ or misrepresented / suppressed any material fact in the application form, for securing appointment, his/ her service will be terminated forthwith during probation period or even after confirmation of the service.
  • The Candidates whose postings are finalized after CBT, Verification and IME will be disqualified if they put external pressure for place of posting.

CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Age Limit: Minimum 18 years; Maximum 65 years as on the date of notification (26 March 2026). Engagement shall not continue beyond 65 years of age.

Educational Qualification (Subject-wise):

PGT (Physics): Two years integrated PG M.Sc course of Regional College of Education of NCERT in Physics/Electronics/Applied Physics/Nuclear Physics; OR Master's Degree with at least 50% marks in Physics/Electronics/Applied Physics/Nuclear Physics from a recognised university; AND B.Ed. or equivalent from a recognised university; Proficiency in teaching medium. Desirable: Computer Application knowledge.

PGT (Chemistry): Two years integrated PG M.Sc course of NCERT in Chemistry/Bio-Chemistry; OR Master's Degree with at least 50% marks in Chemistry/Bio-Chemistry; AND B.Ed. or equivalent; Proficiency in teaching medium. Desirable: Computer Application knowledge.

PGT (Biology): Two years integrated PG M.Sc course of NCERT in Botany/Zoology/Life Sciences/Bio Sciences/Genetics/Micro Biology/Bio Technology/Molecular Bio/Plant Physiology (with Botany and Zoology at Graduation level); OR Master's Degree with at least 50% in relevant subjects; AND B.Ed. or equivalent; Proficiency in teaching medium. Desirable: Computer Application knowledge.

PGT (Mathematics): Two years integrated PG M.Sc course of NCERT in Mathematics/Applied Mathematics; OR Master's Degree with at least 50% in Mathematics/Applied Mathematics; AND B.Ed. or equivalent; Proficiency in teaching medium. Desirable: Computer Application knowledge.

PGT (Hindi): Two years integrated PG MA course of NCERT in Hindi or Sanskrit with Hindi at Graduate Level; OR Master's Degree with at least 50% in Hindi or Sanskrit with Hindi at Graduate level; AND B.Ed. or equivalent; Proficiency in teaching medium. Desirable: Computer Application knowledge.

PGT (Bengali): Two years integrated PG MA course of NCERT in Bengali; OR Master's Degree with at least 50% in Bengali; AND B.Ed. or equivalent; Proficiency in teaching medium. Desirable: Computer Application knowledge.

PGT (History/Geography/Political Science/Economics): Two years integrated PG MA course of NCERT in the relevant subject; OR Master's Degree with at least 50% in the relevant subject; AND B.Ed. or equivalent; Proficiency in teaching medium. Desirable: Computer Application knowledge.

PGT (Commerce): Two years integrated PG MA course of NCERT in Master's Degree in Commerce; OR Master's Degree with at least 50% in Commerce (Note: M.Com in Applied/Business Economics holders are not eligible); AND B.Ed. or equivalent; Proficiency in teaching medium. Desirable: Computer Application knowledge.

PGT (Computer): At least 50% marks in any of: B.E./B.Tech (CS/IT) plus PG Diploma in Computer Applications or B/C Level Diploma from DOEACC with 1 year teaching experience; OR M.Sc. (Computer Science)/MCA plus 1 year teaching experience; OR Master of Engineering/M.Tech (Computer Science/IT).

TGT (Arts/Language-English): Graduation in English and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education; OR at least 50% in Graduation or Post-Graduation in English and B.Ed.; OR Graduation in English with 45% marks and 1-year B.Ed. as per NCTE norms; OR Senior Secondary with 50% and 4-year B.El.Ed.; OR Senior Secondary with 50% and 4-year B.A./B.Sc.Ed. or B.A.Ed./B.Sc.Ed.; OR Graduation in English with 50% and 1-year B.Ed. (Special Education); OR Post-Graduation in English with 55% marks and three-year integrated B.Ed.-M.Ed.; AND competence to teach through the required medium.

TGT (Arts/Language-Bengali): Same pattern as TGT English above but in Bengali subject.

TGT (SST): Graduation in History, Geography, Political Science, Economics and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education; OR at least 50% in Graduation/Post-Graduation in the relevant subjects and B.Ed.; OR with 45% marks and 1-year B.Ed. as per NCTE norms; OR other equivalent combinations as per RBE norms; AND competence to teach through the required medium.

TGT (Phy. Chem. Bio): Graduation in Physics, Chemistry, Biology and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education; OR at least 50% in Graduation/Post-Graduation in the relevant subjects and B.Ed.; OR other equivalent combinations as per RBE norms; AND competence to teach through the required medium.

TGT (Phy. Chem. Maths): Graduation in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education; OR at least 50% in Graduation/Post-Graduation in the relevant subjects and B.Ed.; OR other equivalent combinations as per RBE norms; AND competence to teach through the required medium.

TGT (Hindi): Graduation in Hindi and 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education; OR at least 50% in Graduation or Post-Graduation in Hindi and B.Ed.; OR other equivalent combinations as per RBE norms; AND competence to teach through the required medium.

Physical Instructor: Graduate with Bachelor's in Physical Education (B.P.Ed.) or equivalent; AND competency in imparting Physical Education in English/Hindi medium.

CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026 Remuneration

Selected candidates under CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026 will receive the following consolidated monthly remuneration on a contractual and part-time basis. No additional allowances, benefits, or facilities shall be admissible.

Post Monthly Remuneration
Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) – All Subjects Rs.27,500/- per month
Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) – All Subjects Rs.26,250/- per month
Physical Instructor Rs.26,250/- per month

Payment will be made on a monthly basis. No payment will be made during school vacations. Pro-rata payment will apply for broken months and periods of less than one month (Consolidated Pay × Number of days worked / 30 days).

CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

As per the CLW Chittaranjan Teacher Recruitment 2026 advertisement, no application fee has been prescribed for candidates appearing in the Walk-in-Interview.

CLW GDCE 2026 - Eligibility Criteria

Who Can Apply

  • The applicant must be a regular employee of Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW), including Dankuni Locomotive Works (DLW), HWII Stores Office, and Inspection Cells at Mumbai, Bengaluru, New Delhi, and any other unit under the administrative control of CLW.
  • The applicant must be working substantively in a grade below the notified grade to which he/she wishes to apply. For JE (Works), staff must be working up to and including Pay Level-5. For JE (P-Way) - a safety post - staff working regularly up to and including Pay Level-6 are eligible (Ref. para 19 of Master Circular 69/2024).
  • RPF/RPSF staff are NOT eligible to apply against GDCE vacancies.

Age Limit 

UR OBC SC ST
42 years 45 years 47 years 47 years

Educational Qualification

Post 7th CPC Level Prescribed Qualification
Junior Engineer (P-Way) 6 Three-year Diploma in Civil Engineering, or B.Sc. in Civil Engineering (3 years), or a combination of any sub-stream of basic streams of Civil Engineering from a recognised University/Institute.
Junior Engineer (Works) 6 Three-year Diploma in Civil Engineering, or B.Sc. in Civil Engineering (3 years), or a combination of any sub-stream of basic streams of Civil Engineering from a recognised University/Institute.
Depot Material Superintendent (DMS) 6 Three-year Diploma in any Engineering Discipline (including B.Sc. in Civil Engg. of 3 years), or combination of any sub-stream of basic streams of Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering from a recognised University/Institute.
Post Graduate Teachers (PGT) 8 Masters Degree from a recognised University with at least 50% marks in aggregate in the relevant subject, OR 2-year integrated PG course from a Regional College of Education of NCERT in the relevant subject AND B.Ed from a recognised University.

Since GDCE is conducted against DRQ (Direct Recruitment Quota) vacancies, the educational qualification required is the same as for direct recruitment conducted by RRBs.

CLW GDCE 2026 - Application Fee

Application Fee: NIL - No application fee is required for any category of candidates.

CLW GDCE 2026 - Scheme of Examination 

There shall be a single stage CBT (Computer Based Test) / TBT (Tablet Based Test) for all the notified posts. The exam is tentatively scheduled for May or June 2026. Exact dates will be notified in due course.

For JE (Works), JE (P-Way) & DMS

150 MCQ | 1 mark each | Negative marking: 1/3 per wrong answer
Duration: 120 minutes
Syllabus: General Awareness, Physics, Chemistry, Basics of Computers, Basics of Environment & Pollution Control, and Technical (discipline-specific) abilities (100 questions)

For School Teachers (PGT)

100 MCQ | 1 mark each | Negative marking: 1/3 per wrong answer
Duration: 90 minutes (120 minutes for PwBD with Scribe)
Syllabus: General Awareness, General Intelligence & Reasoning, Mathematics, General Science, and Professional Ability (50 questions)

For Teachers: After the written exam, shortlisted candidates will appear for a second stage Teaching Skill Test of 100 marks, evaluated by a nominated committee on communication skill, presentation skill, and problem-solving ability. Written test and Teaching Skill Test will have a weightage ratio of 85:15 for the final merit list. There is no Supplementary Test for absent candidates.

Detailed Syllabus 

Civil Engineering (JE / DMS Exam Group)

  • Engineering Mechanics, Building Construction, Building Materials, Construction of Sub/Superstructure, Building Finishes & Maintenance, Building Drawing, Concrete Technology, Surveying, Computer Aided Design (AutoCAD), Geo-Technical Engineering, Hydraulics, Irrigation Engineering, Mechanics of Structures, Theory of Structures, Design of Concrete Structures, Design of Steel Structures, Transportation Engineering (Railway Engineering), Highway Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Advanced Construction Techniques, Estimating & Costing, Contracts & Accounts.

Electrical & Allied Engineering (DMS Exam Group)

  • Basic Concepts, Circuit Law, Magnetic Circuits, AC Fundamentals, Measurement Instruments, Electrical Machines (DC/Transformers/Induction Motors), Synchronous Machines, Generation, Transmission & Distribution, Estimation & Costing, Utilisation of Electrical Energy, Basic Electronics.

Electronics & Allied Engineering (DMS Exam Group)

  • Electronic Components & Materials, Electronic Devices & Circuits, Digital Electronics, Linear Integrated Circuits, Microprocessor & Microcontroller, Electronic Measurements, Communication Engineering, Data Communication & Networks, Computer Programming (C/C++), Basic Electrical Engineering.

Mechanical & Allied Engineering (DMS Exam Group)

  • Engineering Mechanics, Material Science, Strength of Materials, Machining, Welding, Grinding & Finishing, Metrology, Fluid Mechanics & Hydraulic Machinery, Industrial Management, Thermal Engineering.

PGT Written Examination Syllabus

  • Mathematics: Number Systems, BODMAS, LCM/HCF, Ratio & Proportions, Percentage, Mensuration, Time & Work, Simple & Compound Interest, Algebra, Geometry, Trigonometry, Statistics, Pipes & Cistern.
  • General Intelligence & Reasoning: Analogies, Series, Coding-Decoding, Venn Diagram, Data Interpretation, Analytical Reasoning, Directions, Statement-Arguments etc.
  • General Awareness: Current Affairs, Indian Geography, Culture, History, Indian Polity & Constitution, Indian Economy, Environment, Sports, Science & Technology.
  • General Science: Physics, Chemistry and Life Sciences (up to Class 10 CBSE syllabus).
  • Professional Ability (50 questions): Education (22-28 Q) - Philosophy, Sociology, Human Values, Democracy, Integration; Psychology of Learner & Teaching (13-18 Q); Curriculum and Instruction (8-12 Q).

How to Apply for CLW GDCE 2026

This is an offline application process meant exclusively for regular CLW employees. There is no online application portal.

1. Download Application Format: Obtain the application form in Annexure-C format as enclosed with this notification (GDCE 01/2026 dated 10.04.2026). Affix one recent self-attested photograph in the space provided.

2. Fill the Application Form: Enter all details accurately - Name (in capitals), Date of Birth, Age as on 09.04.2026, Designation & Ticket No., HRMS ID & Employee No., Date of initial appointment & grade, Educational Qualification, Date of appointment to present grade, Post(s) applied for, Community (UR/SC/ST/OBC), PwBD status, Mobile number, and Email address.

3. Get Controlling Authority Signature: The completed application must be forwarded by the controlling authority - obtain the signature of the controlling supervisor with designation, and the counter signature of the controlling officer with office seal. The Establishment Officer must also certify the particulars from the Service Book.

4. Attach Required Documents: Enclose self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates, category certificate (SC/ST/OBC), PwBD certificate (if applicable), and any other relevant documents.

5. Drop Application in Drop Box: Submit the filled and forwarded application by dropping it in the Drop Box at the Recruitment Section, Personnel Department, Administrative Building, Chittaranjan - 713331 by 08 May 2026 (17:30 hrs). No application will be accepted after the deadline under any circumstances.

Date of ECIL Advt. 07/2026 notification 26 March 2026

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Project Engineer on Contract (PE‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in relevant disciplines such as Electronics, ECE, ETC, EEE, E&I, CSE, IT, CSIT, Mechanical/Electrical with NDT Level‑II (for Kudankulam) along with a minimum of 3 years post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship in the relevant field up to 1 year is also counted as experience.
  • Technical Officer on Contract (TO‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in Electronics/Electrical/ECE/ETC/EEE/E&I/CSE/IT and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship up to 1 year is countable towards experience.
  • Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C): Diploma with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in ECE/ETC/Electronics/EEE/Instrumentation and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience including relevant apprenticeship.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Salary 2026

  • Selected candidates under ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 will receive consolidated monthly emoluments based on the post and contract year, along with limited benefits as per ECIL rules.
  • Consolidated Emoluments: Project Engineer on Contract – Rs. 40,000 (1st year), Rs. 45,000 (2nd year), Rs. 50,000 (3rd year), Rs. 55,000 (4th year) plus a one‑time attire allowance of Rs. 8,400 after completion of at least six months; Technical Officer on Contract – Rs. 25,000 (1st year), Rs. 28,000 (2nd year), Rs. 31,000 (3rd & 4th years); Assistant Project Engineer – Rs. 25,506 per month; Senior Artisan – Rs. 23,368 per month, with APE‑C and SA‑C wages revised every six months as per CLC (Central) guidelines.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • The ECIL Advt. No. 07/2026 walk‑in notification does not prescribe any separate application fee for appearing in the selection process for these contract posts.
  • Fee Status: Candidates are required to download the application form and attend the walk‑in with documents; there is no mention of any application or examination fee in the advertisement, so applicants should not pay any money to unauthorized persons or intermediaries and rely only on official ECIL instructions.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Form

There is no online application process for ECIL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 07/2026); candidates have to attend walk‑in selections as per the notified schedule. Eligible applicants must visit the official ECIL website ecil.co.in, download the prescribed ECIL contract application form 2026, fill it carefully and report at the concerned zonal walk‑in venue on the respective date within the registration time slot.

Candidates must carry the duly filled ECIL application form, updated resume, original certificates and one set of self‑attested photocopies for age, qualification, experience, category, disability, ex‑servicemen and identity proof along with recent passport size photographs. Registration and document verification will be done at the venue before the personal interview under ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026.

Click to Download ECIL Contract Application Form 2026

Download ECIL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF (Advt. No. 07/2026)

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 selection for Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan will be based on walk‑in registration, document verification and personal interview with a weighted merit system.
  • Shortlisting & Evaluation: After on‑spot registration and successful verification of original documents, candidates will be evaluated on three components – (A) Qualification: 20% of aggregate percentage scored in BE/B.Tech/Diploma/ITI; (B) Relevant Experience: up to 30 marks based on post‑qualification experience as per post‑specific rules; and (C) Personal Interview: 50 marks.
  • Final Merit & Offer: Final recommendations will be prepared in order of merit based on total score (A+B+C). Experience from purely academic internships, college projects etc. is not counted. Selected candidates will be engaged on fixed‑tenure contract and must be willing to work anywhere in India as per ECIL’s project requirements.

How to Apply / Attend ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria for ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 07/2026) must appear personally at the designated zonal venues on the scheduled walk‑in dates with the prescribed application form and documents.

  • Step 1 – Download ECIL Application Form: Visit the official ECIL website www.ecil.co.in, open the Careers/Recruitment section and download the application form for Advt. No. 07/2026. Take a printout and fill it neatly with all required details including post category, zone and location preference.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Documents: Keep ready original and one set of self‑attested copies of 10th certificate (DOB proof), all qualification certificates and marksheets, CGPA‑to‑percentage conversion (if applicable), complete experience certificates with from‑to dates and post held, appointment order and recent payslips (if currently employed), caste (EWS/OBC/SC/ST) certificate, non‑creamy layer OBC certificate (not older than one year), PwBD certificate, Ex‑servicemen/ J&K domicile proof and valid government ID (Aadhaar/Passport etc.).
  • Step 3 – Reach Walk‑in Venue in Time: Report to the respective ECIL Zonal Office (Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru on 20 April 2026; Chennai on 20 April 2026) within the registration time 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs. Late reporting after 11:30 hrs will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Step 4 – Registration & Document Verification: Submit the filled ECIL application form 2026, resume and document set at the registration desk. After successful verification, candidates will be allowed to attend the personal interview as part of the selection process.
  • Step 5 – Attend Interview & Wait for Result: Appear for the interview as scheduled at the venue. Final selection will be based on the combined weightage of qualification, experience and interview performance. Shortlisted candidates will receive joining instructions from ECIL and must be prepared for posting at project locations anywhere in India.

NFC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The selection process varies by post code:

  • Post Codes 12601, 12603, 12604 – Interview Based: Selection on the basis of Personal Interview. If response is more, NFC may conduct a Screening Test (75 MCQs, 90 minutes, +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect) to restrict candidates called for interview.
  • Post Codes 12602, 12605, 12606 – Three Stage Process:
    • Stage 1 – Preliminary Test (1 hour, OMR-based): 50 MCQs – Mathematics (20), Science (20), General Awareness (10). +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect. Cut-off: 40% (General), 30% (Reserved categories).
    • Stage 2 – Advanced Test (2 hours): 50 MCQs from relevant discipline. +3 for correct / –1 for incorrect. Cut-off: 30% (General), 20% (Reserved). Merit list prepared based on Stage 2 marks only. Both stages conducted in a single session as Section A & B.
    • Stage 3 – Skill Test (Go/No-Go basis): Up to 5 times the number of vacancies shortlisted from Stage 2. Candidates clearing Skill Test empanelled in order of Stage 2 merit.

How to Apply for NFC Recruitment 2026

  3. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications for each post.
  4. Keep the following documents ready in PDF format for uploading:

  5. Pay the application fee (if applicable) through BharatKosh/NTRP before initiating the online application.

  • Candidates must regularly check https://www.nfc.gov.in for all updates; no information will be sent by post/courier.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the Courts having jurisdiction in Hyderabad only.
  • Beware of fraudulent recruitment advertisements forging NFC/DAE name/logo; NFC does not ask for any payment other than the prescribed application fee.

Selection will be made through shortlisting of applications followed by Interview (or Online Examination + Interview, if conducted by the Bank).

Educational Qualification (All Three Posts – RG/08/26, RG/09/26, RG/10/26): Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering/Technology/Computer Science/Degree in Engineering in Computer Applications/Information Technology/Electronics/Electronics & Telecommunications/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Instrumentation; OR Post Graduate Degree in Electronics/Electronics & Tele Communication/Electronics & Communication/Electronics & Instrumentation/Computer Science/Information Technology/Computer Applications. The degree must be recognised by AICTE/UGC or the concerned regulatory body in India.

UR/EWS category candidates (and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts) must have First Class degree with minimum 60% marks. Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD) applying against reserved posts must have at least 50% marks.

Minimum Experience: Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience in one or more areas mentioned in the Job Description of the respective post.

Job Description – Assistant Manager (IT/Network & Security) – RG/08/26: Review and assess HA firewall configuration and policies; evaluate security posture of core network services (DHCP, DNS, VPN); TCP/IP, Ethernet, iSCSI, Fiber Channel Protocol; EDR solution planning and implementation; DPDP Act compliance; cybersecurity improvements; incident analysis and risk mitigation; Wi-Fi and LAN network setup for 100–250 nodes; DLP/EDR/XDR use case creation; Video Conferencing with Central MCU management; SDWAN setup; Firewall Configuration and Network Management.

Job Description – Assistant Manager (IT/Programming) – RG/09/26: Object-Oriented Programming; Software development and system workflow as per SDLC; Relational Database; SAP S/4 HANA, FIORI, ABAP; Problem-solving techniques in the above domains.

Job Description – Assistant Manager (IT/Data Centre) – RG/10/26: Installing, configuring, tuning, and monitoring Windows Server and Linux servers; IIS, DNS, DHCP, Hyper-V configuration; Windows-based scripting for task automation; Remote server administration; VMware vSphere (ESXi and vCenter) and Hyper-V; SAN, backup and storage; batch scripts; infrastructure capacity and performance analysis; regular system maintenance, hardware/software upgrades, physical to virtual migrations; VMware ESXi and Hyper-V virtual machine management; enterprise backup software; hardware and software troubleshooting; rack cabling (power, Cat-6, fiber); power, space, and cooling management; monitoring of network devices, precision air-conditioners, UPS, and Building Management System (BMS) in Data Centre.

Age Limit: Maximum 32 years as on the last date of submission of application (27.04.2026). Age relaxation: SC/ST – 5 years; OBC-NCL – 3 years; Ex-Servicemen – years of service rendered + 3 years; J&K Domicile – 5 years; PwBD – 10 years (in addition to SC/ST/OBC-NCL relaxation as applicable); RITES regular/contract employees – 5 years over and above the upper age limit.

Note: Training period (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship, and PhD research experience shall not be counted as part of experience.

The pay will be fixed at the minimum of the scale. Candidates from Government Departments/PSUs are eligible for protection of Basic Pay in accordance with company policy. RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The RITES Limited Assistant Manager (IT) Recruitment 2026 selection will be conducted in three stages:

Stage 1 – Written Test (60% Weightage): There will be 125 objective type questions carrying 1 mark each for a duration of 2.5 hours. There is no negative marking. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for UR/EWS (45% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts). PwBD candidates are eligible for compensatory time of 50 minutes. The written test will be conducted at 6 cities across India: Delhi/Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Mumbai, Bhubaneswar, and Guwahati (all centres except Delhi/Gurgaon are tentative). Candidates must give two centre preferences at the time of online application.

Stage 2 – Document Scrutiny: Based on written test results, documents submitted by shortlisted candidates will be scrutinized by RITES Limited. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview preceded by verification of original documents.

Stage 3 – Interview (40% Weightage): Candidates will be called for interview in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies. Weightage: Technical & Professional Proficiency – 30 marks; Personality, Communication & Competency – 10 marks. Minimum qualifying marks in interview: 60% for UR/EWS (50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts). There are no minimum qualifying marks required in the aggregate. Appointment of selected candidates will be subject to medical fitness examination as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness.

Written Test Syllabus Summary:

RG/08/26 (IT/Network & Security): Computer Networking Fundamentals; Network Infrastructure Configuration and Management; Network Security and Cybersecurity Practices; Cybersecurity Compliance, Governance and Regulatory Requirements (including DPDP Act); Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery and Incident Management; Collaboration Infrastructure and Enterprise Systems; Basic Computer Science and Engineering concepts.

RG/09/26 (IT/Programming): Programming Fundamentals and OOP Concepts; Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC); Relational Database Management Systems (SQL, ACID properties); Problem Solving and Logical Programming; SAP S/4HANA, ABAP and FIORI; Basic Computer Science and Engineering concepts.

RG/10/26 (IT/Data Centre): Server Installation, Configuration and Administration; Windows Server Services and Automation; Virtualization Technologies (VMware vSphere, Hyper-V); Storage, Backup and Disaster Recovery; Infrastructure Monitoring, Maintenance and Performance Management; Data Centre Infrastructure and Hardware Management; Data Centre Facility Systems Monitoring (BMS, UPS, precision AC); Basic Computer Science and Engineering concepts.

Step 4 – Pay Application Fee: Pay the applicable application fee online under the "Make Payment" section. After successful payment, download and print the final application form and retain it for future reference.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Application Process

  • The nomination/application process for DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is through offline/hard copy mode only via the proper channel. Eligible officers must get their nominations forwarded by their concerned CCAs (Chief Controllers of Accounts) along with NOC and all required documents.
  • Applications/Documents received through e-Office of concerned CCAs will be accepted only where the same are duly received in hard copy. Applications/Documents received only through email will not be accepted.
  • The nominations of eligible officers along with required documents, duly attested in Hard Copy, must reach by post or special messenger to:
  • Joint Director (CCA), DGPM Hqrs., 5th Floor, Drum Shaped Building, I.P. Estate, New Delhi – 110002 on or before 12th May 2026 (by 5:00 PM).

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is a deputation-based recruitment. Selection will be based on the eligibility criteria as per Recruitment Rules of Additional Assistant Director dated 31.03.2022 of DGPM.
  • The selected officers may be posted to any of the Directorates/Stations throughout India. Applicants may give the option of 05 Directorates in Annexure B(i) and 03 Stations in Annexure B(ii) in order of their preference. However, the options exercised do not guarantee posting at the said Directorate/Station.

How to Apply for DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Project Engineer on Contract (PE‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in relevant disciplines such as Electronics, ECE, ETC, EEE, E&I, CSE, IT, CSIT, Mechanical/Electrical with NDT Level‑II (for Kudankulam) along with a minimum of 3 years post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship in the relevant field up to 1 year is also counted as experience.
  • Technical Officer on Contract (TO‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in Electronics/Electrical/ECE/ETC/EEE/E&I/CSE/IT and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship up to 1 year is countable towards experience.
  • Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C): Diploma with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in ECE/ETC/Electronics/EEE/Instrumentation and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience including relevant apprenticeship.
  • Senior Artisan on Contract (SA‑C): ITI passed in Electronics, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Instrumentation or Radio & TV trades with minimum 2 years post‑qualification experience (including up to 1 year apprenticeship) in maintenance/repair of electronics, instrumentation systems, communication gadgets or computers.
  • Age Limit (UR): Project Engineer – maximum 33 years; Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan – maximum 30 years. Age relaxation is 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, an additional 10 years for PwBD (40% and above) over category relaxation, and 5 years for candidates domiciled in J&K from 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Salary 2026

  • Selected candidates under ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 will receive consolidated monthly emoluments based on the post and contract year, along with limited benefits as per ECIL rules.
  • Consolidated Emoluments: Project Engineer on Contract – Rs. 40,000 (1st year), Rs. 45,000 (2nd year), Rs. 50,000 (3rd year), Rs. 55,000 (4th year) plus a one‑time attire allowance of Rs. 8,400 after completion of at least six months; Technical Officer on Contract – Rs. 25,000 (1st year), Rs. 28,000 (2nd year), Rs. 31,000 (3rd & 4th years); Assistant Project Engineer – Rs. 25,506 per month; Senior Artisan – Rs. 23,368 per month, with APE‑C and SA‑C wages revised every six months as per CLC (Central) guidelines.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • The ECIL Advt. No. 07/2026 walk‑in notification does not prescribe any separate application fee for appearing in the selection process for these contract posts.
  • Fee Status: Candidates are required to download the application form and attend the walk‑in with documents; there is no mention of any application or examination fee in the advertisement, so applicants should not pay any money to unauthorized persons or intermediaries and rely only on official ECIL instructions.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Form

There is no online application process for ECIL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 07/2026); candidates have to attend walk‑in selections as per the notified schedule. Eligible applicants must visit the official ECIL website ecil.co.in, download the prescribed ECIL contract application form 2026, fill it carefully and report at the concerned zonal walk‑in venue on the respective date within the registration time slot.

Candidates must carry the duly filled ECIL application form, updated resume, original certificates and one set of self‑attested photocopies for age, qualification, experience, category, disability, ex‑servicemen and identity proof along with recent passport size photographs. Registration and document verification will be done at the venue before the personal interview under ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026.

Click to Download ECIL Contract Application Form 2026

Download ECIL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF (Advt. No. 07/2026)

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 selection for Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan will be based on walk‑in registration, document verification and personal interview with a weighted merit system.
  • Shortlisting & Evaluation: After on‑spot registration and successful verification of original documents, candidates will be evaluated on three components – (A) Qualification: 20% of aggregate percentage scored in BE/B.Tech/Diploma/ITI; (B) Relevant Experience: up to 30 marks based on post‑qualification experience as per post‑specific rules; and (C) Personal Interview: 50 marks.
  • Final Merit & Offer: Final recommendations will be prepared in order of merit based on total score (A+B+C). Experience from purely academic internships, college projects etc. is not counted. Selected candidates will be engaged on fixed‑tenure contract and must be willing to work anywhere in India as per ECIL’s project requirements.

How to Apply / Attend ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria for ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 07/2026) must appear personally at the designated zonal venues on the scheduled walk‑in dates with the prescribed application form and documents.

  • Step 1 – Download ECIL Application Form: Visit the official ECIL website www.ecil.co.in, open the Careers/Recruitment section and download the application form for Advt. No. 07/2026. Take a printout and fill it neatly with all required details including post category, zone and location preference.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Documents: Keep ready original and one set of self‑attested copies of 10th certificate (DOB proof), all qualification certificates and marksheets, CGPA‑to‑percentage conversion (if applicable), complete experience certificates with from‑to dates and post held, appointment order and recent payslips (if currently employed), caste (EWS/OBC/SC/ST) certificate, non‑creamy layer OBC certificate (not older than one year), PwBD certificate, Ex‑servicemen/ J&K domicile proof and valid government ID (Aadhaar/Passport etc.).
  • Step 3 – Reach Walk‑in Venue in Time: Report to the respective ECIL Zonal Office (Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru on 20 April 2026; Chennai on 20 April 2026) within the registration time 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs. Late reporting after 11:30 hrs will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Step 4 – Registration & Document Verification: Submit the filled ECIL application form 2026, resume and document set at the registration desk. After successful verification, candidates will be allowed to attend the personal interview as part of the selection process.
  • Step 5 – Attend Interview & Wait for Result: Appear for the interview as scheduled at the venue. Final selection will be based on the combined weightage of qualification, experience and interview performance. Shortlisted candidates will receive joining instructions from ECIL and must be prepared for posting at project locations anywhere in India.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Objective Type Test, Power Point Presentation and Personal Interview.

  • The marks shall be assigned to the following parameters for the final selection:
    • Objective Type Test – 50 marks
    • Personal Interview – 20 marks
    • Power Point presentation for assessing work experience – 30 marks Total – 100 marks
  • The Objective Type Test shall be of 60 Minutes duration comprising of 50 Multiple Choice Questions in the areas of General knowledge (10 marks) and Subject Based (40 marks). Each question carries one mark and there will be no negative marks.
  • Mark lists for the post shall be prepared on the basis of marks secured by candidates in the Objective type test.
  • The minimum pass marks for Objective type test shall be as below:
    • For unreserved post – 50% of Total Marks
    • For SC/ST Candidates – 40% of Total Marks (only for vacancies reserved for SC/ST)
    • For PwBD candidates – 40% of Total Marks
    • For OBC Candidates – 45% of Total Marks (only for vacancies reserved for OBC)
  • Candidates who score minimum prescribed pass marks and above in the Objective test shall be short listed for Power Point Presentation and Personal Interview subject to verification of eligibility requirements (age, educational qualification, reservation and experience etc.).
  • Only those candidates who successfully complete the certificate verification shall be shortlisted to attend the Power Point Presentation and Personal Interview.
  • The Power Point Presentation and Personal Interview shall be held at Udupi Cochin Shipyard Limited (UCSL), Malpe/Kochi or through electronic media or any other location as decided by UCSL.
  • Rank list for the post shall be prepared based on the aggregate marks secured by the candidates in the Objective type test, Experience and Personal Interview. In case same marks secured by more than one candidate, marks scored in the Subject part of the Objective Type Test shall be the basis of determining the order of rank list. In case of a tie thereafter, relative merit shall be decided based on seniority in age.
  • Depending upon the number of online applications received, UCSL reserves the right to scrutinise applications and prepare shortlist of candidates based on meeting eligibility requirements ascertained through the certificates uploaded by the applicants in the online application portal and only such shortlisted candidates may be permitted to attend the selection process.

Application Mode: Online only through UCSL / CSL website. No other mode (post, email, offline) will be accepted.

  2. Go through the User Manual and FAQ published in the link before filling the online application.
  3. The application consists of two phases – One time Registration and submission of application against the post.
  4. Applicants meeting the notified requirements may do the one-time Registration in the SAP Online portal and submit their application.
  5. Upload scanned copies of all certificates towards proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste, disability etc. and a recent passport size colour photograph.
  6. Pay the application fee (if applicable) using online payment options (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking).
  7. Submit the application and ensure that the application status shows “In process” in “My Applications”.
  8. After successful submission, retain a soft copy / printout of the online application containing the unique registration number generated by the system for future reference.
  9. Applicants should not submit more than one application. Application once submitted shall be final.

Application Fee: ₹400/- (Non-refundable + bank charges extra) for UR / OBC / EWS candidates. Exempted for SC / ST / PwBD candidates.

  • Period of contract is maximum five years (temporary in nature) subject to project requirements and individual performance. Posting at UCSL-Kochi / Malpe / project sites anywhere in India or abroad.
  • Experience acquired after passing the prescribed qualification and reckoned as on 22-04-2026 only will be considered. All types of training / Apprenticeship with remuneration shall be treated as experience.
  • Only Indian Nationals need to apply. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree - MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch or equivalent - in the relevant department, recognised by the Medical Council of India/NMC/NBE. For Clinical Haematology seats, candidates with MD in General Medicine or MD in Paediatrics will also be considered.

Age Limit

The upper age limit is 45 years as on the date of walk-in interview (cut-off date). Age relaxation is applicable as follows:

Category Age Relaxation
SC / ST 5 years
OBC 3 years
PwBD 10 years
Ex-Servicemen 5 years

SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates applying for unreserved vacancies will not be eligible for age relaxation. Reserve category candidates eligible only by age relaxation will be considered solely for reserved seats of their category.

Reservation

Reservation for EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST candidates is as per Central Government rules. 4% horizontal reservation is applicable for PwBD candidates. OBC-NCL certificate must be valid for Central Government posts and not older than 1 year from the date of interview. EWS certificate must similarly not be older than 1 year.

AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Pay Scale

Rs. 67,700/- as per 7th CPC, Level–11 of the Pay Matrix + NPA + usual allowances as admissible.

AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Application Fee

Category Fee Amount
General / OBC Rs. 1,500/-
SC / ST / EWS Rs. 1,200/-
Ex-servicemen / Women / PwBD Exempted (Nil)

The fee must be paid via Demand Draft only, drawn in favour of AIIMS, Patna, payable at AIIMS, Patna. Cash, cheque, UPI, money orders, postal orders, or any other mode of payment will not be accepted and such applications will be summarily rejected. The application fee is non-refundable.

AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Selection to the posts of Senior Resident (Non-Academic) will be entirely through a Walk-in Interview. There is no written examination.

  • Eligibility will be verified on the day of the walk-in interview through original documents.
  • Qualification and experience will be counted as on the date of interview.
  • In case of a tie (same marks), the older candidate (earlier date of birth) will be ranked higher.
  • The final result will be displayed on the institute website: www.aiimspatna.edu.in. No individual intimation will be sent.
  • Selected candidates must join within the stipulated date mentioned in the offer of appointment.
  • Selection is subject to medical fitness as declared by the Medical Board appointed by the Institute.

How to Apply for AIIMS Patna Senior Resident Recruitment 2026

There is no online application process. Eligible candidates must appear directly at the walk-in interview venue on their respective department's date.

1. Collect documents: Gather originals and one set of self-attested copies of - Aadhaar Card, Date of Birth proof (SSC/HSSC certificate), MBBS Degree Certificate, MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch Degree or Provisional Certificate, UG & PG NMC/State Registration Certificate, Category/PwBD Certificate (if applicable), Experience Certificate (if any), NOC from present employer (for Govt./Pvt. employees), and any research/publication documents.

2. Arrange Demand Draft: Obtain a DD for the applicable fee amount drawn in favour of AIIMS, Patna, payable at AIIMS, Patna. (Exempted for Ex-servicemen, Women, and PwBD candidates.)

3. Carry a passport-size photograph: Bring a recent colour photograph against a light/white background. Caps, hats, and dark glasses are not acceptable. Religious headwear is allowed if the face is clearly visible.

4. Report on your department's interview date: Arrive by 09:00 AM at the E-classroom, Administrative Building, AIIMS Patna. The interview begins from 10:00 AM onwards at the Committee Room, Administrative Building, AIIMS Patna.

5. Fill the application form on the day: Complete the application form at the venue with correct personal, educational, and category details. All signatures must be in full (not abbreviated) and consistent across all documents. Once submitted, no changes can be made.

Selection Process

There will be no interviews.

The eligible candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of merit list formed on the basis of marks secured in Matriculation examination (10th), 12th and ITI Course / Diploma and Bachelor of Engineering or MBA as per following details:

Apprentices Weightage Total marks
Graduate Apprentice 20% to 10th 20% to 12th / Diploma (whichever is higher, in case of both) 60% to aggregate in Engineering/MBA 100
Diploma Apprentice 30% to 10th 70% to Diploma in Engineering 100
ITI Apprentice 30% to 10th 70% to ITI 100

In case of a tie in total marks between two candidates, the one older in age will be considered senior for further selection process.

The candidates shortlisted on the basis of the information provided in the Application Form shall have to produce all original testimonials/certificates at the time of verification. In case any information/claim made by the applicant in his/her application is found to be false, the candidature of such applicant shall be cancelled and he/she shall be liable for prosecution.

Also, the candidate will have to produce a certificate of medical fitness before joining.

The selection and deployment of Apprentice Trainees will be subject to detailed provisions of Apprenticeship Act. The contracts with candidates thus selected will be registered under Board of Apprentice Training (BOAT)/ National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) Portal.

How to Apply

Eligible and interested candidates would be required to apply online only through the Career section on SJVN’s website: www.sjvn.nic.in. No other means/mode of application shall be accepted.

Before registering their applications on the website, the candidates should possess the following:

a) Valid e-mail ID and mobile number, which should remain valid for at least one year.

b) Personal details and educational qualification details and a Debit card/ Credit card/ Internet banking detail via which the payment of application fee of Rs. 100/- (SC/ST/PwD exempted) is to be made on e-recruitment portal. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstance.

c) Candidates should have scanned copy of latest passport size photograph, as well as photograph of signatures in digital format (.jpg or .jpeg file only, less than 500 KB size) for uploading with the application form.

d) Candidates should clearly note that SJVN, in any case, will not be responsible for rejection of application on account of application being incomplete, non-submission of application or payment or any delay in receipt thereof on any account whatsoever.

General Instructions

  • Age Limit: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum will be 30 Years as on closing date. Concession & Relaxation: a) Upper age is relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates. b) Candidates belonging to PwD categories shall be given age relaxation up to 10 years (up to 15 years for SC/ST and up to 13 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates.
  • Stipend: i. Graduate Apprentices: ₹10,000/- Per Month ii. Diploma Apprentices: ₹8,000/- Per Month iii. ITI Apprentices: ₹7,000/- Per Month.
  • Training duration: One Year.
  • Reservation: Reservation of seats for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) and PWDs will be as per the provisions of the Apprenticeship Act, 1961 and its amendments thereafter.
  • Preference to PAF/PAA: 25% seats are earmarked for candidates from Project Affected Families (PAF) and Project Affected Areas (PAA) of STPL with first preference to members of Project Affected Families. However, the candidates will have to produce a certificate in this regard issued from the Competent Authority/Revenue Department/ Panchayat and duly verified by concerned SJVN offices.
  • Only Candidates who are domicile of Bihar State are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates should apply for only one trade / discipline for which he/ she is most desirous, based on his/her qualification. In case of multiple applications from a candidate, the latest one shall be considered as final and older application shall be rejected.
  • Candidates should be eligible with respect to age criteria and educational qualification as on closing date of advertisement. Result awaited candidates need not apply. Candidates who have undergone apprenticeship training in SJVN/ STPL need not apply.
  • Employment in SJVN/ STPL: No extension of training and employment will be given after the completion of one-year training by SJVN/ STPL.
  • Candidates will have to make their own stay and transportation arrangements.
  • The candidates who after the completion of their education have undergone training or job experience of one year or more shall not be considered eligible for apprenticeship training. Even if the gap between the declaration of result and the commencement of training is more than five years, the candidate will be declared not eligible.
  • All correspondence with the registered candidates regarding issuance of call letter/offer of apprenticeship training etc. shall be done through their registered email and/or mobile phones only. The candidates are required to keep their registered email and mobile phone active for at least one year from the date of registration.
  • All information regarding lists of candidates shortlisted for further selection process & list of candidates finally selected shall be made available on website of SJVN www.sjvn.nic.in. Candidates can download relevant lists etc. from the site. Call letters shall be emailed to candidates at their registered email IDs. No separate call letters shall be sent to the candidates by post. SJVN will not be responsible for any loss of e-mail/ SMS sent due to invalid or wrong email ID/mobile phone no. or delivery of emails to spam/bulk mail folder.
  • The sole responsibility of downloading or uploading of documents on SJVN website / SJVN portal and downloading / printing of call letters shall be that of the candidate.
  • Any corrigendum/addendum etc. or updates with regard to this advertisement shall be made available on our website www.sjvn.nic.in. Candidates are thus advised to periodically visit our website as all further correspondence and latest information shall be available only on our website.
  • The decision of Management will be final & binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the applications, mode of selection, cancellation of the selection process either in part or full, higher qualification etc. No correspondence will be entertained in this regard. Filling up of the seats is solely at the discretion of management based on suitability of candidates and no claim will arise for engagement, if some of these seats are not filled due to unsuitability / insufficient number of candidates.

How to Apply for CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online only through the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website. Follow the steps given below to submit your application form.

Visit Official Website

  • Go to the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website: csc.gov.in.

  • On the homepage, navigate to the Recruitment/Careers/Latest Opening section.

Open Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Application Link

  • Find and click on the notification/link titled “CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Recruitment 2026” or similar.

  • Click on the Apply Online button to proceed to the application page.

Registration (New Users)

  • Click on New Registration (if applying for the first time).

  • Enter basic details such as Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Date of Birth, and create a password.

  • Submit the details to generate your Registration ID and Password (note these for future login).

Login and Fill Application Form

  • Login using your Registration ID and Password.

  • Fill in the online application form carefully with personal details, contact details, educational qualification, Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator certificate details, and preferred state/district.

  • Ensure that all details match your certificates and Aadhaar data.

Upload Documents

  • Upload scanned copies of the following documents in the prescribed format and size (as mentioned in the notification):

    • Recent passport size photograph

    • Signature

    • 10th/12th/ITI/Polytechnic Diploma certificates and mark sheets

    • Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor Certificate issued by UIDAI‑authorized Testing & Certifying Agency

    • Any other documents required as per notification

  • Preview the uploaded documents and confirm that they are clear and readable.

Application Fee Payment (If Applicable)

  • Check the Application Fee section in the official notification.

  • If any fee is prescribed, pay it online through available modes such as Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.

  • After successful payment, download/print the fee receipt.

Final Submission

  • Carefully review all the details filled in the application form in the Preview section.

  • If required, make corrections before final submission.

  • Click on Final Submit to complete the application process.

Print Application Form

  • After successful submission, download and take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

  • Keep the Registration ID, Password, and printout safe for further recruitment stages.

Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Selection Process 2026

The Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026 selection process consists of multiple stages such as shortlisting, online assessment, psychometric evaluation, and personal interview. These stages are designed to select the most suitable candidates for wealth management roles.

Shortlisting & Application Scrutiny:

In the initial stage, applications will be scrutinised based on eligibility criteria, educational qualifications, relevant work experience, domain expertise, and other parameters decided by the bank. Only candidates shortlisted as per the bank’s internal norms will be called for further stages. Mere fulfilment of eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting for the Bank of Baroda WMS selection process.

Online Test & Psychometric Assessment:

The selection process may include an online test followed by a psychometric assessment or other suitable evaluations. These tests are conducted to assess the candidate’s personality, communication skills, problem-solving ability, efficiency, innovation, and willingness to work anywhere in India. The bank reserves the right to conduct or waive the online test and/or psychometric test depending on recruitment requirements.

Personal Interview (PI):

Candidates shortlisted from earlier stages will be invited for a Personal Interview. During the interview, candidates will be evaluated on domain knowledge, relationship management skills, leadership qualities (especially for higher roles), communication skills, and overall suitability for wealth management positions. Candidates must secure a minimum of 60% marks (55% for reserved categories) or as decided by the bank.

Final Merit & Provisional Selection:

The final merit list will be prepared based on the candidate’s performance in the online test (if conducted), psychometric test, and personal interview, as per the weightage decided by the bank. Only those candidates who qualify in all stages and rank high in the merit list, subject to vacancy and category norms, will be provisionally selected. The decision of the bank in all matters related to selection will be final and binding.

How to Apply for Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026

Interested and eligible candidates must apply online through the official website of Bank of Baroda within the specified dates. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Step 1 – Visit Official Website:

Visit the official website and navigate to the “Careers → Current Opportunities” section. Then click on the link for Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/08).

Step 2 – Read Detailed Notification:

Download and carefully read the official notification PDF to understand vacancy details, eligibility criteria, age limit, experience requirements, selection process, application fee, and instructions.

Step 3 – Online Registration:

Click on “Apply Online” and complete the registration by entering basic details such as name, mobile number, and email ID. Generate your registration ID and password. Ensure your contact details remain active throughout the recruitment process.

Step 4 – Fill Online Application Form:

Log in using your credentials and fill out the application form with accurate personal, educational, and professional details. Verify all information carefully before final submission, as no corrections will be allowed afterward.

Step 5 – Upload Photograph, Signature & Documents:

Upload a recent passport-size photograph, signature, and required documents such as educational certificates, experience letters, and category certificates in the prescribed format and size.

Step 6 – Pay Application Fee Online:

Pay the application fee through available online modes such as debit card, credit card, net banking, or UPI. After successful payment, download the e-receipt and application form.

Step 7 – Final Submission & Print:

Submit the application form and take a printout of the final submitted form and fee receipt for future reference, especially for interview and document verification.

General Instructions for Bank of Baroda WMS Recruitment 2026

Applicants for Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026 must adhere to all general instructions issued by the bank to ensure smooth processing of their applications and avoid disqualification at any stage.

Single Valid Application: Candidates should submit only one valid online application for a post; in case of multiple applications, only the latest complete application will be considered and all fees paid for previous registrations will stand forfeited. Multiple appearances for a single post in the selection process will lead to cancellation of candidature.

Accuracy of Information: All information furnished in the Bank of Baroda WMS online application form 2026 must be true, complete and correct. If any discrepancy, false information, or suppression of material facts is found at any stage (before or after appointment), the candidate’s candidature will be cancelled and, if already engaged, services may be terminated without notice.

Document Verification & Category Proof: Candidates must produce original documents (age proof, educational certificates, experience proofs, category certificates for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD, NOC from employer, etc.) along with self‑attested photocopies at the time of interview or whenever called by the bank. No change of category will be permitted after online registration, and results will be processed based on the category declared in the application.

Email & Communication: All communication regarding Bank of Baroda Wealth Management Services Recruitment 2026 including call letters, schedule of tests/interviews, and any updates will be sent to the registered email ID and/or published on the Bank of Baroda website. The bank will not be responsible for non‑receipt of email due to incorrect email ID, spam filtering or technical issues.

Eligibility & Disqualification: Candidates are responsible for ensuring that they meet the eligibility criteria regarding nationality, age, qualification, experience and credit history. Applications from candidates with unsatisfactory credit reports, pending or adverse disciplinary/criminal records, or those not meeting the criteria at any stage are liable to be rejected and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.

Jurisdiction & Bank’s Decision: Any dispute related to BOB WMS Recruitment 2026 will fall under the jurisdiction of courts/tribunals in Mumbai only.
