Selection Process

Selection will be made through three stages:

  • Preliminary Examination (Screening Test – Objective Type):
    • Paper-1: General Studies – 200 marks (3 hours)
    • Paper-2: Accountancy and Auditing – 200 marks (3 hours)
    • Total: 400 marks
    • Minimum qualifying marks will be decided by the Commission.
    • Marks of Preliminary Exam will not be counted for final selection.
    • In case of multiple shifts, normalization of scores will be applied.
    • Candidates approximately 15 times the number of vacancies will be called for the Main Examination.
  • Main Written Examination (Conventional Type):
    • Paper-1: Gujarati Language – 150 marks (3 hours)
    • Paper-2: English Language – 150 marks (3 hours)
    • Paper-3: General Studies – 200 marks (3 hours)
    • Paper-4: Accountancy and Auditing-I – 200 marks (3 hours)
    • Paper-5: Accountancy and Auditing-II – 200 marks (3 hours)
    • Total: 900 marks
  • Viva Voce (Interview): 100 marks

Final Selection:

  • Merit will be prepared on the basis of Main Written Examination (900 marks) + Viva Voce (100 marks) = 1000 marks.
  • Preliminary Exam is only a screening test.
  • Waiting list / panel will be prepared as per rules.
  • Appointment is on probation for 2 years.
  • Selected candidates can be posted anywhere in Gujarat.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through GPSC-OJAS portal. No other mode will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit https://gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
  2. Click on “Online Application” → “Apply”.
  3. If already registered, login with One Time Registration (OTR) number; otherwise complete One Time Registration.
  4. Fill all mandatory fields: Personal Details, Communication Details, Other Details, Language Details.
  5. Upload recent passport-size Photograph and Signature in JPG format (as per specifications).
  6. Review the application form.
  7. Pay the required fee online (if applicable).
  8. Submit the application and take a printout / note the Application Number & Confirmation Number for future reference.
  9. A candidate can submit only one application for this post.

General Instructions

  • Cut-off date for determining eligibility (age, qualification, etc.) is the last date of online application i.e. 21-04-2026.
  • Only Gujarat domicile candidates are eligible for reservation benefits.
  • Category once filled cannot be changed later.
  • Candidates must possess the basic knowledge of computer application and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both.
  • All future communications will be sent through registered email / SMS and uploaded on the official website.
  • Mere submission of application or appearing in the examination does not guarantee eligibility. Final eligibility is checked at document verification stage.
  • Canvassing in any form or use of unfair means will lead to disqualification and possible criminal action.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in any stage of the examination.
  • The Commission reserves the right to increase/decrease the number of posts or cancel the recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • Dispute, if any, shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Gujarat Courts only.
  • Candidates are advised to visit https://gpsc.gujarat.gov.in regularly for updates, admit cards, answer keys, results, etc.

IPR Apprentices Recruitment 2026 Download PDF

Application Fees

The advertisement does not mention any application fee; applications are invited online through the NATS portal as per Apprenticeship rules.

Age Limit

The notification specifies academic year conditions for Degree/Diploma passing but does not explicitly give an age limit; eligibility is tied to year of passing.

Key points:

  • Candidates should have passed Degree/Diploma in the respective branch/discipline in 2024, 2025 or 2026.

  • Candidates who have passed Degree/Diploma in 2023 or earlier are not eligible.

Eligibility

Basic Eligibility

  • Candidates must be Degree or Diploma holders in the relevant Engineering branches or Graduates in General Stream as specified.

  • Candidates must have passed in 2024, 2025, or 2026 only; those who passed in 2023 or before are not eligible.

  • Candidates who have already undergone apprenticeship training elsewhere will not be considered.

Educational Qualification – Graduate Apprentices (Degree)

1 Computer Engineering B.Tech or B.E in Computer Engineering 
2 Civil Engineering B.Tech or B.E in Civil Engineering

5 Mechanical Engineering B.Tech or B.E in Mechanical Engineering 
6 Instrumentation & Control B.Tech or B.E in Instrumentation & Control Engineering 
7 General Stream Graduate in Commerce / Arts / Business Administration 

Educational Qualification – Technician Apprentices (Diploma)

1 Computer Engineering Diploma in Computer Engineering

Salary -Monthly Stipend

Apprentice Type Monthly Stipend
Graduate Apprentice (Degree holder) ₹13,500/- per month (Consolidated) 
Technician Apprentice (Diploma holder) ₹12,000/- per month (Consolidated) 

Training Period & Other Conditions

  • Duration of apprenticeship is 1 year for all apprentices.

  • IPR has no obligation to offer regular employment after completion of training, and apprentices cannot claim any right to permanent employment on the basis of apprenticeship.

  • Accommodation facility will not be provided; candidates must arrange their own stay.

  • No TA/DA will be paid for document verification or commencement of apprenticeship.

Selection Process

  • Selection will be purely on merit based on percentage of marks in the respective Degree/Diploma in Engineering/Non-Engineering.

  • Wherever CGPA/SGPA/letter grade is awarded, candidates must indicate equivalent percentage in the online form as per Institute/University norms and produce conversion formula at the time of document verification.

  • The list of selected candidates will be displayed on the IPR website only.

  • Candidature will be provisional and subject to verification of certificates, testimonials and medical fitness.

  • Any form of canvassing will lead to cancellation of candidature.

  • Incorrect/incomplete applications will be summarily rejected and no correspondence will be entertained.

How To Apply

  • Step 1: Register on the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT) NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in and obtain a valid registration number.

  • Step 2: Candidates meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria should submit their online application for IPR apprenticeship through the NATS portal (https://nats.education.gov.in).

  • Step 3: Ensure that Degree/Diploma details, percentage (or converted percentage from CGPA/SGPA) and branch are correctly filled as per institute norms.

  • Step 4: Regularly visit the IPR website for latest updates regarding apprenticeship notification, selection lists and further instructions.

Selection Process

The competitive examination will be conducted in MCQ (Multiple Choice Question) pattern through COMPUTER BASED RECRUITMENT TEST (CBRT) or OPTICAL MARK RECOGNITION (OMR) method.

The detailed examination scheme, syllabus, and pattern will be decided separately by the Gujarat Panchayat Service Selection Board and will be published on the official website of the Board.

Candidates are advised to regularly visit the GPSSB website for updates.

How to Apply

  • Candidates must apply online only through the OJAS portal: https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in
  • Online application window: 11-04-2026 (13:00 Hours) to 02-05-2026 (23:59 Hours).
  • No documents/certificates are required to be uploaded at the time of online application.
  • Candidates must keep scanned copies of:
    • Recent Photograph (max. 15 kb, JPG format)
    • Signature (max. 15 kb, JPG format)
  • All details (educational qualification, age, category, certificates, etc.) must be filled accurately as per original documents.
  • After successful submission and fee payment (where applicable), candidates will receive provisional admission to the examination.
  • Final selection is subject to document verification at a later stage.
  • One candidate can submit only one application. In case of multiple applications, only the last confirmed application will be considered valid.

General Instructions

  • Before filling the online application, candidates must read the full advertisement carefully.
  • All information provided in the online application must match the original certificates. Any mismatch detected during document verification will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Provisional admission to the examination does not guarantee eligibility; final selection is subject to verification of original documents.
  • All updates regarding examination, result, document verification, etc. will be sent via SMS on the registered mobile number and email on the registered email ID. Candidates must keep their mobile number and email ID active till the entire recruitment process is completed.
  • Application fee is non-refundable under any circumstances.
  • No request for change in category, sub-category, or any details will be accepted after submission.
  • Age, educational qualification, and other eligibility criteria will be considered as on the last date of online application i.e. 02-05-2026.
  • Reservations and age relaxations will be given as per prevailing Government rules (detailed in the advertisement).
  • PwD, Ex-Servicemen, Widow, and Sports quota candidates must produce valid certificates at the time of document verification.
  • In case of any dispute, the decision of the Gujarat Panchayat Service Selection Board shall be final and binding.

Who Can Apply for Territorial Army Recruitment 2026?

Nationality

  • Only citizens of India (male and female) are eligible to apply.

Age Limit

  • Candidates must have attained a minimum age of 18 years and must not be more than 42 years as on 19 May 2026 (last date of filing application).

Educational Qualification

  • Candidates must be a Graduate from any recognised university.

Physical Standards

  • Candidates must be physically and medically fit in all respects. Refer to the "Instructions to Candidates applying for Commission in The Territorial Army (Civilian Candidates)" uploaded on the Indian Army website for detailed guidelines.

Employment Condition

  • Candidates must be gainfully employed at the time of application. Serving members of the Regular Army, Navy, Air Force, Police, GREF, Para-Military and like forces are not eligible.

Application Fee

  • Application Fee: Rs. 500/- (Rupees Five Hundred Only)
  • Payment must be made only through the online modes prescribed on the official website. Payment by any other mode is not valid. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor can it be held in reserve for any other examination.

Exam Pattern & Syllabus

The examination is a Computer Based Test (CBT) conducted in a single session of 2 hours. The question paper consists of 100 MCQ carrying 100 marks, divided into three parts.

Paper Subject No. of Questions Marks Time
Part 1 Reasoning 40 40 02 Hours
            (Single Session)
Part 2 General Knowledge 30 30
Part 3 English 30 30
Total 100 100  

ⓘ Negative Marking: For each wrong answer, 1/3 (0.33%) of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty. Questions marked for review will be treated as unanswered.

Detailed Syllabus

  • Part 1 - Reasoning: Tests the ability to complete sequences and make logical conclusions based on simple patterns of numbers, statements, figures, and letters — as expected of a rational thinking person without any special study.
  • Part 2 - General Knowledge: Covers General Knowledge and Current Affairs (equal weightage). Includes questions on current affairs, everyday scientific observation, History of India, and Geography — answerable without special study.    
  • Part 3 - English: Tests understanding of English and workmanlike use of words.

The standard of papers will approximately be that expected of a graduate of an Indian university. The Territorial Army Directorate has the discretion to fix qualifying marks in any or all subjects.

Selection Process

  • Stage 1 - CBT: Candidates whose application forms are found correct and who qualify the CBT will be detailed for Intelligence and Personality Test at the Service Selection Board (SSB).    
  • Stage 2 - SSB (Two-Stage): A two-stage selection procedure based on Psychological Aptitude Test and Intelligence Test is followed at SSBs. All candidates will be put to Stage 1 (Screening) on the first day of reporting. Only those qualifying Stage 1 will be admitted to the Stage 2/remaining tests. Those who fail Stage 1 will be returned.   
  • Final Merit: Male and female candidates will be placed in separate orders of merit based on total marks in CBT and SSB tests combined.

Colonel Level 13 Rs. 1,30,600 - 2,15,900 Rs. 15,500/-
Brigadier Level 13A Rs. 1,39,600 - 2,17,600 Rs. 15,500/-

Documents Required at SSB Interview

Candidates who qualify the CBT must bring the following documents in original with self-attested copies at the time of SSB Interview:

  •  Application Form IAF (TA)-9 (Revised) Part-2 — downloaded from www.indianarmy.nic.in and filled in own handwriting    
  • All educational qualification certificates (Matric onwards).
  • Copy of identity proof with photograph (Voter ID / PAN Card / Passport / Driving Licence / Aadhaar etc.).   
  • Proof of residential address.
  • Certificate for proof of age (Matric/Senior Secondary mark sheet and certificate for DOB verification).
  • Candidates with name variation in documents: copy of Gazette Notification of India/State showing correct name, OR an affidavit supported by newspaper cuttings.
  • Latest income proof from appropriate authority (Income Tax Revenue Department / Magistrate / Employer).
  • Copy of latest Income Tax Return (ITR) filed.
  • Admit Card.
  • Self-employed candidates: Affidavit on Non-Judicial stamp paper (minimum value, duly attested by Notary) stating nature of employment and annual income, along with photocopy of PAN Card and self-certified character certificate.
  • Govt./Semi-Govt./Private Sector employed candidates: Service certificate authenticated by Head of Office, along with salary certificate and No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the department as per the format prescribed in the notification.

How to Apply for Territorial Army Commission 2026

Applications must be submitted online only at www.indianarmy.nic.in. No other mode of application is allowed.

Apply Online - indianarmy.nic.in

1. Visit the official website: Go to www.indianarmy.nic.in and read all instructions for filling the online Application Form IAF (TA)-9 (Revised) Part-1 before proceeding.

2. Fill Application Form: Complete the online application form from 20 April 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 19 May 2026 (23:55 hrs). Provide a valid and active email ID and mobile number — all communications will be sent electronically. Select your examination centre carefully, as no change of centre will be granted.

3. Pay Application Fee: Pay Rs. 500/- through the prescribed online payment modes available on the website. Applications submitted without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected.

4. Submit and Save: Submit the application well before the last date. Save a printout/copy of the filled and submitted application form for future reference.

NIC Scientist B Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates must fulfil the NIC Scientist B eligibility criteria 2026 in terms of valid GATE score, educational qualification and age limit as on 31 March 2026.

  • Valid GATE Score: Candidates must have a valid GATE 2024, 2025 or 2026 score in the relevant paper - CS for Computer Science & IT, EC for Electronics & Communication, and DA for Data Science & AI.
  • Educational Qualification: Computer Science & IT - specified Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Technology, DOEACC B‑level, AMIE/AMIETE or relevant MSc/MCA/ME/M.Tech/M.Phil in listed fields such as Electronics, Computer Science, IT, Informatics, Cyber Law etc., with essential qualification obtained by 31.03.2026 and valid GATE CS score. Electronics & Communication - required BE/B.Tech/ME/M.Tech or equivalent in Electronics & Communication Engineering with valid GATE EC score. Data Science & AI - required engineering or postgraduate degree in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence with valid GATE DA score.
  • Experience: No prior work experience is required for NIC Scientist B posts.
  • Age Limit: Upper age 30 years for UR/EWS, 33 years for OBC (NCL), 35 years for SC/ST and up to 40 years for PwBD (45 years for SC/ST PwBD, 43 years for OBC PwBD) as on 31.03.2026; additional relaxation for eligible service candidates and Ex‑servicemen as per Government rules.

NIC Scientist B Salary 2026

Selected candidates in NIC Scientist B Recruitment 2026 will be appointed as Scientist‑B in Level‑10 of the 7th CPC pay matrix.

  • Pay Scale: Level‑10, Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500 along with applicable allowances as per Government of India rules.
  • The post is a Group‑A S&T Gazetted position with all‑India service liability, and appointees may be posted anywhere in India or abroad in the interest of NIC.

NIC Scientist B Application Fees 2026

Applicants have to pay a non‑refundable NIC Scientist B application fee 2026 category wise through online mode only.

  • UR / OBC (NCL) / EWS: Rs. 800 per discipline applied.
  • SC / ST / PwBD / Women candidates: No application fee (Nil).

NIC Scientist B Selection Process 2026

The NIC Scientist B selection process 2026 is based on GATE score shortlisting followed by personal interaction/interview and document verification.

  • Shortlisting: Eligible candidates with valid GATE score are shortlisted discipline‑wise and category‑wise in a ratio of 1:5 for personal interaction/interview, based on their best GATE 2024/2025/2026 score in the relevant paper.
  • Document Verification & Interview: Shortlisted candidates undergo document verification before the interview; only those whose documents are found in order can appear for interaction/interview which carries 50 marks covering technical knowledge, communication and academic performance.
  • Final Merit List: Final selection is prepared on the basis of 60% weightage to GATE score and 40% weightage to interview marks, with minimum qualifying marks of 50% for UR and 40% for EWS/OBC/SC/ST/PwBD in the interview.

How to Apply for NIC Scientist B Recruitment 2026

Candidates must apply online for NIC Scientist B Recruitment 2026 by completing all four mandatory steps on the NIC recruitment portal between 27 March and 24 April 2026.

Step 1 - Registration: Visit https://recruitment.nic.in, click on the NIC Scientist‑B 2026 link and complete the one‑time registration by providing basic details, valid email ID and active mobile number to generate an application number and password.

Step 2 - Fill Online Application & Upload Documents: Log in with application number and password, fill the NIC Scientist B application form with personal, educational and GATE score details, select discipline(s), and upload scanned photo, signature and required certificates (DOB, qualification, GATE scorecard, category, PwBD, NOC, etc.) as per prescribed size and format.

Step 3 - Pay Application Fee (if applicable): Pay the applicable application fee (Rs. 800 for UR/OBC/EWS per discipline; Nil for SC/ST/PwBD/Women) through the online payment gateway and ensure that the transaction is successful before the closing date.

Step 4 - Download Confirmation Page: After successful fee payment and form submission, download and save the confirmation page; only applications with all four steps completed will be treated as valid and incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Project Engineer on Contract (PE‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in relevant disciplines such as Electronics, ECE, ETC, EEE, E&I, CSE, IT, CSIT, Mechanical/Electrical with NDT Level‑II (for Kudankulam) along with a minimum of 3 years post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship in the relevant field up to 1 year is also counted as experience.
  • Technical Officer on Contract (TO‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in Electronics/Electrical/ECE/ETC/EEE/E&I/CSE/IT and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship up to 1 year is countable towards experience.
  • Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C): Diploma with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in ECE/ETC/Electronics/EEE/Instrumentation and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience including relevant apprenticeship.
  • Senior Artisan on Contract (SA‑C): ITI passed in Electronics, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Instrumentation or Radio & TV trades with minimum 2 years post‑qualification experience (including up to 1 year apprenticeship) in maintenance/repair of electronics, instrumentation systems, communication gadgets or computers.
  • Age Limit (UR): Project Engineer – maximum 33 years; Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan – maximum 30 years. Age relaxation is 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, an additional 10 years for PwBD (40% and above) over category relaxation, and 5 years for candidates domiciled in J&K from 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Salary 2026

  • Selected candidates under ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 will receive consolidated monthly emoluments based on the post and contract year, along with limited benefits as per ECIL rules.
  • Consolidated Emoluments: Project Engineer on Contract – Rs. 40,000 (1st year), Rs. 45,000 (2nd year), Rs. 50,000 (3rd year), Rs. 55,000 (4th year) plus a one‑time attire allowance of Rs. 8,400 after completion of at least six months; Technical Officer on Contract – Rs. 25,000 (1st year), Rs. 28,000 (2nd year), Rs. 31,000 (3rd & 4th years); Assistant Project Engineer – Rs. 25,506 per month; Senior Artisan – Rs. 23,368 per month, with APE‑C and SA‑C wages revised every six months as per CLC (Central) guidelines.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • The ECIL Advt. No. 07/2026 walk‑in notification does not prescribe any separate application fee for appearing in the selection process for these contract posts.
  • Fee Status: Candidates are required to download the application form and attend the walk‑in with documents; there is no mention of any application or examination fee in the advertisement, so applicants should not pay any money to unauthorized persons or intermediaries and rely only on official ECIL instructions.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Form

There is no online application process for ECIL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 07/2026); candidates have to attend walk‑in selections as per the notified schedule. Eligible applicants must visit the official ECIL website ecil.co.in, download the prescribed ECIL contract application form 2026, fill it carefully and report at the concerned zonal walk‑in venue on the respective date within the registration time slot.

Candidates must carry the duly filled ECIL application form, updated resume, original certificates and one set of self‑attested photocopies for age, qualification, experience, category, disability, ex‑servicemen and identity proof along with recent passport size photographs. Registration and document verification will be done at the venue before the personal interview under ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026.

Click to Download ECIL Contract Application Form 2026

Download ECIL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF (Advt. No. 07/2026)

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 selection for Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan will be based on walk‑in registration, document verification and personal interview with a weighted merit system.
  • Shortlisting & Evaluation: After on‑spot registration and successful verification of original documents, candidates will be evaluated on three components – (A) Qualification: 20% of aggregate percentage scored in BE/B.Tech/Diploma/ITI; (B) Relevant Experience: up to 30 marks based on post‑qualification experience as per post‑specific rules; and (C) Personal Interview: 50 marks.
  • Final Merit & Offer: Final recommendations will be prepared in order of merit based on total score (A+B+C). Experience from purely academic internships, college projects etc. is not counted. Selected candidates will be engaged on fixed‑tenure contract and must be willing to work anywhere in India as per ECIL’s project requirements.

How to Apply / Attend ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria for ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 07/2026) must appear personally at the designated zonal venues on the scheduled walk‑in dates with the prescribed application form and documents.

  • Step 1 – Download ECIL Application Form: Visit the official ECIL website www.ecil.co.in, open the Careers/Recruitment section and download the application form for Advt. No. 07/2026. Take a printout and fill it neatly with all required details including post category, zone and location preference.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Documents: Keep ready original and one set of self‑attested copies of 10th certificate (DOB proof), all qualification certificates and marksheets, CGPA‑to‑percentage conversion (if applicable), complete experience certificates with from‑to dates and post held, appointment order and recent payslips (if currently employed), caste (EWS/OBC/SC/ST) certificate, non‑creamy layer OBC certificate (not older than one year), PwBD certificate, Ex‑servicemen/ J&K domicile proof and valid government ID (Aadhaar/Passport etc.).
  • Step 3 – Reach Walk‑in Venue in Time: Report to the respective ECIL Zonal Office (Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru on 20 April 2026; Chennai on 20 April 2026) within the registration time 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs. Late reporting after 11:30 hrs will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Step 4 – Registration & Document Verification: Submit the filled ECIL application form 2026, resume and document set at the registration desk. After successful verification, candidates will be allowed to attend the personal interview as part of the selection process.
  • Step 5 – Attend Interview & Wait for Result: Appear for the interview as scheduled at the venue. Final selection will be based on the combined weightage of qualification, experience and interview performance. Shortlisted candidates will receive joining instructions from ECIL and must be prepared for posting at project locations anywhere in India.

SSF Constable Recruitment 2025 Selection Process

The SSF Constable (Barber & Washerman) Recruitment 2025 selection will be conducted in four phases:

  • Phase I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET): Qualifying in nature; no marks awarded. Events include 1.6 km Race (within 7.30 minutes), Long Jump (11 feet, 3 chances), and High Jump (3½ feet, 3 chances). Candidates failing any event will be eliminated. PET will not be held for Ex-Servicemen.
  • Phase I – Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates who qualify PET will be screened for Height, Chest and Weight measurements. Those not meeting the required physical standards will be eliminated. Candidates may appeal on the same day to the Appellate Authority through the Presiding Officer.
  • Phase II – Written Examination (50 Marks): Objective type Multiple Choice Questions (OMR or CBT) of 1 hour duration covering General Awareness/GK (15 marks), Elementary Mathematics (10 marks), Analytical Aptitude (15 marks), and English/Hindi (10 marks). Minimum qualifying marks: 18 for UR & Ex-Servicemen; 17 for SC & OBC. No negative marking.
  • Phase III – Trade Test (50 Marks): Candidates who qualify the written examination (10 times the category-wise vacancies) will appear for a Trade Test. Qualifying marks are 50% for all categories. Trade Test is qualifying in nature only.
  • For Constable (Barber): Hair cutting of various types (20 marks), Body/head massage (15 marks), Knowledge of tools/machines used in trade (15 marks).
  • For Constable (Washerman): Washing of various types of clothes (15 marks), Ironing of clothes (10 marks), Knowledge about dry-cleaning of clothes (10 marks), Knowledge about use of various detergents/washing powders/soaps (15 marks).
  • Phase IV – Verification of Original Documents & Detailed Medical Examination (DME): Shortlisted candidates will undergo document verification followed by Detailed Medical Examination. Candidates declared unfit in DME may undergo Review Medical Examination (RME) by giving written consent within 24 hours.

Step 2 – Create Profile & Fill Application: Create a profile on the ITBPF Recruitment website and fill in all required details including Category (UR/SC/OBC NCL), Employment status, personal details, educational qualifications, and trade applied for correctly and completely.

Step 3 – Upload Documents: Upload a genuine and functional email ID and mobile number along with required documents in the prescribed format as specified in the official notification.

Step 5 – Submit Application: Review all entries carefully and submit the completed application form before 28 April 2026 (11:59 PM). Download and print a clear and legible copy of the online application form and admit card for use at all stages of the recruitment process.

SSB Head Constable Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details

Sl. No. Post Name Total
1 Head Constable (Steward) 2

4 Head Constable (Veterinary) 5
Grand Total 233

UR: Un-Reserved | EWS: Economically Weaker Section | SC: Scheduled Caste | ST: Scheduled Tribe | OBC: Other Backward Class.
10% vacancies are reserved for Ex-Servicemen.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Qualifications – Head Constable (Steward):
    • 12th class pass from a recognized Board.
    • Diploma of minimum two years duration in Catering and Kitchen Management from an institution recognized by the Central Government or State Government.
    • Working experience of minimum one year as a Steward in a minimum hundred bedded hospital or institution recognized by the Central Government or State Government.
  • Qualifications – Head Constable (Communication):
    • 12th class pass in Science with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics from a recognized Board; OR
    • Three years Diploma in Electronics or Communications or Computer Science or Information Technology from a recognized Institute.
  • Qualifications – Head Constable (Electrician):
    • Matriculation or equivalent from a recognized Board.
    • Two years work experience in respective trade; OR
    • One year certificate course from a recognized Industrial Training Institute or Vocational Institute with at least one year experience in the respective trade; OR
    • Two years Diploma from a recognized Industrial Training Institute in the respective trade or similar trade; AND
    • Must qualify trade test.
  • Qualifications – Head Constable (Veterinary):
    • 12th class pass with Science and Biology as main subject from a recognized Board.
    • Two years Diploma Course in Veterinary and Livestock Development or Veterinary Stock Assistant Course or Animal Husbandry Course from an institution recognized by the Central Government or State Government.
  • Nationality: Only Indian citizens are eligible. No person who is not a citizen of India shall be appointed except with prior written permission of the Central Government. Subjects of Nepal or Bhutan may be appointed in the Force.
  • Crucial Date for Age & Eligibility: The closing date for receipt of applications i.e. 30 (thirty) days from the date of publication of this advertisement in the Employment News will be the crucial date to determine age and all eligibility criteria.
  • Candidates must fulfill all eligibility conditions for the applied post and be in possession of all certificates as on the last date of receipt of applications.

Salary / Stipend

  • Post: Head Constables (Steward, Communication, Electrician and Veterinary)
  • Pay Scale (7th CPC): Level-4 Pay Matrix – Basic Pay ₹25,500/- to ₹81,100/- Per Month
  • Other Allowances: Dearness Allowance, Ration Money Allowance, House Rent Allowance and any other allowances as admissible in SSB from time to time as per Government orders.
  • Pension: Selected candidates will be covered under Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (New Pension Scheme) OR Unified Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (UPS) as applicable for new entrants to Central Government services w.e.f. 01st January 2004 or 01st April 2025 respectively, as per prevailing government rules and organizational policies.

Age Limit 

  • Head Constable (Steward): Between 18 and 27 Years
  • Head Constable (Communication): Between 18 and 27 Years
  • Head Constable (Electrician): Between 18 and 25 Years
  • Head Constable (Veterinary): Between 18 and 27 Years
  • Age Relaxation:
    • SC/ST: 5 years
    • OBC: 3 years
    • Ex-Servicemen: 3 years after deduction of military service rendered from actual age
    • Departmental Candidates (Central Govt. Employees): Up to 40 years (UR), 43 years (OBC), 45 years (SC/ST)
    • Candidates domiciled in J&K and Ladakh during 01-01-1980 to 31-12-1989 (UR): 5 years; (OBC): 8 years; (SC/ST): 10 years
    • Children and dependents of victims killed in 1984 riots (UR): 5 years; (OBC): 8 years; (SC/ST): 10 years
  • Age relaxation is NOT admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of ex-servicemen.
  • Date of Birth (D.O.B.) and name as recorded in Matriculation certificate will be accepted for determining the age and name. No subsequent request for change in date of birth and name will be considered.

Application Fee

  • UR, EWS and OBC Candidates: ₹100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) – Non-Refundable
  • Exempted (Fee = Nil): SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen and Female candidates are exempted from payment of examination fees.
  • Payment Mode: Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI
  • No amount will be refunded in any case. Candidates are advised to avoid making multiple payments against a single registration as payments are non-refundable.

Important Dates

Event Date
Advertisement Published in Employment News 21–27 March 2026
Last Date for Receipt of Online Applications 30 days from date of publication of advertisement in Employment News
Crucial Date for Age & Eligibility Determination Closing date for receipt of applications (30 days from publication)

Selection Process

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET) & Physical Standard Test (PST):
    • PET – Male: 1.6 Km run in 6 Minutes 30 Seconds; Female: 800 Meter race in 4 minutes.
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET but must appear in PST, Written Examination, Skill Test (as applicable), Documentation and Medical Examination.
    • PST – Candidates must meet prescribed height and chest standards (post-wise and category-wise as per notification).
    • General (UR/EWS/OBC): Male – 165 cm height, 75–80 cm chest; Female – 155 cm height (Head Constable Steward). Different standards apply for SC/ST, NE States, J&K and other specified categories.
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test – CBT):
    • Paper-I Common Entrance Test: 3 hours duration, 150 marks, 150 multiple-choice objective type questions.
    • Part-I (50 Marks): General Knowledge, Mathematics, Reasoning, General English/General Hindi.
    • Part-II (100 Marks): Technical Subject.
    • Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for Gen/EWS/OBC/Ex-SM; 45% for SC/ST.
    • Final Merit will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained by candidates in the written examination.
  • Stage III – Skill Test (Only for Head Constable Electrician):
    • Skill test will be conducted for up to 20 times the vacancies (category-wise) for the post of Head Constable (Electrician).
    • Skill test carries 50 marks; minimum qualifying marks for all categories including SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen: 60%.
    • Skill test is qualifying in nature. Marks of skill test will not be included in the final merit list.
  • Stage IV – Document Verification (DV) and Detailed Medical Examination (DME) / Review Medical Examination (RME):
    • Candidates shortlisted up to 3 times the vacancies (category-wise) will be called for Documentation and DME/RME.
    • All original documents will be verified by detailed BOOs of SSB.
    • Candidates declared unfit in DME may prefer an appeal for Review Medical Examination (RME). The decision of RME Board will be final and no 2nd appeal will be entertained.
  • Final Selection: Final selection list will be prepared in order of merit, category-wise, after completion of Review Medical Examination. Where equal marks are obtained: candidate with more marks in Part-II (Technical Subject) will rank higher; if still equal, senior in age will rank higher; if date of birth is also same, priority based on alphabetical order of names in English.

General Information / Instructions

  • Posts are temporary but likely to continue. Selected candidates are liable to serve anywhere in India or outside the Territory of India and will be governed by SSB Act & Rules and other Rules amended from time to time.
  • A candidate can apply for only one post from amongst the posts mentioned in the notification.
  • Applications received through any mode except Online Mode shall not be accepted and rejected straightway.
  • SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates who fulfill eligibility criteria of unreserved category may apply against the unreserved category for posts where no vacancies are reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS.
  • OBC Non-Creamy Layer status should have been obtained within three years of the closing date of receipt of applications.
  • EWS certificate should be valid for 2026-27 as per Annexure-III. Family gross annual income must be below ₹8,00,000/-.
  • Biometrics of both thumbs (Left & Right) of candidates will be taken for verification in all stages after attendance.
  • Persons employed in Government/Semi-Government/Public Sector Undertakings should apply through proper channel and submit NOC from their employer at the time of documentation.
  • Name, Father's Name & Date of Birth should be mentioned exactly as recorded in the Matriculation certificate.
  • Candidates should be prepared for a stay of at least one week at the recruitment venue at their own arrangement. No TA/DA will be admissible.
  • Unemployed SC/ST candidates appearing in the written test will be reimbursed fare as admissible under relevant Rules subject to production of Rail/Bus tickets, original caste certificate and Non-employment certificate issued by MP or MLA or any Gazetted Officer.
  • Persons with bigamy/marriage to a person with a living spouse are disqualified. Conviction by court of law or dismissal from Government service also leads to disqualification.
  • Calculator, Digital Diary, Cellular Phone, pager, Whiteners, blade etc. are prohibited in the recruitment venue.
  • The DG, SSB has full right to make changes/cancel/postpone the recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • There will be no provision of reserve merit list/panel. If vacancies remain unfilled after declaration of final result, the same will be carried forward for the next recruitment.
  • Any amendment in the schedule/condition/process of recruitment will be available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/ only.

How to Apply

  • Candidates are advised to go through the instructions and detailed advertisement available on SSB official website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ & https://ssb.gov.in/ carefully before filling up the application form.
  • Applications must be submitted through Online Mode Only. Applications received through any other mode shall not be accepted.
  • Fill all fields in the application form including: Post applied, Candidate's Name, Father's/Husband's Name, Mother's Name, Date of Birth (in DD/MM/YYYY format as per matriculation certificate), Gender, Nationality, Religion, Marital Status, Category, Education Qualification, Postal/Permanent Address, Aadhaar Number (or valid Photo Identity Card number), Identification Marks, Mobile Number, E-mail ID, Criminal Cases Declaration.
  • Upload passport size coloured photograph in JPG format (less than 12 KB and greater than 4 KB, resolution 100 pixel width × 120 pixel height, white background with 75% face visible).
  • Upload signature in JPG format (less than 12 KB and greater than 4 KB, resolution 140 pixel width × 60 pixel height).
  • Pay the requisite fee of ₹100/- (for UR/EWS/OBC) through Net Banking / Credit Card / Debit Card / UPI. SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Women candidates are exempted from fee payment.
  • After successful submission, note down the Registration Number generated and take a printout of the application form/acknowledgement for future reference.
  • Application form can be edited by clicking "Edit Details" button till the closing/last date of receipt of online application form. After submission, no request for change/correction will be entertained.
  • Reporting to Recruitment Venue: Admit Cards can be downloaded from the SSB Recruitment website. Candidates must report to the venue on the date mentioned in the Admit Card with all original documents including Identity certificate, educational qualification certificates, Caste Certificates, Aadhaar Card etc.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Test (CBT), Document Verification, Interview (only for Post Code-02) and Medical Test.

  • Computer Based Test (CBT): Single stage consisting of Part A & Part B (100 MCQs, 90 minutes duration; 120 minutes for eligible PwBD with Scribe).
    • Part A (50 marks): Mathematics/Numerical Ability (20), General Awareness (10), Logical Reasoning (10), Knowledge about Railways/IRFC (10).
    • Part B (50 marks): Subject-specific (Corporate Accounting, Finance, Taxation, etc.).
    • Negative marking: 1/4th marks deducted for wrong answer.
    • Qualifying Marks: UR/EWS – 40%, SC/OBC-NCL – 30%, ST – 25%.
    • Normalization applied if CBT held in multiple shifts.
    • Candidates up to 3 times the vacancies (community-wise) will be called for next stage based on CBT merit.
  • Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will produce original documents/certificates for verification.
  • Interview (only for Assistant Manager/Finance – E1 Level): Weightage 20% in final merit (CBT 80% + Interview 20%).
  • Medical Test: Candidates must be medically FIT as per IRFC standards (C1 category).

Final merit prepared strictly as per CBT marks + Interview (where applicable) + extant reservation rules. Selected candidates will be on 1 year probation.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through IRFC official website

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official IRFC website and register online.
  2. Fill the online application form with all mandatory details.
  3. Upload scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression and required certificates.
  4. Pay the application fee online (if applicable).
  5. Submit the form and take printout of the application for record.
  6. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit separate applications.
  7. Regular employees of IRFC are not required to produce NOC but must bring Vigilance & D&AR Clearance at Document Verification.
  8. No documents to be sent by post; everything is online.

General Instructions

  • Candidates must read the full notification carefully before applying.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee selection.
  • Age is reckoned as on 01-01-2026.
  • Candidates must possess the prescribed essential qualifications as on the closing date.
  • Reservation benefits are applicable as per Government of India rules.
  • PwBD candidates (minimum 40% disability) can avail scribe facility and compensatory time.
  • Ex-Servicemen candidates must produce Discharge Certificate/NOC.
  • No TA/DA will be paid for attending CBT/Interview/Document Verification/Medical Test.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • IRFC reserves the right to cancel/modify the recruitment process without assigning any reason.
  • Any dispute will be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts in Delhi only.
  • All information/updates will be available only on the official IRFC website.
  • Selected candidates will execute a Service Bond (Rs. 2 Lakh + GST for Assistant; Rs. 3 Lakh + GST for Assistant Manager) to serve IRFC for minimum 2 years.
  • Appointment is subject to verification of antecedents and being found medically FIT.

Selection Process

The direct recruitment will be done through a three-stage process:

  • Stage 1: Screening Test (qualifying in nature)
    • Online MCQ (150 questions, 3 hours duration) on Reasoning, Basic Mathematics, English, Aptitude, Attitude and Leadership Quality.
    • Medium: English only.
    • Qualifying marks: Minimum 60% (relaxable to 50% for OBC and 40% for SC/ST/PwBD if sufficient candidates not available).
    • Shortlisting ratio: Restricted to 1:6 (six candidates per post) in order of merit in each category.
  • Stage 2: Evaluation of Academic Records
    • Applications qualifying the Screening Test will be evaluated by a Screening Evaluation Committee.
    • Marks awarded as per detailed norms given in Annexure-I (Scientist-C) and Annexure-II (Scientist-D) (total 120 marks).
    • Shortlisting ratio for Interview: 1:3 (three candidates per post) in order of merit.
  • Stage 3: Personal Interaction / Interview
    • 30 marks.
    • Conducted at Delhi or any other location/mode approved by competent authority.
    • Final Merit List: Marks of Evaluation (120) + Interview (30) = 150 marks.

Document Verification: Original documents will be verified prior to the interview. Candidates failing to produce all required original documents will be debarred.

Note: Screening Test is qualifying only. Final selection is based on combined marks of Evaluation + Interview. Normalization of marks will be applied if the test is conducted in multiple batches.

How to Apply

Candidates must apply ONLINE only at https://recruitment.nic.in/ between 08-04-2026 to 30-04-2026 (05:30 PM). No other mode of application will be accepted.

  2. Fill Online Application Form & Upload Documents (Photo, Signature, Age Proof, Qualification Certificates, Experience Certificates, Caste/PwBD Certificates, NOC/CCA Declaration, SOP, etc. – full checklist given in the advertisement)
  3. Payment of Application Fee (if applicable)
  4. Download Confirmation Page

Important:

  • Application is complete only after all four steps.
  • Aadhaar-based authentication will be used at every stage.
  • Candidates can apply for more than one post but must pay separate fee for each.
  • Change of category is not permitted after submission.

Application Fee (non-refundable):

  • Nil – SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates
  • Rs. 800/- per post – General and all others

General Instructions

  • The number of posts is tentative and may increase or decrease.
  • Place of posting: Anywhere in India and outside India.

  • All communications will be sent only through registered email ID and mobile number. Candidates must regularly check their email/SMS and the official recruitment portal.

  • Decision of NIC/MeitY in all matters relating to recruitment shall be final.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Shortlisting of candidates followed by Interview.

  • Applications will be scrutinized as per eligibility criteria mentioned in the advertisement.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview (date, time and venue will be informed separately).
  • Candidates have to bear their own travelling cost for attending the interview.
  • Self-attested copies of educational qualifications and experience certificates will be submitted at the time of interview. Original documents will be required for verification.
  • Final selection will be based on performance in the interview and verification of documents.
  • NPS Trust reserves the right to modify the selection procedure, if deemed fit.
  • Mere fulfilling of eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.
  • The decision of NPS Trust in all matters relating to eligibility, shortlisting and selection shall be final and binding.
  • Appointment is purely contractual for 3 years (extendable by 2 years subject to outstanding performance). No claim for regular / permanent appointment.

How to Apply

Application Mode: By Email only. No other mode (post, online portal, hand delivery etc.) will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Download and fill the prescribed Application Format (Section II of the notification) in legible PDF / type-written format.
  2. Paste recent passport-size photograph and sign across it.
  3. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents (DOB proof, educational certificates & mark sheets, experience certificates, relieving letters, caste / category certificate if applicable, Annexure-A for OBC if required, CV / Resume etc.).
  4. Send the complete application along with supporting documents by email to [email protected].
  5. Mention the exact subject line: “Recruitment of Staff (<Name of the Post & Department>) on Contract Basis”.
  6. Candidates applying for multiple posts must send separate applications for each post.
  7. Applications received after the due date / time or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

Note: Only one application per post will be considered (latest application in case of multiple submissions).

General Instructions

  • Cut-off date for determining eligibility (age, qualification, experience) is 28-02-2026.
  • Appointment is purely contractual in nature. Selected candidates shall have no right for permanent absorption in NPS Trust under any circumstances.
  • Initial contract period is 3 years, extendable by 2 years (one year at a time) subject to satisfactory performance.
  • Performance will be reviewed half-yearly. Unsatisfactory performance may lead to termination of contract.
  • Termination of contract can be done by either party by giving 2 months’ notice or payment in lieu thereof.
  • Place of posting is New Delhi (may be transferred anywhere in India as per requirement).
  • No residential accommodation will be provided.
  • Total yearly leave of 30 days (proportionate basis) with conditions mentioned in the notification.
  • Remuneration is fixed monthly gross salary with provision for annual increment based on performance.
  • Proficiency in English and Hindi (reading, writing & speaking) is essential.
  • Candidates working in Government / PSU must submit proper NOC / relieving letter at the time of joining.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • Corrigendum / Addendum, if any, will be published only on the official website www.npstrust.org.in.
  • Any dispute arising out of this recruitment shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of Courts at New Delhi only.
  • NPS Trust reserves the right to cancel / modify the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason.

INMAS DRDO Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification: Candidates must hold the relevant Diploma, ITI Certificate or Graduate degree (B.Sc./B.Pharma/B.L.I.Sc.) in the applicable discipline as specified in the vacancy table above. Only fresh pass-out candidates who have passed their respective qualifying course in the year 2022 or later are eligible to apply. Candidates who passed their qualifying examination before 2022 are not eligible. Candidates with a post-graduation degree are also not eligible to apply.

Only those candidates who have completed their qualifying examination as regular candidates (not through distance/correspondence mode) are eligible.

Graduate or Diploma holders who have undergone training or have job experience of one year or more after attaining the essential qualification are NOT eligible for engagement as an Apprentice under the Act.

Age Limit: Not specifically mentioned. Candidates should refer to the Apprentices Act 1961 as amended in 1961, 1973 and 2014 for applicable age norms.

Reservation: Reservation will be applied as per the provisions of the Apprentices Act 1961 as amended and Apprenticeship Rules 1992 as amended from time to time. Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)/EWS/PwD categories must produce their caste/relevant certificates in the prescribed format issued by the Competent Authority.

INMAS DRDO Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Stipend

Selected candidates will receive monthly stipend during the 12-month apprenticeship training period as per the Apprentices Act 1961 and applicable MSDE norms. No accommodation or transport will be provided by INMAS during the training period. No TA/DA will be paid for joining.

Apprenticeship Category Monthly Stipend
ITI Apprentice Rs.9,600/- per month
Diploma Apprentice Rs.10,900/- per month
Graduate Apprentice Rs.12,300/- per month

Employment Note: It shall not be obligatory on the part of INMAS, Delhi to offer any employment to any Apprentice on completion of the apprenticeship training period.

INMAS DRDO Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Application Fee

As per the INMAS DRDO Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 advertisement, no application fee has been prescribed for candidates applying for Apprentice posts.

INMAS DRDO Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process

The INMAS DRDO Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 selection will be based strictly on merit.

Merit-Based Shortlisting: Candidates will be selected strictly on the basis of percentage/marks obtained in the essential qualifying examination. A Board constituted by the Director, INMAS will review all applications and shortlist candidates as per the vacancies indicated. Only selected candidates will be informed about further proceedings.

Important: Canvassing or personal follow-up with the intention of influencing the selection process will lead to immediate disqualification of the candidate.

How to Apply for INMAS DRDO Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27

Eligible candidates for INMAS DRDO Apprentice Recruitment 2026-27 must apply online through the BOAT portal before the last date.

Step 1 – Register on BOAT Portal: Visit www.mhrdnats.gov.in and register/enrol your name on the BOAT (Board of Apprenticeship and Training) web portal. Candidates who are not registered are likely to be rejected. Ensure your registration is verified by the Regional Board before applying.

Step 2 – Login and Search Establishment: For candidates with Technical/Engineering subjects, apply through the Establishment user ID NDLNOC000005 (INMAS/Institute of Nuclear Medicine and Allied Sciences) on the portal www.mhrdnats.gov.in.

Step 3 – Verify Eligibility: Before applying, ensure that you fulfill all eligibility criteria including the qualifying course, pass-out year (2022 or later), regular candidate status, and that you do not hold a post-graduation degree or prior training/job experience of 1 year or more in the relevant field.

Step 4 – Fill and Submit Application: Fill in all required personal details, educational qualification details, discipline, category, and reservation claims carefully and submit the application online before 30 April 2026.

Step 5 – Keep Records: Save a copy of the submitted application for future reference. Selected candidates will be required to submit a Medical Fitness Certificate at the time of joining and execute a contract for 12 months of training as per the Apprentices Act 1961.

SSB Paramedical Eligibility Criteria 2026

Eligibility criteria include age limit, educational qualification, professional qualification and experience. All conditions must be met by the closing date of receipt of applications.

Age Limit & Relaxation 2026

Category Age Relaxation beyond Upper Age Limit
Minimum Age (All Posts) 18 years

Note: Age relaxation is NOT admissible to sons, daughters and dependants of ex-servicemen. The crucial date for determining age shall be the closing date of receipt of applications.

SSB Paramedical Educational & Professional Qualification 2026

Post-wise essential educational and professional qualifications are as follows:

Post Essential Educational & Professional Qualification
Head Constable (Laboratory Assistant) (i) 12th class pass with Biology as a subject from a recognized Board.
(ii) Certificate course of minimum one year in Laboratory Assistant Course from a recognized institution.
(iii) Working experience of minimum one year as Lab Assistant in a Laboratory Diagnostic Centre or hospital or institution lab recognized by Central/State Government.
Head Constable (Physiotherapy Assistant) (i) 12th class pass from a recognized Board.
(ii) Certificate course of minimum one year in Physiotherapy from a recognized institute.
(iii) Experience of minimum one year as Physiotherapy Assistant from a Physiotherapy Centre or minimum 100-bedded hospital or institute recognized by Central/State Government.
Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic) (i) 10th class pass from a recognized Board.
(ii) First Aid Certificate course from St. John's Ambulance Organization or Red Cross Society of India.
(iii) Experience of minimum one year as Nursing Assistant in a minimum 50-bedded Hospital or Institution recognized by Central/State Government.

SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026

The SSB Paramedical Selection Process 2026 consists of the following stages:

  • Stage I – Physical Efficiency Test (PET):
    • HC (Lab Assistant) & HC (Physiotherapy Assistant): Male – 1.6 km in 6 min 30 sec; Female – 800 m in 4 min
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): Male – 4.8 km in 24 min; Female – 2.4 km in 18 min
    • Ex-Servicemen are exempted from PET
  • Stage I – Physical Standard Test (PST): Height and chest measurement as per category-wise norms (General/UR/OBC/EWS: Male 165 cm, Female 155 cm; chest for males 75–80 cm; relaxations for ST, NE States, Garhwali, Kumaoni, Dogra, Maratha, J&K/Ladakh candidates).
  • Stage II – Written Examination (Computer Based Test):
    • HC (Lab Assistant & Physiotherapy Assistant): 150 marks, 3 hours, 150 MCQs – Part I (50 marks): GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi; Part II (100 marks): Technical Subject. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.
    • Constable (Nursing Assistant cum Medic): 100 marks, 2 hours, 100 MCQs – GK, Maths, Reasoning, General English/Hindi. Negative marking: 0.25 per wrong answer.

How to Apply for SSB Paramedical Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official SSB Recruitment website https://recruitment.ssb.gov.in/ or https://ssb.gov.in/ and read all instructions carefully before filling the application.
  2. Fill Part-I of the online application: Post name, personal details (name as per matriculation certificate), father's/mother's name, date of birth, gender, nationality, religion, marital status, category.
  3. Fill Part-II: Upload passport-size coloured photograph (JPG, 4–12 KB, 100×120 pixels, white background, 75% face) and signature (JPG, 4–12 KB, 140×80 pixels, blue/black ink).
  4. After successful upload, a Registration Number will be generated – note it down or take a printout.
  5. Fill remaining details: Aadhaar number/photo ID, identification marks, mobile number (mandatory), email ID (mandatory), education qualification, postal/permanent address, criminal case declaration, and create a password.
  6. Proceed to Part-III: Pay examination fee (if applicable) through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card/UPI.
  7. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.
  8. Report to the recruitment venue on the date mentioned in the Admit Card with all original documents, certificates, Aadhaar Card, etc.

Important Instructions

  • A candidate can apply for only ONE post from the three posts mentioned.
  • Only online applications will be accepted; applications through any other mode will be rejected.

  • DG, SSB reserves the right to increase/decrease/cancel vacancies or postpone the recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • All updates and amendments will be available only on the SSB Recruitment website; candidates must visit regularly.

Selection Process

  • The selection process for Central Bank of India Specialist Officers in Risk Management streams consists of an online written examination followed by a personal interview.

  • The final merit will be prepared by giving 70% weightage to the online written test and 30% weightage to the interview, subject to document verification and medical fitness.

  • Only those candidates who qualify the online exam and meet the bank’s cutoff will be called for the interview in a prescribed ratio to the number of vacancies.

How to Apply

Visit official website

  • Go to the official Central Bank of India website: centralbank.bank.in.

  • Open the “Recruitment/ Careers” section and click on the link for “Recruitment Process for Selection of Officers in Specialist Category in Risk Management Streams.”

Open Apply Online link

  • On the recruitment page, click on “Click Here to Apply” / “Apply Online” which redirects to the online registration page (IBPS application link for CBI SO).

  • Read the detailed notification, “How to Apply” and FAQ on the registration page carefully before proceeding.

New registration

  • Click on “New Registration” and enter basic details (name, contact number, email ID, etc.) to generate a Registration Number and Password.

  • Note down the Registration Number and Password for future login and form completion.

Fill online application form

  • Log in using Registration Number and Password and select the relevant post/scale (Analytics & Model Risk, Asset Liability Management, Digital Risk Management, Enterprise Risk, Market Risk in Scale IV/III/II as applicable).

  • Fill personal details, category, domicile, address, qualification (B.Sc/B.Tech/BE/MBA/PGDM etc.) and post-qualification experience in Risk/IT/ALM/Digital Risk as per eligibility.

  • Ensure all experience details (years, organisation, role) match what is required for the chosen scale and stream.

Upload required documents

  • Upload recent passport-size photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration in the prescribed dimensions and file size, as per the instructions in the notification.

  • Upload supporting documents (if asked at application stage) like educational certificates, experience certificates and category certificates in the specified format.

Pay application fee

  • Pay the application fee online: ₹175/- (intimation charges) for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates and ₹850/- (application fee + intimation charges) for all other candidates, through debit card/credit card/net banking/UPI.

  • After successful payment, verify that the fee status shows as “paid” and proceed to final submit. Applications without successful fee payment (where applicable) will be treated as incomplete.

Final submission and print

  • Review all details carefully; edit if required before final submission, as no changes are allowed after final submit.

  • Click on “Final Submit” and generate your application form.

  • Download and take a printout of the e-receipt and submitted application form for future reference, online exam and interview/document verification stages.

General Instructions for Candidates

  • Apply online only; no other mode of application will be accepted.

  • Ensure you fall within the required age limits for Scale IV (20–45 years) and Scale III/II (20–35 years) with applicable relaxations as per Government/Bank rules.

  • Enter details exactly as per your certificates; any mismatch or false information may lead to rejection at any stage of the recruitment process.

  • Keep the registered mobile number and email ID active; all communication regarding exam date, admit card, interview schedule, etc., will be sent on these only.

  • Candidates are advised to complete the application process well before 30-04-2026 to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Indian Navy Agniveer (MR/Musician) Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational Qualification: Candidate must have passed Matriculation Examination with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from the Boards of School Education recognised by Ministry of Education, Govt. of India.

Age Limit: Born between 01 Jul 2004 – 31 Dec 2008 (both dates inclusive).

Marital Status: Only unmarried male and unmarried female candidates are eligible. Candidates will have to give a certificate of being 'unmarried' at the time of enrolment. Agniveers shall not be permitted to marry during their entire tenure of four years. Marriage during tenure will result in dismissal.

Musical Ability: The candidate should have proficiency and aptitude for music with accuracy in tempo, pitch and singing one complete song. He/She should also have actual practical skill on any instrument of Indian or foreign origin with proficiency in tuning of instrument, matching unknown notes with instrument, prepared piece, sight reading of Indian Classical/Tablature/Staff Notation, performance of Scale/Raaga/Taala and basic theory of Indian or International music.

Type of Instruments on which Proficiency Required: Candidates would be required to perform with expertise on one or more instruments such as Keyboard/String/Wind instruments or any other instrument of Indian or foreign origin. Candidates performing on indefinite pitch instruments such as Jazz Drum set, Bass Drum, Snare Drums, Side Drums, Cymbals, Non Chromatic instruments such as bugle & monotone instruments used to produce only one note or drone will not be eligible.

Musical Experience Certificate:

  • Candidates performing Hindustani or Carnatic Classical music on wind instruments will require a musical experience certificate from any recognized musical institute or organisation of repute.
  • A certificate of minimum initial grade from international boards such as Trinity College of Music, London or Royal School of Music London etc., will be mandatory for candidates performing western notation or western music on wind instruments.
  • Other candidates will be required to submit certificates of participation/awards presented at various events.

Physical Standards:

  • Minimum Height: 157 cm (Male & Female)
  • Visual Standards: 6/12, 6/12 (Uncorrected) | 6/6, 6/6 (Corrected) | CP Pass

Indian Navy Agniveer (MR/Musician) Recruitment 2026 Pay, Allowances & Benefits

Agniveers will be paid a package of ₹30,000 per month with a fixed yearly increment. In addition, risk and hardship, dress and travel allowances will be paid.

  • Life Insurance Cover: ₹48 Lakh (non-contributory)
  • Death Compensation: ₹44 Lakh (one-time ex-gratia) + Insurance
  • Disability Compensation: ₹44/25/15 Lakh (based on % disability)

Indian Navy Agniveer (MR/Musician) Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

Selection of recruits is based on the order of merit based on their performance in Music Ability Test.

  1. Shortlisting: Based on marks obtained in Matriculation examination (All India merit). Only candidates holding valid music certificates will be considered.
  2. Recruitment Process: Physical Fitness Test (PFT) → Written Examination → Music Ability Test → Recruitment Medical Examination.

  2. Music Ability Test: Qualifying for final selection.
  3. Recruitment Medical Examination & Pre-Enrolment Medicals at INS Chilka.

Final Merit List: Based on performance in Music Ability Test (All India basis).

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality

The candidate must be a citizen of India.

Educational Qualification

  • Must possess a BDS or equivalent Degree from a Medical College or Medical Institution recognized by the Dental Council of India (DCI).
  • Must possess a valid Registration Certificate under the Dentist Act, 1948.
  • Candidates having degrees from foreign universities must possess required Conversion Certificates recognized by DCI.

Additional Requirements

  • Houseman-ship/Internship Completion Certificate
  • Certificate relating to passing of the screening test conducted by the National Board of Examinations (for candidates from foreign universities)
  • Odia language test pass certificate, or must pass the required Odia examination within 4 years of joining service

Odia Language Requirement

Candidate must be able to read, write, and speak Odia and must have fulfilled any one of the following:

  • Passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject; OR
  • Passed Matriculation or equivalent examination with Odia as medium of examination in non-language subject; OR
  • Passed in Odia as language subject in the final examination of Class-VII or above; OR
  • Passed a test in Odia in Middle English School standard conducted by the School and Mass Education Department.

Proviso: If a candidate has not passed Middle School Examination in Odia as a language subject, he/she shall be required to pass the examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Odisha within 4 years of joining service. Failing this, no further increment will be sanctioned and promotion to Group-A (Senior Branch) will not be allowed.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Age Limit (as on 01 January 2026)

  • Minimum Age: 21 years
  • Maximum Age: 42 years
  • Candidate must not have been born earlier than 02 January 1984 and not later than 01 January 2005.

Age Relaxation

Category Upper Age Limit Relaxation
SEBC 5 years
SC 5 years
ST 5 years
Women candidates 5 years
Ex-Servicemen 5 years
PwBD (40% or more permanent disability) 10 years
PwBD belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories 15 years (cumulative benefit)
  • A candidate who comes under more than one category shall be eligible for only one benefit of upper age relaxation, whichever is more beneficial.
  • Exception: PwBD candidates belonging to SEBC/SC/ST categories shall be eligible for 15 years cumulative age relaxation.
  • Date of birth in High School Certificate or equivalent certificate issued by the concerned Board/Council will only be accepted.
  • Save as provided above, the age limits prescribed can in no case be relaxed.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Salary & Pay Scale

Selected candidates will be appointed in Level-12, Cell-1 of the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay (ORSP) Rules, 2017 and will also be entitled to Dearness Allowance (DA) and other admissible allowances as sanctioned by the Government from time to time.

SC, ST, PwBD candidates NIL (Exempted) Not applicable

  • Applications without payment of examination fee (except SC/ST/PwBD candidates) will be treated as incomplete and rejected.
  • Refunds will be processed to the original mode of payment used at the time of transaction.
  • Candidates must furnish bank account details in the online application form for refund in case of technical glitches.
  • Bank account must remain valid and active. The Commission will not entertain correspondence regarding incorrect bank details.

OPSC Dental Surgeon 2026 Selection Process

The selection shall be made on the basis of a Written Test as per the Odisha Medical Services (Method of Recruitment and Conditions of Service of Dental Surgeons) Rules, 2022 along with Amendment Rules, 2025.

Merit List Preparation

  • The Commission shall prepare a list of candidates in order of merit on the basis of the Written Test equal to the number of advertised vacancies.
  • If two or more candidates secure equal marks, the candidate securing higher marks in the BDS Examination will rank higher.
  • If marks in the BDS Examination are also equal, the candidate older in age will be placed above the younger candidate.
  • The recommendation list shall remain valid for one year from the date of recommendation or till the next recruitment is made by the Commission.
  • A Sports Person must secure the qualifying marks of his/her category for inclusion in the merit list.

Answer Key & Result

  • Provisional Answer Keys shall be uploaded on the website within 10 days of examination.
  • Candidates can submit objections/suggestions against the provisional answer key.
  • Candidates who do not challenge the provisional answer key shall forfeit their right to agitate the matter later.
  • Cut-off marks, answer keys, and individual marks will be declared only after publication of the final result and select list.

  1. Visit the official website: https://opsc.gov.in
  2. Read Advertisement No. 07 of 2025-26 carefully before applying.
  3. Click on the Apply Online link for Dental Surgeon recruitment from 17.03.2026 to 17.04.2026 (5:00 PM).
  4. Read detailed instructions available on the OPSC portal.
  5. Complete online registration to obtain a unique Permanent Public Service Account Number (PPSAN).
  6. Fill the automated online application form with accurate personal, contact, category, educational, registration, Odia test, and bank details.
  7. Upload scanned copies of required documents in the prescribed format and size.
  8. Upload recent passport size photograph, full signature, and left-hand thumb impression.
  9. Pay the examination fee online, if applicable.
  10. Verify all details carefully before final submission.
  11. Submit the application form successfully.
  12. Take a printout of the finally submitted application form for future reference.
  13. Note down your Application Number (USER ID) and PPSAN for future correspondence.

  • Keep at least four copies of the same passport size photograph used in the application.
  • Ensure all details are correct because the application process is automated and system driven.

  • The Admit Card will be uploaded on the OPSC website before the exam date.
  • Candidates must download and produce the admit card at the examination centre.
  • No separate communication will be made for admit card issuance.
  • Notice for document verification shall also be uploaded on the OPSC website.
  • Candidates qualified in the written exam must bring hard copy of the online application along with self-attested copies and originals of all required certificates for verification.
  • Each document copy must mention: “Submitted by me and Certified as genuine and has not been cancelled” with full signature and date.

DBT Note: An additional Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) amount of ₹4,000/month for Diploma Apprentices and ₹4,500/month for Graduate Apprentices is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme. The above stipend figures are inclusive of DBT wherever applicable. Candidates must have an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account.

Age Limit

Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years of age. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and other reserved categories will be applicable as per Government of India guidelines.

Reservation

Reservation will be followed as per the Apprentice Act 1961. Candidates claiming reservation must submit the requisite certificate in the prescribed Government format issued by the competent authority. Failure to do so will result in the candidate being treated as General category.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

There will be no written examination or interview. Selection will be entirely based on merit, calculated from the candidates' academic performance.

Graduate Apprentice

  • 10th Class: 20%
  • 12th/Diploma (higher of the two): 20%
  • Engineering/Graduation/PG:60%
  • Total:100

Diploma Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • Diploma in Engineering:70%
  • Total:100

ITI Technician

  • 10th Class:30%
  • ITI in Concerned Trade:70%
  • Total: 100

Preference in Selection

Based on merit, preference will be given in the following order:

  1. Candidates from Project Affected Families of the respective Project/Power Station.
  2. Candidates from the concerned district(s) of the State/UT where the project is located.
  3. Candidates from the State/UT where the project is located.
  4. Candidates from other States/UTs based on merit.

NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee

As per the official advertisement, no application fee has been prescribed for candidates applying for any category of NHPC Apprentice posts 2026.

How to Apply for NHPC Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The application process is online only and consists of two steps - first registering on the NAPS/NATS portal, then applying on the NHPC official website.

  1. Register on NAPS/NATS Portal: ITI trade candidates must register on NAPS at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Graduate/Diploma trade candidates must register on NATS at nats.education.gov.in. Complete your profile and upload all required documents.
  2. Note your Registration/Enrolment Number: After completing registration, note your NAPS/NATS enrolment number carefully - it will be required for the NHPC application form.
  3. Apply on NHPC Website: Visit nhpcindia.com → Career Section → Engagement of Apprentice → Apply Now. Fill in all required details including trade, personal information, educational qualifications, category and NAPS/NATS enrolment number.
  4. Upload Documents: Upload scanned copies of - NAPS/NATS Registration Form, 10th Marksheet (Age proof), ITI/Diploma/Degree Marksheets, SC/ST/OBC(NCL) Certificate (if applicable), recent passport-size colour photograph, and signature.
  5. Submit & Save: Review all entries carefully and submit the application before 06 May 2026, 5:00 PM. Save/print a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Note: candidates should apply for only one region/state/trade. 

Important: Applications made through any mode other than the NHPC official website will not be accepted. Candidates awaiting final results of qualifying examinations and those who have already undergone apprenticeship training of 1 year or more are not eligible to apply.
