CUPB Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications:

  • As per UGC Regulations on Minimum Qualifications for Appointment of Teachers and Other Academic Staff in Universities and Colleges, 2018 and amendments
  • For Department of Education (ITEP): As per Appendix-15 of NCTE (Recognition, Norms and Procedure) Amendment Regulations, 2021
  • For Department of Physical Education: As per NCTE Regulations 2014 and amendments
  • For Department of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning: As per AICTE Guidelines in addition to UGC Regulations
  • For Department of Applied Agriculture: Specific PG and PhD qualifications in relevant specialization required

Good Academic Record: Minimum 55% marks at Master's level and minimum 50% marks at Bachelor's level (or equivalent grades).

Age Limit: No candidate will be considered beyond 64 years of age for regular appointment.

For OCI Card Holders: Persons registered as Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) under Section 7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955 are also eligible to apply.

Reservations: SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PWD/EWS relaxations as per Government of India/UGC rules. OBC (NCL) and EWS certificates must be issued on or after 01.04.2026.

CUPB Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Application Fee

Category Fee
General / OBC / EWS Rs. 750/- per post
SC / ST / PWD / Women Exempted

Separate application along with fee must be submitted for each post applied for. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

CUPB Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Shortlisting: Based on API (Academic Performance Indicator) scores as per UGC Regulations. For one post, up to 25 candidates will be shortlisted; for two posts of the same category, up to 35 candidates. For posts with Concerned/Relevant/Allied subjects, top 13 from Concerned Subject group and top 12 from Relevant/Allied group will be called per post.

Selection: Direct recruitment through All India advertisement and selection by duly constituted Selection Committees. The process may include presentation/seminar/interview or a combination thereof.

Interview: Candidates may be interviewed in person or through Video Conferencing. SC/ST/PwD outstation candidates will be reimbursed to-and-fro rail fare (as per GoI Rules) for attending interview.

The University reserves the right to shortlist/select candidates as per specialization/research area requirement and to place a reasonable limit on total candidates called for interview.

How to Apply for CUPB Faculty Recruitment 2026

Step 1 – Visit the online application portal: curec.samarth.ac.in

Step 2 – Register and fill in a separate online application form for each post applied for, along with the required application fee.

Step 3 – Professors and Associate Professors must fill the API/Research Score form strictly in the format provided in UGC Regulations 2018 (Table 2 of Appendix II). Assistant Professor applicants must fill shortlisting criteria as per Table 3A of Appendix II.

Step 4 – Upload all required documents including qualification certificates, mark sheets, experience certificate (with Date of Joining, Date of Relieving, designation, pay scale, date of promotion), at least one salary slip per financial year for each claimed experience, Form-16 (for Non-Government organizations), NOC from employer (if currently employed in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Autonomous body), caste/disability/EWS certificate as applicable, and equivalence certificate for foreign PhD (if applicable).

Step 5 – Preview and verify all details before final submission. Incomplete applications or those without fee and required enclosures will be summarily rejected.

Step 6 – Submit the application before 27 April 2026 (05:00 PM IST). No hard copy of the application form should be sent to the University.

Step 7 – Retain a duly signed printout of the online application form along with all enclosures for future reference.

All corrigendum/amendments related to this advertisement will be uploaded on cup.edu.in only. Candidates must regularly check the university website, email, and SMS for updates.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Computer Based Online Test followed by Document Checking.

  • The online test will consist of two parts:
    • Part-I (Qualifying Test of Punjabi Language): 50 MCQs (mandatory). Minimum 50% marks (i.e., 25 marks) required to qualify. Failure in Part-I disqualifies the candidate irrespective of Part-II performance.
    • Part-II: 100 MCQs (Total 100 marks)
      • Questions related to the concerned discipline (Technical – Electrician/Wireman): 50
      • Punjabi Language Knowledge: 20
      • General Knowledge: 10
      • Reasoning: 10
      • Arithmetic: 10
  • Duration of exam: 3 hours (180 minutes).
  • All questions carry 1 mark each. No negative marking.
  • Part-II will be bilingual (English/Punjabi) except Punjabi questions which will be only in Punjabi.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in Part-II:
    • General Category: 25%
    • Reserve Category (SC/BC/EWS/Ex-Servicemen/FF/SP/PwD): 20%
  • Merit List: Prepared on the basis of marks scored in Part-II only (after normalization if exam held in multiple shifts). For Sports Person category, final merit prepared by Director/Sports, Punjab as per Sports Gradation Policy.
  • In case of tie, higher age candidate will be placed higher in merit.
  • Candidates qualifying the online test will be called for Document Checking as per merit.
  • Final selection panel will be prepared after successful document verification. Mere qualifying the test or appearing for document checking does not guarantee appointment.
  • Selected candidates will undergo 6-month Classroom + On-the-Job Training.
  • Probation period: 3 years (or as per Punjab Govt. instructions).

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through the official website of PSPCL. No other mode of application will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit www.pspcl.in → Click on “Recruitment” tab → “Recruitment for the post of Assistant Lineman against CRA 315/26”.
  2. Click on NEW REGISTRATION (or REGISTERED CANDIDATE if already registered).
  3. Fill Part-1 (Post Applied, Name, DOB, Father’s Name, Mobile, Email etc.) and verify OTP received on registered mobile/email.
  4. Fill complete online application form, upload scanned Photograph (20-50 KB) & Signature (10-20 KB) as per specifications.
  5. Accept Terms & Conditions and Self-declaration → Click Save and Preview → Submit.
  6. After submission, proceed to Pay Fee link (Internet Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card).
  7. After successful fee payment, login again → Check “Fee Status” (must show “Paid”).
  8. Click PRINT APPLICATION FORM and retain the printout for future reference.
  9. Candidates who have appeared in qualifying exam but result is awaited should write “RESULT AWAITED” in Year of Passing column but must possess the qualification by 06-05-2026.

General Instructions

  • Cut-off date for determining eligibility (age, qualification, experience etc.) is 01-01-2026. Candidates must possess required qualifications upto last date of online application (06-05-2026).
  • Only Punjab Domicile candidates are eligible for reservation benefits.
  • Category once filled in online application cannot be changed later. Wrong category application will be rejected.
  • Reservation for Women, Ex-Servicemen, PwD, EWS, Sports Person, Freedom Fighter as per Punjab Govt. rules.
  • PwD candidates must possess minimum 40% benchmark disability as per Annexure-A.
  • Candidates working in Govt./Semi-Govt./PSU must produce No Objection Certificate at the time of joining.
  • Mobile phones, electronic devices, ornaments etc. are strictly prohibited inside examination hall.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • PSPCL reserves the right to increase/decrease vacancies or cancel the entire recruitment without assigning any reason.
  • All future communications (admit card, result, document checking schedule etc.) will be sent only through registered email ID and uploaded on www.pspcl.in. Candidates must keep their email and mobile active.
  • In case of any ambiguity, decision of PSPCL shall be final and binding. Jurisdiction of any dispute shall be Local Courts at Patiala only.
  • Action against misconduct: Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, or furnishing false information will be disqualified and may face criminal prosecution.

How to Apply for CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026

Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online only through the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website. Follow the steps given below to submit your application form.

Visit Official Website

  • Go to the official CSC e‑Governance Services Indian website: csc.gov.in.

  • On the homepage, navigate to the Recruitment/Careers/Latest Opening section.

Open Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Application Link

  • Find and click on the notification/link titled “CSC e‑Governance Services Indian Aadhaar Supervisor/ Operator Recruitment 2026” or similar.

  • Click on the Apply Online button to proceed to the application page.

Registration (New Users)

  • Click on New Registration (if applying for the first time).

  • Enter basic details such as Name, Mobile Number, Email ID, Date of Birth, and create a password.

  • Submit the details to generate your Registration ID and Password (note these for future login).

Login and Fill Application Form

  • Login using your Registration ID and Password.

  • Fill in the online application form carefully with personal details, contact details, educational qualification, Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator certificate details, and preferred state/district.

  • Ensure that all details match your certificates and Aadhaar data.

Upload Documents

  • Upload scanned copies of the following documents in the prescribed format and size (as mentioned in the notification):

    • Recent passport size photograph

    • Signature

    • 10th/12th/ITI/Polytechnic Diploma certificates and mark sheets

    • Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor Certificate issued by UIDAI‑authorized Testing & Certifying Agency

    • Any other documents required as per notification

  • Preview the uploaded documents and confirm that they are clear and readable.

Application Fee Payment (If Applicable)

  • Check the Application Fee section in the official notification.

  • If any fee is prescribed, pay it online through available modes such as Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.

  • After successful payment, download/print the fee receipt.

Final Submission

  • Carefully review all the details filled in the application form in the Preview section.

  • If required, make corrections before final submission.

  • Click on Final Submit to complete the application process.

Print Application Form

  • After successful submission, download and take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

  • Keep the Registration ID, Password, and printout safe for further recruitment stages.

The competitive examination will be conducted through Online Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 100 objective type multiple-choice questions (MCQ).

  • Punjabi Language Knowledge: 20
  • General Knowledge: 10

NARL Recruitment 2026 Events Important Dates & Time
Release of NARL Scientist/Engineer SD & SC Notification 2026 (NARL/RMT/SD&SC/01/2026) 06 March 2026
Release of NARL JRF Notification 2026 (NARL/RMT/JRF/02/2026) 06 March 2026

Last date to submit NARL JRF online application 2026 27 April 2026 (23:59 hrs IST)

NARL Scientist, Engineer & JRF Eligibility Criteria 2026

Candidates must satisfy the NARL eligibility criteria 2026 in terms of educational qualification and age limit for the respective posts as on the closing date 27.04.2026.

  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’: Ph.D. in Physics/Atmospheric Sciences/Meteorology/Earth Science/Environmental Science or equivalent from a recognised university with prior M.Sc./MS in relevant discipline having minimum 60% marks or equivalent CGPA.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’: M.E./M.Tech in RF, Microwave and Communication System Engineering in first class with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA and B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering in first class with minimum 65% marks or equivalent CGPA from a recognised university.
  • Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Postgraduate degree in Physics/Atmospheric Science/Space Physics/Meteorology/Earth System Sciences/Geophysics/Remote Sensing/Applied Chemistry with required minimum 65% marks or equivalent CGPA or relevant M.E./M.Tech with 60% along with qualification in CSIR‑UGC NET / GATE / JAM / JEST as specified.
  • Age Limit: Scientist/Engineer SD - maximum 35 years; Scientist/Engineer SC - maximum 30 years; JRF - preferably 28 years as on last date; upper age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/Ex‑servicemen as per Government of India rules.

NARL Scientist, Engineer & JRF Salary 2026

Selected candidates under NARL Scientist/Engineer & JRF Recruitment 2026 will receive pay and fellowship as per 7th CPC and NARL norms.

  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SD’: Level‑11, basic pay Rs. 67,700/- per month (Rs. 67,700 - 2,08,700) plus admissible HRA and Transport Allowance and other benefits.
  • Scientist/Engineer ‘SC’: Level‑10, basic pay Rs. 56,100/- per month (Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500) plus admissible HRA and Transport Allowance and other central government facilities.
  • Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Rs. 37,000/- per month for 1st & 2nd year and Rs. 42,000/- per month for subsequent years along with admissible allowances, hostel facility or HRA, medical facilities and subsidised canteen as per rules.

NARL Scientist, Engineer & JRF Application Fees 2026

The NARL Scientist/Engineer & JRF 2026 advertisements do not mention any specific application fee for submitting the online application form. Candidates are therefore expected to complete the NARL online registration and upload documents without payment of fee, and should follow only the official instructions on narl.gov.in regarding any future update on fees.

NARL Scientist, Engineer & JRF Application Form 2026

The online application process for NARL Scientist/Engineer & JRF Recruitment 2026 will start on 28th March 2026 and the last date to submit the NARL online application form is 27th April 2026 (23:59 hrs IST). Candidates must visit the official website narl.gov.in and complete their NARL Scientist/Engineer SD, SC & JRF Application Form 2026 in online mode before the last date; applications through any other mode will not be accepted.

Click to Apply for NARL Scientist/Engineer & JRF Recruitment 2026

Download NARL Scientist/Engineer SD & SC Notification 2026 PDF (NARL/RMT/SD&SC/01/2026)

Download NARL JRF Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF (NARL/RMT/JRF/02/2026)

NARL Scientist, Engineer & JRF Selection Process 2026

The NARL Scientist/Engineer & JRF Selection Process 2026 is primarily based on shortlisting and interview as per the respective notifications.

  • For Scientist/Engineer SD & SC: NARL may adopt shortlisting criteria such as higher educational qualifications, higher relevant experience, experience counted after essential qualification, and number of publications in peer‑reviewed journals to restrict candidates called for interview, followed by personal interview only.
  • For JRF: Candidates will be shortlisted based on academic records, NET/GATE/JAM/JEST and other credentials, and called for interview; sleeper class train fare will be reimbursed to interview attendees as per rules.

How to Apply for NARL Scientist, Engineer & JRF Recruitment 2026

Candidates have to apply online for NARL Scientist/Engineer & JRF Recruitment 2026 through the official website within the given dates.

  • Step 1 - Visit NARL official website: Go to www.narl.gov.in and open the recruitment/ careers section to find the links for Advertisement No. NARL/RMT/SD&SC/01/2026 and NARL/RMT/JRF/02/2026 and the online application form.
  • Step 2 - Register and fill NARL online application form 2026: Complete one‑time registration, then log in and fill in personal details, educational qualifications, experience, publications and other required information for the relevant post code.
  • Step 3 - Upload photo & documents: Upload recent passport size photograph and academic credentials (marksheets, degree certificates, category certificates, experience details and, for SD post, consolidated PDF of post‑doctoral/research experience and publications; for JRF, relevant research/awards file) within the prescribed size limits.
  • Step 4 - Submit application before last date: Submit the NARL online application form on or before 27 April 2026 (23:59 hrs); applications through any other mode will be summarily rejected.
  • Step 5 - Preserve registration number & follow updates: Note the online registration number for future reference and regularly check your email and the NARL website for interview call letters, schedule, and any corrigendum regarding NARL Scientist/Engineer & JRF Recruitment 2026.

AP High Court Vacancy 2026 Details

The AP High Court Recruitment 2026 announces a total of 300 posts with community-wise reservation (121 General/OC, 33 EWS, 24 BC-A, 26 BC-B, 3 BC-C, 19 BC-D, 12 BC-E, 4 SC-A, 20 SC-B, 20 SC-C, 18 SC-D, and ST). AP High Court Eligibility Criteria 2026

AP High Court eligibility criteria include age limit, educational qualification and other conditions. All conditions must be fulfilled as on 01.01.2026.

Age Limit & Relaxation 2026

Particulars Details
Minimum Age 18 years (as on 01.01.2026)
Maximum Age 42 years (as on 01.01.2026)

Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen As per Rule 12(1)(c)(i) of AP State and Subordinate Service Rules
Age Relaxation for Sports Quota As per respective community/category

AP High Court Educational Qualification 2026

Educational and professional qualifications for AP High Court Recruitment 2026 are post-specific and must be from Government-recognised universities/institutions.

  • Section Officer: Degree in Law (3 or 5 years course). Preference for computer skills.
  • Senior System Officer: B.Tech (CSE/ECE/EEE/IT)/M.Sc. Computer Science + Certificate with 5 years work experience on Networking and Server Maintenance Administration.
  • Computer Operator: Degree in Computer Science + Typewriting English Higher Grade (45 w.p.m.).
  • Assistant Librarian: Degree in Law (3 or 5 years) + B.Li.Sc. + Computer skills certificate for library maintenance.
  • Librarian Grade-II: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Law + B.Li.Sc.
  • U.D. Stenographer: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Law + Shorthand English (120 w.p.m.) + Typewriting English Higher Grade (45 w.p.m.).
  • Assistant/Examiner/Copyist: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Law.
  • Typist: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Law + Typewriting English Higher Grade (45 w.p.m.).
  • Data Entry Operator: Degree with Computer Science as main subject + Typewriting English Higher Grade (45 w.p.m.).
  • Stenographer: Degree in Arts/Science/Commerce/Law + Shorthand English (80 w.p.m.) + Typewriting English Higher Grade (45 w.p.m.).
  • Office Subordinate: Pass in 7th Class or equivalent. Candidates who failed Intermediate or equivalent will be considered but those with higher qualifications will not be eligible.

AP High Court Selection Process 2026

The AP High Court Selection Process 2026 includes two stages:

Stage 1: Computer Based Examination

  • Section Officer: General Knowledge (20 Marks) + Mental Ability (10 Marks) + Law Civil/Criminal (50 Marks) = 80 Marks
  • All Other Degree Posts: General Knowledge (40 Marks) + Mental Ability (40 Marks) = 80 Marks
  • Office Subordinate: General Knowledge (50 Marks) + Mental Ability (30 Marks) = 80 Marks
  • Total Questions: 80 (Each 1 mark)
  • Duration: 90 Minutes
  • Language: English and Telugu (English version final)
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: 40% (OC/EWS), 35% (BC), 30% (SC/ST/PwBD)

Stage 2: Skill Test (For Selected Posts Only)

  • Applicable for: Senior System Officer, Computer Operator, U.D. Stenographer, Stenographer, Typist, Copyist, Data Entry Operator
  • Computer Based Examination marks used for screening only (not added to final merit)
  • Final selection based ONLY on Skill Test performance
  • Skill Test mode and particulars will be uploaded on aphc.gov.in

Merit List Preparation

  • For Section Officer, Assistant Librarian, Librarian Gr.-II, Assistant, Examiner, Office Subordinate: Merit based on Computer Based Examination marks
  • For Senior System Officer, Computer Operator, U.D. Stenographer, Stenographer, Typist, Copyist, DEO: Merit based ONLY on Skill Test marks

Physical Standards

Candidates must meet the following minimum physical standards (male only; no relaxation allowed at any stage):

Category Height Chest (Only for Males)
UR / OBC / EWS 168 cm Without expansion: 81 cm With expansion: 86 cm
SC / ST / Maratha 165 cm Without expansion: 79 cm With expansion: 84 cm
Gorkha / Nepali / Kumaon 158 cm Without expansion: 76 cm With expansion: 81 cm
  • Minimum 5 cm chest expansion is mandatory wherever applicable.
  • No relaxation in physical standards for any category.
  • Measurement will be done by the committee on the notified date. Late reporting will not be allowed.

Selection Process

Recruitment will be conducted in three phases:

  1. Skill Test (Screening – Phase-I)
    • Candidates will be tested on any one instrument from List “A” (mandatory).
    • This is a qualifying test only (no marks).
    • Only successful candidates will proceed to Phase-II.
  2. Band Vadana Test (Phase-II – 75 Marks)
    • Trade Test (List “A” instrument): 60 Marks
    • Bonus Marks (List “B” instruments): 15 Marks (5 marks per instrument, maximum 15)
    • Minimum qualifying marks:
      • UR / OBC / EWS: 50%
      • SC / ST: 40%
    • Three times the number of advertised posts (vertical category-wise) will be called for Interview based on cut-off.
  3. Interview (Phase-III – 25 Marks)
    • Based on trade knowledge, personality, general knowledge, expression, sports, etc.
    • Final merit list prepared on the basis of Band Vadana Test (75 marks) + Interview (25 marks) = 100 marks.
  • Tie Breaker: Higher age will get preference.
  • Final selection is subject to Document Verification, Medical Examination and Character Verification.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through MP Online portal.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit the official MP Online website and register.
  2. Fill the online application form with all mandatory details.
  3. Upload required documents and recent photograph.
  4. Pay the application fee online (if applicable).
  5. Submit the form and take printout of the application for future reference.
  6. Keep the Application Number safe – it will be required to download the admit card.
  7. Aadhaar registration is mandatory.

Note: Only male candidates are eligible. Female candidates need not apply.

General Instructions

  • Candidates must be Indian citizens and MP domicile for reservation/age relaxation benefits.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee eligibility or call for test.
  • Candidates must carry original photo ID (Voter ID, PAN, Aadhaar, Driving Licence or Passport) + Aadhaar card / e-Aadhaar / Aadhaar number / VID at every stage.
  • All required original certificates (age, education, caste, HG/Ex-Servicemen etc.) must be produced at Document Verification.
  • Government / Semi-Government employees must submit NOC from their employer at the time of joining.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification.
  • No TA/DA will be paid except for SC/ST candidates appearing in Band Vadana Test / Interview (as per rules).
  • The number of vacancies may increase or decrease.
  • Selected candidates will be on 3 years probation and must complete mandatory training.
  • Selected candidates will not be posted in their home district.
  • They must serve in the allotted unit for a minimum of 5 years before any transfer.
  • All disputes will be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts in Bhopal.
  • MP Police reserves the right to cancel/modify the recruitment process without assigning any reason.
  • All updates will be sent via e-mail, SMS & WhatsApp only.
  • Candidates are advised to regularly check the official MP Police / MP Online website.

Selection Process

Selection will be made based on the Marks scored in NCTVT (NAC) and Trade Test / Practical Test only, in the order of Merit.

  • Priority & Preference Order:
    1. First Preference: AOCP Trade apprentices of Ordnance Factories and AOCP Trade apprentices from Government/Private Organizations having Government affiliation.
    2. Second Preference: Feeder trade candidates (IMCP, MMCP, PPO, Fitter, Machinist, Turner, etc.) who have experience of working as DBW/CPW on tenure basis and possess certificate of 03 months training (1 month extensive in-house training w.r.t. Safe Handling of explosives, ammunitions, safety norms, Do’s & Don’ts + 2 months On-Job training) from any MIL group of Ordnance Factories.
    3. Third Preference: Feeder trade candidates (IMCP, MMCP, PPO, Fitter, Machinist, Turner, etc.) from Ordnance Factories / Government/Private Organizations having Government affiliation but without 03 months training certificate.
  • Merit List Preparation:
    • Weightage: 80% NCTVT (NAC) Exam + 20% Trade Test / Practical Test.
    • Cut-off percentage for calling candidates for Trade Test will be decided by Ordnance Factory Khamaria based on NAC marks.
    • Merit list prepared category-wise / discipline-wise.
  • Document Verification: Candidates qualifying in NCTVT (NAC) + Trade Test will be called for Document Verification in order of merit. Number of candidates called will be limited to the number of posts notified. Additional candidates will be called in case of rejections.
  • Tie Resolution (in this order):
    1. Ex-Trade Apprentice of AOCP Trade.
    2. Ex-Trade Apprentice of Ordnance Factories.
    3. Higher marks in NAC issued from NCVT.
    4. Date of Birth (elder candidate preferred).

Note: After selection, AOCP candidates (non-Ordance Factory apprentices) and all feeder trade candidates will undergo compulsory 1 month extensive in-house training (and additional 2 months On-Job training for feeder trades) on safe handling of explosives before deployment.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Offline only

Steps to Apply:

  1. Download the Application Form from the official website.
  2. Fill the application form in BLOCK LETTERS only.

  • Only the date of birth as recorded in the 10th (High School) marksheet will be accepted. Candidates must mention the same name, father's name, and date of birth in the online application as in their High School marksheet.

    • SC/ST/OBC/Divyangjan/Government Employees/Nagar Sainik/Women (Unreserved/Reserved): 5 years relaxation in upper age limit as per MP Government order Saa.Pra.Vib. No. Ci.3-8/2016/1/3 dated 04 July 2019.
    • Ex-Servicemen: Age reduced by length of defence service; resultant age must not exceed upper age limit by more than 3 years.
    • Intercaste married couple (Anusuchit Jati-Savarna) under Promotion Scheme: 5 years.
    • Vikram Puraskar awardee sportspersons: 5 years.
    • In no case should the maximum age exceed 45 years after all relaxations.

Category Examination Fee
MP Domicile SC / ST / OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) / EWS / Divyangjan candidates ₹250/-

  • Late Application Fee (after 28.05.2026 to 28.10.2026): ₹25,000/- additional.
  • Error correction fee: ₹50/- per correction (up to 28.10.2026).
  • Fee once paid will not be refunded except in the case of advertisement cancellation by the Commission, in which case fee will be returned online to the candidate's account.

Selection Process

  • Written Examination (OMR Based):
    • Objective type questions on OMR sheet will be conducted.
    • Negative Marking (Rnnatmak Mulyankan) is applicable.
    • Exam centres: Indore, Bhopal, Jabalpur and Gwalior.
    • Exam Plan and Syllabus will be published on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in in due course.
    • Candidates up to a maximum of three times the notified vacancies (category-wise) will be shortlisted for interview based on written exam marks.
  • Interview (Viva Voce / Saakshaatkar):
    • Candidates shortlisted from the written examination will be called for interview.
    • Interview total marks: 100. Minimum qualifying marks for Unreserved category: 41; for Reserved categories and Divyangjan: 31.
    • Final selection will be based on the merit order of aggregate marks (written examination + interview).
    • Candidates absent from interview will be considered ineligible for selection.
  • If total applicants are less than 500: Selection will be based on interview only. Candidates will be shortlisted directly for interview as per the following ratio: 1 post – up to 12 candidates; 2–3 posts – up to 24; 4–6 posts – up to 36; 7–9 posts – up to 48; 10 posts and above – up to 50 candidates or 5 times the vacancies.
  • Post-Answer Key Process: Provisional answer key will be published on the Commission's website after the exam. Objections can be submitted within 05 days at ₹150/- per question (plus ₹40/- portal charge). Final answer key will be published after expert committee review. No objections will be entertained after publication of the final answer key.

General Information / Instructions

  • All amendments/instructions issued by the Government from time to time regarding age, domicile, employment exchange registration, reservation etc. will be incorporated into the final selection result.
  • The syllabus is attached in Bhaag-"H" of the notification and will be published on the Commission's website www.mppsc.mp.gov.in.
  • Cut-off marks of written exam and interview will not be disclosed prior to final selection.
  • If a computer or clerical error is noticed after declaration of result, the Commission reserves the right to correct it.
  • Reserved category seats (SC/ST/OBC) and age relaxation benefits are available only to Madhya Pradesh domicile candidates. Candidates from other states will be considered as Unreserved.
  • In any reserved category, if no eligible female candidate is available, the reserved seats will be filled by male candidates of the same category.
  • Divyangjan (Persons with Disabilities) candidates must attach the latest valid disability certificate issued by the District Medical Board constituted as per Ministry notification F-8-1-Satreh-Medi-2, dated 09.01.2009. Disability certificate issued after 01.06.2021 must be from the UID portal http://www.swavlambancard.gov.in. Manually issued certificates after that date will be invalid. Minimum 40% permanent disability is required to claim reservation and other benefits.
  • Candidates who are in Government service (temporary, daily wage, contractual, or under public undertakings) must submit an Undertaking that they have informed their Head of Department/office about applying for this post.
  • All information published regarding this recruitment notification including result will be available only on www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Commission will not communicate through Email/letters/phone individually.
  • EWS (Economically Weaker Section) certificate valid for financial year 2026-27 must be held by the candidate by the last date of online application i.e. 20.05.2026.
  • OBC candidates must ensure they are not in the Creamy Layer. Non-Creamy Layer declaration as per the prescribed proforma must be submitted.
  • Final selection result for OBC reservation is subject to the pending court cases SLP 8764/2023 and WP5596/2024 and related matters. The result will be declared in Main Part (87%) and Provisional Part (13%) as per MP Govt. order dated 29.09.2022.
  • Disqualifications under MP Civil Services Rules 1961: Candidates convicted of crimes against women, candidates with more than 2 living children (where one was born on or after 26 January 2001) are not eligible for appointment.

How to Apply

  • Online applications must be submitted at www.mppsc.mp.gov.in. Applications through any other means will not be accepted.
  • Online application window: 21-04-2026 to 20-05-2026.
  • Before filling the form, prepare a recent passport-size colour photograph scan and signature scan file as per instructions in the notification.
  • Fee can be paid via Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, or at M.P. Online authorized kiosks in cash.
  • After filling the form, a popup window will display basic information (name, parents' names, date of birth, category, gender) for verification. If any error is found, click Cancel to go back and correct. Click OK to submit. After successful submission, the application number will be generated (status will be Unpaid until fee is paid).
  • After submitting, click "Proceed for Payment" to complete fee payment. After successful payment, the application will be received and "Payment Done" will be displayed. Take a printout of the application form and preserve the application number for future reference.
  • Error Correction Facility: Online application correction can be done from 26.04.2026 to 22.05.2026 (till 12:00 midnight) at ₹50/- per correction. Applications submitted with late fee: corrections allowed up to 28.10.2026 at ₹50/- per correction.
  • Category/Gender/Date of Birth cannot be changed after the error correction period ends.
  • Candidates must ensure their signature is consistent across all documents; mismatch of signatures on various documents will lead to cancellation of candidature.
  • No documents need to be uploaded at the time of online application. However, before the interview, attested self-certified documents must be submitted to the Commission as per the detailed checklist in Annexure/Parishisht-01 of the notification.

Selection Process

Selection will be made through Personal Interview of the provisionally shortlisted candidates.

  • Shortlisting of candidates for Personal Interview shall be done (on or before the date of Interview as per the discretion of management) based on the scrutiny of the applications against the information, declaration and supporting documents provided by the candidate at the time of submission of online application.
  • The mode of selection may be changed, if required, at the discretion of Management.
  • Final selection will be based on performance in the Personal Interview and verification of documents.
  • List of shortlisted candidates, date, time and venue of interview will be uploaded on MECON’s official website and communicated through registered email ID.
  • Candidates must produce all original certificates/documents in support of their claim at the time of interview.
  • Further scrutiny of the application shall be undertaken on the date of Personal Interview. If any claim made in the application is not found substantiated, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview and no TA shall be paid.
  • The decision of MECON in all matters relating to eligibility, shortlisting and selection shall be final and binding.
  • Appointment is on regular basis in the regular scale of pay. Selected candidates will be appointed against regular posts.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through MECON website. No other mode (post, email, offline) will be accepted.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit MECON website www.meconlimited.co.in → Careers → Career Opportunities → Click here to apply Online.
  2. Read all instructions carefully before filling the online application.
  3. Fill all required details in the online application form and upload scanned copies of the following documents:
    • Recent passport size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
    • Signature (Blue/Black ink, jpg/jpeg, max 40 KB)
    • Self-attested scanned copies in PDF format (merged into single PDF ≤ 1 MB) of: Matriculation certificate, Graduation/Post-Graduation certificates & mark sheets, Work Experience certificates, Caste/Category certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, etc.
  4. Pay the application fee (if applicable) online through the payment gateway.
  5. Submit the application and take a printout of the online application form for your records.
  6. Candidates applying for multiple posts must submit separate applications for each post.
  7. Applications without fee (where applicable), incomplete or incorrectly filled will be summarily rejected.

Application Fee: ₹1000/- (Non-Refundable) for OBC (NCL)/EWS category. Exempted for SC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen/Internal candidates.

Note: No hard copy of application or documents is required to be sent. Hard copy of online application is required only at the time of interview (if called).

General Instructions

  • Cut-off date for determining eligibility (age, qualification, experience) is 10-03-2026.
  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Reservations for SC/OBC(NCL)/PwD/EWS/Ex-Servicemen shall be provided as per Govt. of India guidelines. PwD reservation is on horizontal basis.
  • Age relaxation: 3 years for OBC(NCL), 5 years for SC, additional relaxation for PwD/Ex-Servicemen/J&K domicile as per rules. Upper age limit after relaxation shall not exceed 52 years.
  • Candidates belonging to OBC(NCL) must produce latest OBC(NCL) certificate (not more than 1 year old) and must not belong to Creamy Layer.
  • PwD candidates must upload certificate showing ≥40% disability.
  • Candidates employed in Govt/PSU/Autonomous bodies must produce NOC from present employer at the time of interview or forward application through proper channel.
  • All appointments are subject to medical fitness as per Company’s norms.
  • Place of posting can be anywhere in India as per requirement of the Company.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.
  • Mere submission of application does not guarantee selection.
  • MECON reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify the recruitment process without assigning any reason.
  • Any dispute arising out of this recruitment shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Courts at Ranchi (Jharkhand) only.
  • All correspondences will be sent only through registered email ID provided in the online application. Candidates are advised to keep their email ID and mobile number active.
  • For any queries, candidates may write to [email protected] or contact 0651-2483571/2483043 on working days.

Selection Process

The mode of selection shall be through Computer Based Test (CBT) of the candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria as per the advertisement. The mode of selection may be changed, if required, at the discretion of Management.

Computer Based Test (CBT):

  • Question paper will be bilingual (English/Hindi).

  • Each question carries 1 mark.

  • 0.25 negative marking for each incorrect answer.

  • Total duration of the test is 90 minutes.

Test Structure:

Subject/Section Assistant (Administration / Secretarial Service) Assistant (HR) / Accountant
General Awareness & Current Affairs 15 10
Quantitative Aptitude 20 10
Logical Reasoning 20 10
English Language 15 10
Computer Awareness 10 10
Domain Knowledge (Post Specific) 20 50
Grand Total 100 100
  • Finalization of eligible candidates for CBT will be done before the date of CBT based on scrutiny of online applications and uploaded documents.
  • Admit Card will be available for download on Candidate Registration Portal.
  • Result and final list of selected candidates will be uploaded on MECON website.
  • Selected candidates will undergo Medical Examination at Company’s Hospital (Ispat Hospital, Shyamali, Ranchi). The decision of the Medical Board will be final and binding.

How to Apply

Application Mode: Online only through the official website https://www.meconlimited.co.in (Careers → Career Opportunities → Click here to apply Online). No other mode of submission of application is allowed.

Steps to Apply:

  1. Visit MECON website www.meconlimited.co.in → Careers → Career Opportunities → Click here to apply Online.
  2. Register and fill the online application form with all required details.
  3. Upload scanned copies of: Recent passport size colour photograph (jpg/jpeg, ≤2 MB), signature (jpg/jpeg, ≤2 MB), and self-attested documents in PDF format (Matriculation certificate, BBA / Intermediate marksheets / certificates, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, category certificates etc.).
  4. Pay the prescribed application fee online through MECON’s Payment Gateway.
  5. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.
  6. Keep checking the MECON website regularly for updates, admit card, result etc.

General Instructions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • Candidates employed in Central / State Government, Public Sector Enterprises or Autonomous Bodies must produce No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their present employer at the time of registration and upload the same.
  • Candidates must upload valid SC / ST / OBC (NCL) / EWS / PwD / Ex-Servicemen certificates as per Govt. of India format (not more than 1 year old for OBC(NCL)).
  • Aadhaar Card is mandatory for online application and uploading. Any mismatch in Aadhaar number will lead to summary rejection.
  • A candidate can submit online application for one post only. No modifications are allowed after submission.
  • Mere submission of application does not confer any right for employment. Final selection is subject to document verification and medical fitness.
  • Canvassing in any form shall disqualify the candidature.
  • All future communications / announcements will be made only through MECON website www.meconlimited.co.in and registered email ID. Candidates are advised to visit the website regularly and keep the same email ID & mobile number active for at least 1 year.
  • Any dispute with regard to recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Ranchi (Jharkhand) only.
  • Decision of Chairman & Managing Director, MECON Limited in all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, mode of selection etc. shall be final and binding on the candidates.

NPCIL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Selection Process

Candidates are shortlisted for Personal Interview based on GATE 2024/2025/2026 scores in a 1:12 ratio (discipline and category wise). GATE score carries no weightage in the final selection — final selection is purely based on Personal Interview performance and medical fitness.

Stage Details
Shortlisting Based on GATE 2024/2025/2026 score (1:12 ratio, merit list discipline & category wise)
Personal Interview Tentatively 8–19 June 2026 at Mumbai, NAPS (UP), MAPS (Tamil Nadu), KGS (Karnataka)
Qualifying marks (Interview) UR — 70% | EWS/SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD — 60%
Tie-breaking Higher GATE score → if still tied, senior in age ranks higher
Medical fitness Mandatory — by NPCIL's authorised medical officer
Bond Rs. 9,18,000/- indemnity bond + service bond for minimum 3 years after training

NPCIL Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 – Training Details

Selected candidates undergo a one-year orientation training at one of NPCIL's Nuclear Training Centres (NTC). Candidates in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Electronics, and Instrumentation disciplines must choose a Reactor Stream — either Pressurised Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR) or Light Water Reactor (LWR). Selection Process

  • Stage 1 – Combined Pre-Examination (Samyukt Purva Pariksha): All three posts share a common preliminary examination. The pre-exam carries 100 marks.
  • Stage 2 – Main Examination (Mukhya Pariksha): Candidates shortlisted from the Combined Pre-Examination are eligible to appear for the Main Examination of the respective post. The Main Examination carries 400 marks for Maharashtra Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Combined Service Main Examination.
  • Stage 3 – Physical Test (for Police Sub-Inspector only): Physical endurance test of 100 marks is conducted. Qualifying marks: minimum 60 out of 100 (i.e., 60 marks). Candidates scoring below 60 marks are not eligible for interview/further process. Candidates scoring below 60 marks will also not be considered for final selection.
  • The final result will be declared based on the combined merit of the Main Examination marks and Physical Test marks (for Police Sub-Inspector). 
  • The examination type and process for each post shall follow the service entry rules as below:
    • Assistant Section Officer, Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Service Entry Rules 2018.
    • State Tax Inspector (Tax Collector Inspector) Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Service Entry Rules 2021.
    • Police Sub-Inspector, Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Service Entry Rules 1995.
  • The final result process for the Combined Pre-Examination and Main Examination shall be as per the present Examination Scheme / Method published on the Commission's website. 

How to Apply

  • Applications are accepted only through the Commission's Online Application System at https://mpsconline.gov.in. 
  • Step 1 (One): If you have not previously registered on the Commission's Online Application Portal, create a new Profile (Account) and register. If you already have an account, log in and update your profile if necessary.
  • Step 2 (Two): Ensure your account is active and complete KYC verification through the Commission's portal before applying.
  • Step 3 (Three): Complete the KYC (Know Your Customer) process on the Commission's website. The KYC process must be completed as per official Advt. No. ADR-2425/SER.06/2025/MA.TAN. published on 20 June 2025, within the valid period available in the account. The KYC process in the account must be completed independently. 
  • Step 4 (Four): Upload required documents (as applicable) in PDF format within the prescribed file size limits (minimum 50 KB, maximum 500 KB per file)
  • Step 5 (Five): Pay the examination fee online (Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking) or offline (Challan at Indian State Bank branch).
  • Step 6 (Six): Select the district examination centre.
  • Step 7 (Seven): As per the Combined Pre-Examination notification, candidates must apply online via the Commission's Computer System for the Maharashtra Group-B (Non-Gazetted) Combined Pre-Examination. 
  • Step 8 (Eight): Based on the Reserved and Unreserved total vacancy count from the Combined Pre-Examination, the number of candidates eligible for the Main Examination will be determined, and a combined merit result of Maharashtra Group-B (Non-Gazetted) service candidates will be declared. 
  • Admit Cards for the examination will be made available on the Commission's Online Application Portal (https://mpsconline.gov.in) 7 days before the examination date. Download the Admit Card and produce it at the examination centre.
  • The Admit Card cannot be issued to candidates themselves; it must be downloaded by the candidate from the Commission portal. 
  • After the Admit Card is made available, the candidate's registered mobile number will receive an SMS notification

General Information / Instructions

  • There are a total of 37 district examination centres across Maharashtra for this examination. (Page 1)
  • Candidates who pass the Combined Pre-Examination and qualify for the Main Examination shall declare the Main Examination date themselves.
  • Applications are accepted only through the Commission's Online Application System. 
  • Application portal: https://mpsconline.gov.in and also available at https://mpsc.gov.in. 
  • Applications will not be considered without payment of the prescribed examination fee
  • KYC verification through the Commission's portal (Advt. No. ADR-2425/SER.06/2025/MA.TAN., dated 20 June 2025) must be completed within the prescribed period before applying. 
  • Candidates who claim Economically Weaker Section (EWS) reservation must upload the income/asset certificate for the year 2025–2026 or 2026–2027 by the last acceptance date (30 April 2026). 
  • Candidates who claim Sports Quota reservation must upload the Sports Certificate (Government Decision dated 01 July 2016) along with the application before the deadline. 
  • Divyang (PWD) candidates must upload valid UDID Card (Universal Identification Card) and relevant disability certificate
  • If the Sports Certificate submitted along with the application is not available, or if the document submitted on or before the prescribed date was not complete/valid, then the Sports Reservation claim shall not be accepted. 
  • Candidates must select a district examination centre at the time of applying. Once a district centre is chosen, it cannot be changed under any circumstances.
  • The following documents must be uploaded by reserved category candidates at the time of applying
    • Proof of Social Category (Caste Certificate) – PDF, Min 50 KB, Max 500 KB
    • Economically Weaker Section certificate for year 2025–2026 or 2026–2027 – PDF
    • Valid Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for year 2025–2026 or 2026–2027 – PDF
    • Proof of eligible PWD/Divyang status – PDF
    • Proof of Ex-Serviceman status – PDF
    • Sports Quota Eligibility proof (for Pre-Exam: Sports Proof of Sports Participation Report or Sports Proof document submission record as applicable) – PDF
    • Proof of Anath (Orphan) Reservation eligibility – PDF
    • Domicile Proof for Backward Class, Divyang, Ex-Serviceman, Anath reservation claim – PDF
  • After appointment, selected candidates must have the following educational/professional qualifications:
    • Where departmental/professional examination is compulsory, the candidate must pass such examination as per departmental norms.
    • Hindi and Marathi language proficiency examinations as per applicable rules. 
    • Computer literacy certificate/proof as per Government Resolution (GR) dated 04 February 2013 (Maharashtra IT GR) and revised GR dated 01 July 2016. 
  • Use of mobile phone or any electronic device at the exam hall, examination venue, physical test, or interview venue is strictly prohibited.
  • Candidates must submit all original documents at the time of document verification; failure to do so will render them ineligible for selection/appointment. 
  • This notification is available on the Commission's website: https://mpsc.gov.in and https://mpsconline.gov.in.

Electronics Corporation of India Limited (ECIL), a Miniratna Category‑I PSU under the Department of Atomic Energy, has released ECIL Recruitment 2026 Notification Advt. No. 07/2026 for walk‑in selections to various fixed tenure contract posts in its business verticals across the country.

🔔 Never Miss a Govt Job Again!

⚡ Get Custom Govt Job Alerts by Your Qualification (10TH | 12TH | Diploma | ITI | Graduate, Etc)

Join Now

The notification invites dynamic and experienced candidates for Project Engineer on Contract (PE‑C), Technical Officer on Contract (TO‑C), Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C) and Senior Artisan on Contract (SA‑C) with postings in North, West and South Zones including New Delhi, Chandigarh, Ferozepur, Pathankot, Rawatbhata, Mumbai, Kakrapar, Bengaluru, Kaiga, Kudankulam, Kalpakkam and Chennai.

Engagement will be purely on contract basis for an initial period of one year, extendable up to four years (two years for one Kudankulam PE‑C category) based on project requirements and performance, with consolidated monthly emoluments up to Rs. 55,000 for Project Engineers and other benefits like medical insurance reimbursement, PF and TA/DA as per rules.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF

Advertisement

Notification PDF for ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 is available on the ECIL careers page under the title “Walk‑in Selections for various Contract Posts (Advt. No. 07/2026)”. Candidates should download and read the ECIL notification carefully to check detailed post‑wise qualifications, experience, age limits, reservation, salary, selection criteria and complete instructions for appearing in the walk‑in.

ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF (Advt. 07/2026) Download Notification PDF

ECIL Recruitment 2026 - Overview

Particulars Details
Organization Electronics Corporation of India Limited (ECIL), a Govt. of India (DAE) enterprise, Miniratna Category‑I 
Advertisement Number & Date Advt. No. 07/2026, dated 26.03.2026

Tenure Initial 1 year, extendable up to 4 years (including initial term) depending on project requirement & performance; one PE‑C post at Kudankulam extendable up to 2 years 
Work Locations/Zones New Delhi & Chandigarh & Ferozepur & Pathankot & Rawatbhata (North Zone); Mumbai & Kakrapar (West Zone); Bengaluru & Kaiga (South Zone); Kudankulam, Kalpakkam & Chennai (South Zone)

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy 2026 Details

A total of 27 vacancies will be filled for Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan posts under the ECIL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 07/2026) on fixed tenure contract basis across North, West and South Zones. Check ECIL post wise contract vacancy details in the table below.

Post ECIL Vacancy 2026

Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C) 03

Total ECIL Contract Posts 32

ECIL Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates (walk‑in schedule)

ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 Events Important Dates & Details
Date of ECIL Advt. 07/2026 notification 26 March 2026 
Walk‑in date – Mumbai (West Zone) 09 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, #1207, Veer Savarkar Marg, Dadar (Prabhadevi), Mumbai – 400028 
Walk‑in date – New Delhi (North Zone) 09 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, D‑15, DDA Local Shopping Complex, A‑Block, Ring Road, Naraina, New Delhi – 110028 
Walk‑in date – Bengaluru (South Zone) 20 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, #1/1, 2nd Floor, LIC Building, Sampige Road, Malleswaram, Bengaluru – 560003 
Walk‑in date – Chennai (South Zone) 20 April 2026 – ECIL Zonal Office, Economist House, S‑15, Industrial Estate, Guindy, Chennai – 600032 
Walk‑in registration time at venues 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs; candidates reporting after 11:30 hrs will not be allowed to register 
Cut‑off date for age & post‑qualification experience Date of selection (respective walk‑in date) 

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria 2026

  • Project Engineer on Contract (PE‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in relevant disciplines such as Electronics, ECE, ETC, EEE, E&I, CSE, IT, CSIT, Mechanical/Electrical with NDT Level‑II (for Kudankulam) along with a minimum of 3 years post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship in the relevant field up to 1 year is also counted as experience.
  • Technical Officer on Contract (TO‑C): B.E./B.Tech with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in Electronics/Electrical/ECE/ETC/EEE/E&I/CSE/IT and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience; apprenticeship up to 1 year is countable towards experience.
  • Assistant Project Engineer on Contract (APE‑C): Diploma with at least 60% aggregate marks (50% for SC/ST where reserved) in ECE/ETC/Electronics/EEE/Instrumentation and minimum 1 year post‑qualification experience including relevant apprenticeship.
  • Senior Artisan on Contract (SA‑C): ITI passed in Electronics, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Instrumentation or Radio & TV trades with minimum 2 years post‑qualification experience (including up to 1 year apprenticeship) in maintenance/repair of electronics, instrumentation systems, communication gadgets or computers.
  • Age Limit (UR): Project Engineer – maximum 33 years; Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan – maximum 30 years. Age relaxation is 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, an additional 10 years for PwBD (40% and above) over category relaxation, and 5 years for candidates domiciled in J&K from 01.01.1980 to 31.12.1989.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Salary 2026

  • Selected candidates under ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 will receive consolidated monthly emoluments based on the post and contract year, along with limited benefits as per ECIL rules.
  • Consolidated Emoluments: Project Engineer on Contract – Rs. 40,000 (1st year), Rs. 45,000 (2nd year), Rs. 50,000 (3rd year), Rs. 55,000 (4th year) plus a one‑time attire allowance of Rs. 8,400 after completion of at least six months; Technical Officer on Contract – Rs. 25,000 (1st year), Rs. 28,000 (2nd year), Rs. 31,000 (3rd & 4th years); Assistant Project Engineer – Rs. 25,506 per month; Senior Artisan – Rs. 23,368 per month, with APE‑C and SA‑C wages revised every six months as per CLC (Central) guidelines.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • The ECIL Advt. No. 07/2026 walk‑in notification does not prescribe any separate application fee for appearing in the selection process for these contract posts.
  • Fee Status: Candidates are required to download the application form and attend the walk‑in with documents; there is no mention of any application or examination fee in the advertisement, so applicants should not pay any money to unauthorized persons or intermediaries and rely only on official ECIL instructions.

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Application Form

There is no online application process for ECIL Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 07/2026); candidates have to attend walk‑in selections as per the notified schedule. Eligible applicants must visit the official ECIL website ecil.co.in, download the prescribed ECIL contract application form 2026, fill it carefully and report at the concerned zonal walk‑in venue on the respective date within the registration time slot.

Candidates must carry the duly filled ECIL application form, updated resume, original certificates and one set of self‑attested photocopies for age, qualification, experience, category, disability, ex‑servicemen and identity proof along with recent passport size photographs. Registration and document verification will be done at the venue before the personal interview under ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026.

Click to Download ECIL Contract Application Form 2026

Download ECIL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF (Advt. No. 07/2026)

ECIL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 selection for Project Engineer, Technical Officer, Assistant Project Engineer and Senior Artisan will be based on walk‑in registration, document verification and personal interview with a weighted merit system.
  • Shortlisting & Evaluation: After on‑spot registration and successful verification of original documents, candidates will be evaluated on three components – (A) Qualification: 20% of aggregate percentage scored in BE/B.Tech/Diploma/ITI; (B) Relevant Experience: up to 30 marks based on post‑qualification experience as per post‑specific rules; and (C) Personal Interview: 50 marks.
  • Final Merit & Offer: Final recommendations will be prepared in order of merit based on total score (A+B+C). Experience from purely academic internships, college projects etc. is not counted. Selected candidates will be engaged on fixed‑tenure contract and must be willing to work anywhere in India as per ECIL’s project requirements.

How to Apply / Attend ECIL Walk‑in Recruitment 2026

Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria for ECIL Contract Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 07/2026) must appear personally at the designated zonal venues on the scheduled walk‑in dates with the prescribed application form and documents.

  • Step 1 – Download ECIL Application Form: Visit the official ECIL website www.ecil.co.in, open the Careers/Recruitment section and download the application form for Advt. No. 07/2026. Take a printout and fill it neatly with all required details including post category, zone and location preference.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Documents: Keep ready original and one set of self‑attested copies of 10th certificate (DOB proof), all qualification certificates and marksheets, CGPA‑to‑percentage conversion (if applicable), complete experience certificates with from‑to dates and post held, appointment order and recent payslips (if currently employed), caste (EWS/OBC/SC/ST) certificate, non‑creamy layer OBC certificate (not older than one year), PwBD certificate, Ex‑servicemen/ J&K domicile proof and valid government ID (Aadhaar/Passport etc.).
  • Step 3 – Reach Walk‑in Venue in Time: Report to the respective ECIL Zonal Office (Mumbai, New Delhi, Bengaluru on 20 April 2026; Chennai on 20 April 2026) within the registration time 09:00 hrs to 11:30 hrs. Late reporting after 11:30 hrs will not be accepted under any circumstances.
  • Step 4 – Registration & Document Verification: Submit the filled ECIL application form 2026, resume and document set at the registration desk. After successful verification, candidates will be allowed to attend the personal interview as part of the selection process.
  • Step 5 – Attend Interview & Wait for Result: Appear for the interview as scheduled at the venue. Final selection will be based on the combined weightage of qualification, experience and interview performance. Shortlisted candidates will receive joining instructions from ECIL and must be prepared for posting at project locations anywhere in India.

BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 - Fellowship Amount

  • Selected candidates under BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 will be placed at one of three fellowship levels - RA-I, RA-II or RA-III - based on qualifications, experience and performance in the selection interview.

RA-II and RA-III carry higher fellowship amounts plus Contingency Grant and HRA as per BARC norms.   • RA-I: 58,000/- p.m. plus Contingency Grant of 60,000/- per annum plus HRA as applicable.

Deputy Establishment Officer, Recruitment-V, Central Complex, BARC, Trombay, Mumbai - 400085

The envelope must be superscribed with the Research Project Number. Candidates must apply separately for each Research Project with a separate set of documents. Applications received through email will not be accepted.

BARC RA Fellowship Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The BARC Research Associate Fellowship Recruitment 2026 selection will be conducted through screening of applications followed by a personal interview - no written exam.
  • Stage 1 - Screening: Applications received will be subject to screening based on qualifications, experience and relevance to the research project. Only screened-in candidates will be called for interview. All information related to selection will be made available on www.barc.gov.in.

The RA fellowship level (RA-I / RA-II / RA-III) will be decided by the interview committee based on: (i) quality of Ph.D. thesis, (ii) post-Ph.D. research experience as evidenced from publications and/or products/processes developed, and (iii) performance in the selection interview.   • Step 3 - Affix Photograph: Affix a recent passport-size photograph in the space provided on the application form.

SBI SCO Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process

  • Shortlisting: Merely fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience does not guarantee a call for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide the shortlisting parameters. The Bank's decision to call candidates for interaction shall be final.
  • Interview: Interview will carry 100 marks. Qualifying marks will be decided by the Bank. Merit list will be prepared in descending order of scores obtained in interview only.

  • Call Letter: Intimation/call letter for interview will be uploaded on the Bank's website or sent by email. No hard copy will be sent.
  • Travel Reimbursement: Outstation candidates shortlisted for interview will be reimbursed Air fare (Economy Class) for the shortest route, maximum up to Rs. 15,000/- (both ways) or actual travel cost, whichever is lower. Local conveyance will not be reimbursable.

2. Fill Application Form: Fill in all details carefully. The application can be saved if unable to complete in one go — a provisional registration number and password will be generated. This saving/editing facility is available only three times. Once submitted, no changes/corrections will be allowed.

3. Upload Documents: Upload all required documents in the prescribed format. All documents (except photo & signature) must be in PDF format, A4 size, max 500 kb. Photo: JPG/JPEG, 20-50 kb, 200×230 pixels. Signature: JPG/JPEG, 10-20 kb, 140×60 pixels (on white paper with black ink pen; signature in CAPITAL LETTERS not accepted).

4. Pay Application Fee: Pay Rs. 750/- (General/EWS/OBC) or Nil (SC/ST/PwBD) online via Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/UPI. On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form will be generated — print and retain for records. Registration is complete only after successful fee payment.

5. Take Printout: After final submission, take a printout of the system-generated online application form for future reference. All updates will be posted on the Bank's website only — no separate communications will be sent.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Supervisor (Assay/T.O.-Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy): Candidates must possess a 1st class full-time Diploma in Engineering in the relevant stream (Chemical/Mechanical/Electrical/Metallurgy) from a recognized institution, or higher qualification i.e. B.Tech/B.E./B.Sc. (Engineering) in the relevant discipline.
  • Engraver (Sculpture/Metal Works): Candidates must hold a Bachelor of Fine Arts (Sculpture or Metal Works) with at least 55% marks from a recognized institution.
  • Jr. Office Assistant & Jr. Bullion Assistant: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and typing speed of English @ 40 w.p.m. / Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Jr. Hindi Typist: Candidates must be a Graduate in any discipline with computer knowledge and Hindi typing speed @ 30 w.p.m.
  • Laboratory Assistant: Candidates must hold a B.Sc. with Chemistry as a major subject with at least 55% marks.
  • Jr. Technician (all trades): Candidates must hold a full-time ITI certificate recognized by NCVT/SCVT in the relevant trade (Fitter/Turner/Electrician/Carpentry/Melter/Chemical Plant Operator/Goldsmith).
  • Age Limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum 25 years for Jr. Technician posts, 28 years for B-3/B-4 level posts, and 30 years for Supervisor posts, as on the closing date of online application. Age relaxation is provided for SC/ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10–15 years), and Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected candidates under IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 will be appointed on regular posts with pay scales as per the company's pay structure along with applicable allowances.
  • Pay Scale Details: Supervisor posts carry Level S-1 pay matrix ₹27,600–95,910; Engraver and Jr. Office/Bullion Assistant/Lab Assistant posts carry Level B-3 ₹21,540–77,160 or Level B-4 ₹23,910–85,570; and Junior Technician posts carry Level W-1 ₹18,780–67,390. Selected candidates will be placed on probation for one year, extendable by a further one year at the discretion of the company.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Application Fees

  • As per the IGM Recruitment 2026 advertisement, candidates belonging to UR, EWS and OBC categories must pay a non-refundable fee of ₹1000/- (inclusive of GST).
  • SC/ST and PwBD candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee but are required to pay a non-refundable fee of ₹200/- towards service expenses.
  • Payment can be made online through Debit Cards, Credit Cards, Internet Banking, or UPI. Fee once paid is non-refundable under any circumstances.

IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted through an online Computer Based Test (CBT) of objective type, followed by a Typing/Skill Test for certain posts, and a final merit list based on CBT performance.
  • For Supervisor posts (S-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes consisting of General Arithmetic (25 marks), Logical Reasoning (20 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (105 marks).
  • For Jr. Office Assistant, Jr. Bullion Assistant & Jr. Hindi Typist (B-3 Level): A CBT of 150 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Awareness (30), Computer Knowledge (30), English Language Skills (30), Numerical Aptitude (30), and Reasoning Aptitude (30), followed by a Typing Test (English @ 40 w.p.m. or Hindi @ 30 w.p.m.). Final merit is based on CBT performance only.
  • For Jr. Technician posts (W-1 Level): A single-phase CBT of 120 marks in 120 minutes comprising General Arithmetic (20 marks), Logical Reasoning (15 marks), and Technical/Professional knowledge in the relevant trade (85 marks).
  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: General/EWS category – 55%; OBC – 50%; SC/ST – 45%. There is no negative marking.

  • Eligible candidates for IGM Noida Recruitment 2026 must complete the online application through the company's official website within the specified dates.
  • Step 1 – Visit Official Website: Go to http://igmnoida.spmcil.com, click on "Discover SPMCIL" and navigate to the CAREERS page to find the IGM Recruitment 2026 link.
  • Step 2 – Registration: Register on the portal using a valid mobile number and email ID, create login credentials, and proceed to the IGM online application form 2026.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

  • Additional Assistant Director: The post is to be filled on deputation basis. The eligibility criteria including educational qualification, experience, and other conditions are detailed in Annexure-C, available on the CBIC website (www.cbic.gov.in) and DGPM website (https://dgpm.gov.in).
  • The Directorate General of Performance Management is the cadre control authority in respect of Group 'B' and 'C' cadres including the post of Additional Assistant Director in various Directorates under CBIC.
  • These Directorates deal with functions such as investigations into cases of evasion of duties/taxes, human resource development, infrastructure, audit, inspections, legal and appellate matters, systems and data management, and data analysis.
  • Candidates whose applications are forwarded by the concerned Ministry/Department/Organization once received in DGPM will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Salary

  • Selected officers under DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 will be placed at Pay Matrix Level-8 (Rs. 47,600–1,51,100) on deputation basis.
  • After completion of four years of regular service in Level-8, officers will be placed at Level-9 (Rs. 53,100–1,67,800) in the pay matrix.

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Application Process

  • The nomination/application process for DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is through offline/hard copy mode only via the proper channel. Eligible officers must get their nominations forwarded by their concerned CCAs (Chief Controllers of Accounts) along with NOC and all required documents.
  • Applications/Documents received through e-Office of concerned CCAs will be accepted only where the same are duly received in hard copy. Applications/Documents received only through email will not be accepted.
  • The nominations of eligible officers along with required documents, duly attested in Hard Copy, must reach by post or special messenger to:
  • Joint Director (CCA), DGPM Hqrs., 5th Floor, Drum Shaped Building, I.P. Estate, New Delhi – 110002 on or before 12th May 2026 (by 5:00 PM).

DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • The DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 is a deputation-based recruitment. Selection will be based on the eligibility criteria as per Recruitment Rules of Additional Assistant Director dated 31.03.2022 of DGPM.
  • The selected officers may be posted to any of the Directorates/Stations throughout India. Applicants may give the option of 05 Directorates in Annexure B(i) and 03 Stations in Annexure B(ii) in order of their preference. However, the options exercised do not guarantee posting at the said Directorate/Station.

How to Apply for DGPM CBIC Recruitment 2026

  • Eligible officers for DGPM CBIC Additional Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 must submit their nominations through proper channel well before the closing date.
  • Step 1 – Check Eligibility: Download and read Annexure-C from www.cbic.gov.in or https://dgpm.gov.in to verify eligibility criteria, educational qualification, and experience requirements.
  • Step 2 – Prepare Application: Fill in the application/nomination form with personal details, service details, cadre information, posting preference (5 Directorates from Annexure B(i) and 3 Stations from Annexure B(ii)), and all required information.
  • Step 3 – Obtain NOC: Obtain No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your employer/department before forwarding the application.
  • Step 4 – Forward Through Proper Channel: Get the nomination forwarded through the concerned CCA (Chief Controller of Accounts) with all required documents duly attested in hard copy.
  • Step 5 – Ensure Hard Copy Reaches on Time: Ensure the complete application in hard copy reaches Joint Director (CCA), DGPM Hqrs., 5th Floor, Drum Shaped Building, I.P. Estate, New Delhi – 110002 on or before 12 May 2026 by 5:00 PM. Applications received after the last date or incomplete in any respect will not be entertained.
